title: Curriculum Manager - AI Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About DataCamp

Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors.

In this role, you’ll combine AI skills, technical expertise, and passion for great didactic experiences to usher in the next generation of education. 

About the role

This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with subject matter experts and leverage in-house-built cutting-edge AI tooling to scale high-quality course creation across AI engineering: building applications with large language models (LLMs), prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and related topics such as evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, and LLMOps. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

  • Manage the entire content development lifecycle and deadlines.
  • Source and recruit top-tier subject-matter experts as instructors.
  • Collaborate with instructors to create engaging content.
  • Consistently leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and more to drive high-quality content production at scale.
  • Design, review, and create content on LLM application development, prompt and context engineering, RAG and vector databases, agents and tool use, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of AI systems, and related topics. You will review content from a learner perspective, ensuring it is technically accurate, reflects current AI engineering best practices in a fast-moving field, and is pedagogically effective.
  • Continuously assess course performance using learner feedback and engagement data to drive improvements.
  • Identify and prioritize existing curriculum gaps or new topics in DataCamp's AI engineering curriculum.

We’re excited about you because you have the following:

  • A solid hands-on background building and shipping production AI applications as an AI engineer, machine learning engineer, or software engineer. Experience taking LLM-powered systems from prototype to production (e.g. evaluation, monitoring, cost and latency optimization) is a strong plus.

title: Customer Operations Director
descriptionHtml:
Customer Operations Director

Do you know how to combine customer focus, commercial awareness and operational excellence?

As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets.

Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery.

This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations.

What will you do?

You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance.

You will:

  • Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels.

  • Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries.

  • Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets.

  • Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up.

  • Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs.

  • Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals.

  • Use customer feedback and data to improve service, and share insights with Sales and Product.

  • Lead the organization through change together with HR and country managers, while keeping service levels high.

In addition:

  • You have 10+ years of experience in customer service, order management and/or sales support in a B2B environment.

  • You have 5+ years of leadership experience, including managing team leaders and being responsible for service performance.

  • You have a proven track record of improving processes and leading change, ideally across multiple countries.

  • You combine commercial awareness with operational discipline.

  • You have experience with CRM and order management systems, and you know how to turn data into practical improvements.

  • Experience in building automation, technical products or subscription services is a strong plus.

  • You are fluent in Dutch and professionally proficient in English. German is a plus.

  • You are willing to travel regularly between teams and markets.

What you get

Ready to make an impact?

Do you want to take Customer Operations within Building Automation to the next level and build a strong, scalable and customer-focused organization for our customers and partners?

descriptionHtml:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

  

About the role

 

We are looking for a DS/ML Engineer intern to join our Data Science team. Your mission will at the crossing of R&D, ML Engineering and product, supervised by senior ML engineers. You will work on developing of our existing Deep Learning/Computer Vision pipelines using State-of-the-art algorithms.

  

Your main mission will be to:


• Develop clinical understanding of fetal ultrasound in the anatomical areas you will work on,
• Explore and train different approaches for Detection and Segmentation of anatomical structures and views, and integrate your results in our ML infrastructure (AWS, SageMaker, MLflow),
• Explore the possibility of training Foundation Models for Ultrasound Imaging,
• Run evaluation protocols consistent with the way our models are evaluated during regulatory submissions, and document your experiments so the team can build on them. Publication is possible and encouraged if the results support it.

 


About the profile

 

Sonio is a mission-driven company so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:


• Currently in Master 2 / Bac+5 of Engineering School or University, you are majoring in Computer Science or Data Science and are looking for an internship lasting between 5 and 6 months,
• Good knowledge of Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms, and the willingness to explore and work on state-of-the-art algorithms,
• Solid Python and PyTorch/HuggingFace, and comfortable with segmentation and detection architectures,
• Strong interest in computer vision and women’s health. A first experience with medical images is a plus,

title: Data Science Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation and causal inference.

We’re hiring multiple Data Science Managers across different areas of the business. All of these roles are at the same level. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope and team at the end of the process, based on your background, interview performance, preferences and current business needs.

We’re also advertising some opportunities separately where particular domain experience is especially relevant. You only need to submit one application, as we’ll consider your profile across all suitable Data Science Manager vacancies. Before an offer is made, you’ll have the opportunity to meet the proposed team, either virtually or at our London headquarters, and learn more about the role’s scope and priorities.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll own the analytical direction and measurable impact of a product or business area, while leading and developing a high-performing team of data scientists or machine learning engineers.

Our Data Science Managers work across a range of consumer, product and commercial areas. Depending on the team you join, your work could focus on areas such as customer retention and loyalty, pricing and promotions, discovery and personalisation, or customer acquisition and engagement.

Across all roles, you’ll lead and develop your team, set the analytical direction for your area and decide which problems are worth solving. You’ll ensure data science work translates into better product and commercial decisions, not just analysis.

You’ll remain hands-on while managing a team, partnering with Product, Engineering, Ops, Marketing and Finance as a thought partner. You’ll set the bar for analytical rigour, prioritisation and impact across noisy metrics, real trade-offs and strong stakeholder opinions.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience line managing data scientists and supporting their career development

  • A strong background as a senior individual contributor, with hands-on experience in experimentation, causal inference or applied machine learning

  • Proven ability to identify high-impact opportunities and turn insights into clear strategy and execution

  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where prioritisation and judgement matter as much as technical skill

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll work on real-world problems at global scale, across a three-sided marketplace that is constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more, united by a shared drive to make things better. Working here, you can expect:

  • High autonomy to shape strategy and deliver meaningful impact

  • Support to learn and grow through L&D programmes, mentoring and peer learning

  • A strong focus on wellbeing, with benefits that vary by country

  • A place to belong, with a diverse global workforce and active employee communities

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Serval is an AI-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real-world workflows and execute them end-to-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high-volume, high-friction operational work across their organizations.

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others.

About the team

The Agent Deployment team is a customer-facing technical team, central to how Serval turns product capability into real business outcomes. The org is a family of roles: Deployment Strategists are the primary technical relationship and AI advisor for each customer, partnering with Deployed Software Engineers to build enterprise-grade features and products. Deployment Success Managers own each customer's long-term success, building the systems and motions that scale adoption, expansion, and renewal well past go-live.


Role Overview

As a Deployment Strategist on Serval's Agent Deployment team, you’ll be the primary technical relationship for Serval’s customers: guiding their deployments, advising their AI strategy, and owning their outcomes. You’ll work deeply within Serval’s existing product surface area: building novel workflows, configuring integrations, and shipping bug fixes and product changes yourself.

This role is for someone who thrives on execution velocity, moving quickly across multiple engagements at once. You’re at home in ambiguity and bring a strong blend of technical depth, product sense, and customer obsession. And because you sit closest to how customers actually use Serval, you'll directly shape our product roadmap: the workflows and features you build in the field make their way into the core product.

What You’ll Do

  • Own customer engagements from pilot through production launch: design and deliver deployments that fit each customer's workflows and scale adoption of Serval.

  • Build AI agents: design and build AI agents on Serval's platform that drive real value for customers.

  • Advise AI strategy: embed with customers to guide and shape how they adopt and scale AI.

  • Lead migrations: design and execute migration plans that minimize disruption and ensure seamless adoption of Serval's platform.

  • Partner cross-functionally: work with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to turn field learnings into repeatable processes and a sharper go-to-market.

What You’ll Need

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • 5+ years in a relevant role (product, engineering, consulting, founder).

  • Strong communication and relationship management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Hands-on technical ability: reading and troubleshooting production code in customer-facing environments, analyzing code paths, database state, and API requests/responses with infra and browser dev tools.

  • Working knowledge of APIs and REST, IAM, and SQL for data analysis.

     

Nice to Have

  • Experience in an early-stage startup environment.

  • Background working with enterprise customers or complex technical sales cycles.

  • Familiarity with IT, security, service management, or workflow automation.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.

  • Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.

descriptionHtml:
Développeur Python IA (H/F)

Paris/Lille | Secteur Assurance

Pourquoi cette opportunité ?

Parce que vous participerez à la construction de notre stratégie d’intelligence artificielle, que nous sommes en train de définir.
Vous rejoindrez une équipe motivée et talentueuse, dont la mission est d’intégrer l’IA au cœur de nos processus métier.

L’objectif est de répondre aux besoins de nos équipes comme à ceux de nos clients, et d’automatiser certaines tâches à faible valeur ajoutée.

Éléments clés

  • Concevoir des solutions RAG et agentiques appliquées à des cas d’usage métier concrets.
  • Développer et orchestrer des agents tout en assurant la traçabilité des sources et la maîtrise des hallucinations.
  • Contribuer directement au workflow de paramétrage produit KELIA, avec une validation humaine intégrée aux étapes clés.
  • Participer à la mise en production des assistants, de leur API jusqu’à leur intégration dans l’interface web interne.


Ce qu’il faut savoir :

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur Python IA pour rejoindre notre équipe R&D à Paris ou Lille

Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions, de la conception jusqu’à la mise en production, en mobilisant différentes approches : modèles de langage (LLM), apprentissage supervisé, clustering et autres techniques de machine Learning.

Un volet important de la mission concerne également le paramétrage produit : l’objectif est d’extraire les informations pertinentes des conditions générales, de proposer un paramétrage, de prévoir une validation par un expert à chaque étape et de produire un fichier directement importable dans KELIA.

Missions principales :

Vous développez en Python des fonctionnalités IA.

  • Ingestion documentaire : extraire le texte et les tableaux des PDF, des pages Confluence, des documents SharePoint et des dépôts GitLab, puis découper, indexer et mettre à jour ces contenus avec des jobs asynchrones.
  • Recherche : recherche hybride (sémantique et mots-clés), filtres par collection et par chemin, reranking, et recherche visuelle sur les pages de documents.
  • Agents et LLM : développer des agents avec LangGraph (routage, recherche, filtrage, réflexion, réponse), écrire et versionner les prompts, citer les sources, et répondre « je ne trouve pas » quand l'information manque.
  • Workflow de paramétrage produit : contribuer à l'agent qui extrait les informations des conditions générales, propose le paramétrage, fait valider chaque étape par un expert et produit un fichier importable dans KELIA.
  • Qualité : maintenir des jeux de tests, mesurer le taux de bonnes réponses, suivre les réponses inventées et vérifier que les résultats sont stables d'un run à l'autre.
  • Coût et latence : suivre la consommation de tokens, le temps de première réponse et le cache, et choisir le bon modèle pour chaque tâche.
  • API : exposer les assistants en API, avec des réponses en streaming, et les intégrer à l'interface web interne.
  • Documenter votre code, écrire des tests et participer aux revues de code.


Ce poste est fait pour vous si:

  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’un Bac+5 en informatique ou assurance
  • Vous maîtrisez Python 3.11+ et êtes à l’aise avec le développement d’API via FastAPI, Pydantic et le streaming SSE.
  • Vous avez une expérience ou un réel intérêt pour les solutions d’IA générative, les LLM et les architectures agentiques avec LangChain, LangGraph et LiteLLM.
  • Vous connaissez les principes de RAG, de recherche hybride, d’embeddings et de reranking, idéalement avec Qdrant.
  • Vous savez travailler avec des sources documentaires variées et leur ingestion, notamment des PDF, Confluence, SharePoint ou GitLab, avec des outils tels que Docling.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les environnements de stockage et de persistance reposant sur PostgreSQL et le stockage objet S3.
  • Vous accordez de l’importance à l’observabilité et à la qualité des solutions IA, notamment au suivi des prompts, des traces, des logs, des coûts et des performances, avec des outils comme MLflow.
  • Vous êtes sensibilisé aux enjeux de sécurité, d’authentification et de gestion des rôles, notamment avec Keycloak.
  • Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement d’industrialisation moderne utilisant Git, GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm et pytest, ainsi que des outils collaboratifs comme Jira et Confluence.


Ce que vous apportez

  • Une bonne maîtrise de Python et de ses bonnes pratiques : tests (pytest), typage, gestion des dépendances.
  • Votre expérience dans l’utilisation des API de LLM et bases du prompt engineering, y compris les sorties structurées.
  • Votre compréhension du fonctionnement d'un RAG : embeddings, découpage, recherche, génération.
  • Une bonne maîtrise du SQL et notions de bases de données.
  • Git et travail en équipe.


Pourquoi nous joindre:

  • Pour contribuer à une stratégie où l’intelligence artificielle est un levier clé de la feuille de route technologique, avec des solutions intégrées au cœur des outils métiers.
  • Pour travailler sur des cas d’usage concrets d’IA générative, de RAG et d’agents LLM, de l’expérimentation jusqu’à l’industrialisation.
  • Pour associer des technologies IA de pointe à une expertise métier forte dans le secteur de l’assurance et créer des solutions à impact réel.

title: DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
In a world where geopolitical tensions and security threats are accelerating, the way nations protect people and preserve peace is being redefined. For a long time, innovating in defense was about making tougher hardware. But with the evolution of software and the recent AI disruption, the future of defense is shifting to software-powered unmanned systems that save lives by removing humans from the front line. This is our mission.

At Intelic, we're building the intelligence layer for unmanned systems in defense. As a software-first company, we enable autonomous platforms to operate together - faster, smarter, and more reliably - across complex, mission-critical environments. Our technology turns disconnected assets into coordinated forces, helping operators make accurate decisions when it matters most.

Based in Amsterdam and growing fast, Intelic offers a rare opportunity to work on products that don't just move metrics - they meaningfully impact safety, resilience, and the future of Europe's security.

Why This Role Exists

Nexus has to run in places most software never goes: offline, in the field, installed and operated by people who are not developers. Getting it there in one piece, and keeping it running, is a job on its own.

Right now that job sits mostly with three backend engineers who cover this alongside their own work. As Nexus grows, so does the team, and we're adding someone to take real ownership of the pipelines, installers, and infrastructure that turn Nexus into something operators can trust, and who treats security as part of how the work gets done, not a separate project bolted on afterwards.

What You Will Do

You will join Product Adoption, the team that owns the last stretch between working software and a field-ready product: deployment, installers, monitoring, and everything that keeps Nexus running once it leaves the building. We are hiring at medior to senior level, roughly a 2 to 3, with room to flex higher for the right person.

  • Build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines that turn Nexus into an installable, field-ready product across Linux and Windows

  • Maintain and harden our software supply chain, including dependency scanning and package security

  • Own the Windows installer and service orchestration, and help developers debug the platform-specific issues that come with it: permissions, firewalls, services, "works on my machine"

  • Secure the software update server, the one online touchpoint in an otherwise offline system, and keep telemetry from the field reliable without leaking sensitive data

  • Harden APIs and authentication on the surfaces that face the outside world

  • Maintain and gradually take over our on-prem infrastructure: physical servers, backups, and disaster recovery, as we move away from renting machines in the cloud

  • Build small internal tools, mostly in Python, Rust and shell or PowerShell scripts: installers, updaters, and the occasional internal or customer-facing web app

  • Support incident response when things break in production, and help build the monitoring that catches problems before customers do

  • Write down what you learn, so the next person, including future you, doesn't have to debug the same thing twice

You'll Thrive Here If

  • You bring solid experience with CI/CD pipelines and build automation

  • Comfort working across both Linux and Windows, with the ability to actually debug problems on either, not just deploy to them

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Ansible, OpenTofu, or similar)

title: DevOps Engineer- Late Shift(2 PM - 10PM)
descriptionHtml:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

We are looking for a Senior  software engineer who is passionate about solving infrastructure challenges through software engineering and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that streamline cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational processes.

You will build programmatic infrastructure solutions using Python, Jinja2, and Terraform, generating and managing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) at scale. You will also leverage Puppet for configuration management and develop PowerShell-based automation to support and optimize Windows environments.

This is a highly technical, coding-focused position. The ideal candidate is a software-minded engineer who writes clean, maintainable, and testable code every day—not just ad hoc scripts. You should be comfortable designing reusable automation components, applying software development best practices, and driving operational excellence through automation across complex cloud and hybrid environments.

How Will You Make an Impact?

  • Drive infrastructure standardization and operational excellence by designing and developing scalable automation frameworks in Python that enable consistent and repeatable deployments across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Accelerate infrastructure provisioning by building and enhancing Terraform code-generation platforms using Python and Jinja2, enabling teams to produce validated, environment-specific infrastructure code from reusable templates.
  • Improve system reliability and compliance by developing and maintaining Puppet modules, manifests, and Hiera configurations that manage Linux and Windows environments at scale.
  • Increase operational efficiency across Windows platforms by creating robust PowerShell automation solutions for server management, Active Directory administration, and hybrid cloud integrations.
  • Simplify complex infrastructure workflows by developing internal automation tools, command-line utilities, and APIs that empower engineering teams to self-service common operational tasks.
  • Enhance the speed and safety of infrastructure delivery by integrating automation frameworks with CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated validation, testing, and deployment of infrastructure changes.
  • Improve software quality and reduce deployment risk by implementing comprehensive testing strategies for infrastructure code, including unit testing, linting, and integration testing.
  • Partner closely with cloud, platform, and application teams to identify manual processes, eliminate operational toil, and drive automation-first solutions across the organization.
  • Enable long-term scalability and maintainability by creating clear documentation, standards, and runbooks for automation frameworks and infrastructure templates.
  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture by participating in code reviews, sharing best practices, and continuously improving the quality, security, and maintainability of automation solutions.

Have you got what it takes? 

Python & Automation Development

  • 5+ years of Python development experience — not scripting, but structured, testable application code
  • Strong understanding of Python packaging, virtual environments, dependency management (pip, Poetry), and code quality tooling (pylint, black, mypy)
  • Experience building CLI tools and automation frameworks using Python (Click, Typer, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with Jinja2 templating — building reusable, parameterised templates for configuration and infrastructure code generation
  • Experience with pytest for unit and integration testing of automation code

Terraform & IaC Code Generation

  • Strong Terraform proficiency: module design, state management, remote backends, workspaces, and dependency graphs
  • Proven experience generating Terraform HCL programmatically using Python and Jinja2 — building template-driven pipelines that produce valid, linted, plan-ready infrastructure code
  • Familiarity with Terraform tooling: tflint, tfsec, terraform-docs, Terragrunt, or Atlantis
  • Understanding of Terraform provider internals and resource lifecycle management

Puppet & Configuration Management

  • Hands-on Puppet experience: writing manifests and modules, Hiera data hierarchies, node classification, and r10k / Code Manager workflows
  • Experience managing mixed Linux and Windows environments with Puppet at scale
  • Familiarity with puppet-lint, rspec-puppet, and automated Puppet module testing pipelines
  • Understanding of Puppet Enterprise or open-source Puppet Server administration

PowerShell Scripting

  • Proficient PowerShell scripting for Windows Server administration, task automation, and hybrid cloud integrations (AWS Tools for PowerShell, Azure PowerShell)
  • Experience writing reusable PowerShell modules, functions, and error-handling patterns
  • Familiarity with Pester for PowerShell unit testing
  • Experience automating Active Directory, Group Policy, or Windows networking tasks via PowerShell

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Solid AWS experience: EC2, EKS/ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch — understanding of services as automation targets
  • Familiarity with CI/CD platforms and integrating infrastructure code pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI)
  • Comfortable working with Linux  and Windows Server in production environments

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NICEr!

Enjoy NICE-FLEX! 

At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

Requisition ID: 11294
Reporting into: Director, Cloud Operations CXone, EMEA

Role Type: Individual Contributor

NICE Ltd. Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

title: Digitalisierungsberater (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du verstehst Prozesse schneller als andere und willst Kunden mit einer Lösung überzeugen, die wirklich passt? Dann verbinde bei uns Beratung, Technik und Vertrieb in einer Rolle.

Wer wir sind

docu-fix digitalisiert den sozialwirtschaftlichen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren Prozesse rund um Dokumente: Scan-Dienstleistungen, Dokumentenmanagement (u. a. DocuWare), Workflows und E-Signatur. Unsere Kunden sind unter anderem Träger der Sozialwirtschaft, Rechenzentren und öffentliche Verkehrsbetriebe.

Unsere Kunden sparen mit uns bis zu 80 % ihrer Prozesskosten – mit einer Lösung, die EU-konform ist. Wir wachsen stark, und unser Vertrieb liefert immer mehr qualifizierte Termine. Damit aus diesen Terminen Projekte werden, suchen wir dich.

Was du machst

  • Du übernimmst die Termine, die unser Inside Sales vereinbart, und führst sie bis zum Abschluss.

  • Du nimmst Prozesse auf. Im Erstgespräch und im Workshop fragst du so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo beim Kunden Zeit und Geld liegen bleiben.

  • Du zeigst die Lösung. In der Demo sieht der Kunde seinen eigenen Rechnungseingang, seine Personalakte oder seinen Vertragsprozess – nicht eine Standardpräsentation.

  • Du entwirfst das Lösungskonzept: welche Bausteine aus Scan, DocuWare, Workflow, Schnittstellen und E-Signatur zusammenpassen und was sie bringen.

  • Du kalkulierst den Aufwand, schreibst das Angebot gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb und vertrittst es vor Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Fachabteilung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Projekte sauber dokumentiert an unser Team Technischer Service & Implementierung und bleibst für den Kunden ansprechbar.

  • Du baust Wiederverwendbares auf: Demo-Umgebungen, Lösungsvorlagen und Referenzszenarien für unsere Zielbranchen.

Worauf du dich einstellst

  • Wir verkaufen kein Standardprodukt. Jeder Kunde hat andere Systeme, andere Abläufe und andere Vorgaben – du baust daraus eine Lösung, die trägt.

  • Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Buchhaltung. Die eine will Zahlen, die andere Architektur, die dritte einen Alltag, der funktioniert.

  • Du stehst zwischen Vertrieb und Technik. Du versprichst nur, was unser Implementierungsteam liefern kann.

  • Du arbeitest an mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig und hältst Fristen für Angebote und Ausschreibungen.

  • Du bist bei Kunden vor Ort und online unterwegs.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du hast Erfahrung in Presales, Consulting, Business Analyse oder der Einführung von Unternehmenssoftware.

  • Du denkst in Prozessen. Du verstehst, wie ein Rechnungseingang, eine Freigabe oder eine Aktenführung abläuft, und siehst, wo es hakt.

  • Du erklärst Technik so, dass eine Geschäftsführung entscheidet und eine IT-Leitung zustimmt.

  • Du bist technisch fit: Schnittstellen, Cloud und On-Premises, Berechtigungen und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut. Programmieren musst du nicht.

  • Du schreibst Konzepte und Angebote, die man ohne Rückfrage versteht.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, verbindlich und gern im Team mit Vertrieb und Technik.

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch, weil Workshops, Konzepte und Angebote auf Deutsch laufen.

Hilft, ist aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit DocuWare oder anderen DMS-, ECM- oder Workflow-Systemen

  • Kenntnis der Sozialwirtschaft, des öffentlichen Sektors oder von ERP- und Finanzbuchhaltungssystemen

  • Erfahrung mit E-Rechnung, E-Signatur oder revisionssicherer Archivierung

descriptionHtml:
NOTRE AGENCE

Periscope est une agence de marketing et de communication digitale indépendante qui accompagne notamment des associations, des ONG et des acteurs de l'intérêt général.

Nos clients se répartissent en trois familles :

  • Générosité : faire donner (ONG, fondations, associations)

  • Communauté : faire adhérer

  • Impact : faire recourir à un service

Notre organisation repose sur des pôles d'expertise, chacun avec son chef de projet dédié :

  • Social : stratégie et animation des réseaux sociaux

  • Design : identité, UX/UI, création

  • Développement : sites, landing pages, intégrations

  • Marketing : SEA, SEO et data

Cette organisation garantit un haut niveau d'expertise sur chaque métier.

Le poste de Directeur / Directrice de projets Grands Comptes a pour vocation de relier ces différentes expertises et d'assurer leur cohérence sur les accompagnements transverses mobilisant plusieurs pôles.

LE POSTE

Passionné(e) par la culture digitale et convaincu(e) du rôle essentiel des associations et ONG dans notre société, vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences au service de projets qui ont du sens ?

Rattaché(e) au pôle Commerce, vous assurez le pilotage opérationnel global de quelques grands comptes stratégiques multi expertises, principalement des ONG et des associations, dont les accompagnements mobilisent plusieurs pôles d'expertise de l'agence.

Véritable chef d'orchestre de ces comptes, vous en êtes le référent opérationnel en interne. Vous en maîtrisez les enjeux, l'historique et les priorités, et veillez à assurer une coordination fluide entre les différentes expertises, avec une vision partagée des objectifs et des engagements clients.

Vous exercez une autorité fonctionnelle sur les chefs de projet métiers dans le cadre des projets transverses, notamment pour coordonner les interventions, arbitrer les priorités et garantir la cohérence globale des accompagnements, sans lien hiérarchique direct.

VOS MISSIONS

1. Piloter les grands comptes et coordonner les expertises

  • Être l'interlocuteur opérationnel privilégié des clients au quotidien et assurer le suivi global de leurs accompagnements multi expertises

  • Coordonner les chefs de projet métiers, arbitrer les priorités et contribuer à la bonne répartition de la charge entre les équipes

  • Maîtriser les enjeux, les objectifs et l'historique de chaque compte afin de garantir une vision d'ensemble et une bonne circulation de l'information entre les équipes

  • Élaborer et piloter un rétroplanning global intégrant l'ensemble des expertises métiers et les différentes étapes des projets

  • Anticiper et coordonner les dépendances entre les pôles (maquettes design, intégration et développement, plan de taggage et tracking, lancement des campagnes…)

  • Organiser et animer les comités de pilotage avec les clients

  • Assurer le suivi du budget global et de la rentabilité de chaque compte, toutes expertises confondues

  • Identifier les opportunités de développement chez les clients et les transmettre à la Direction de Clientèle, qui en assure le suivi commercial et le développement

2. Analyser et optimiser la performance

  • Suivre et analyser les performances des dispositifs digitaux déployés

  • Interpréter les données et consolider les analyses des différentes expertises afin d'avoir une vision globale des résultats

  • Assurer le suivi des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et présenter des bilans réguliers aux clients

  • Identifier les leviers d'optimisation et formuler des recommandations pour améliorer continuellement les dispositifs et les résultats obtenus

3. Assurer une veille et être force de proposition

  • Réaliser une veille sur les tendances digitales, les innovations et les évolutions du secteur associatif et humanitaire

  • Effectuer des benchmarks et identifier les bonnes pratiques du marché

  • Proposer de nouvelles approches et solutions digitales en adéquation avec les enjeux et les objectifs de vos clients

VOTRE PROFIL

De formation supérieure (Bac +3 à Bac +5) en marketing, communication ou digital, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative d'au moins 7 à 10 ans en direction de projets digitaux, idéalement acquise en agence.

Vous avez une bonne connaissance du secteur associatif, humanitaire ou de l'intérêt général, et comprenez les enjeux spécifiques des ONG, notamment en matière de notoriété, de mobilisation, d'engagement et de collecte de fonds.

Vous possédez :

  • Une solide expérience dans le pilotage de projets digitaux complexes impliquant plusieurs expertises et de nombreux interlocuteurs

  • Une capacité éprouvée à coordonner des équipes pluridisciplinaires sans lien hiérarchique direct

  • Une bonne culture des leviers digitaux : SEO, SEA, social media, emailing, acquisition et analytics

  • Une bonne maîtrise des outils de suivi et de gestion de projet

  • Une connaissance des outils Analytics et de l'analyse de la performance digitale

  • Une connaissance des principaux CMS et frameworks open source du marché (WordPress, Drupal, Prestashop...)

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :

  • Votre excellent relationnel et votre sens du service client

  • Votre capacité à prendre de la hauteur, à comprendre les enjeux business et à formuler des recommandations pertinentes

title: Director Customer Growth (all gender)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Director Customer Growth (all gender) to join our Customer Success Team at our office in Berlin. Join us in building the AI-driven financial operating system for European healthcare!

What to expect in the role as Director Customer Growth: As Director Customer Growth, you own growth across our existing customer base. You lead a team of 8–10 Key Account Managers, report to our VP Customer Success and work closely with our executive leadership team.

The role has two phases. First, transformation: you turn a team with a strong service identity into a commercial growth unit with its own pipeline, reliable forecasting and measurable expansion numbers. Then, scale: you design a scalable tech-touch model for our 2,000+ smaller practices.

You are not only a manager but also hands-on in deals: with large practice chains, you lead the conversations at C-level.

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, taking admin, billing and payments off practices plates so they can focus on patients. We combine what banks and practice software offer separately: factoring, payments and software in one platform. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We hire exceptional people and hold each other to the highest standards. We believe in talent density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. We invest heavily in your development: a learning budget, regular feedback and room to take on more. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Own net revenue retention: You own NRR across our customer base, from activation after onboarding to expansion and retention; and the forecast to leadership.

  • Activate new practices: You shorten the time it takes newly onboarded practices to reach their full Private Factoring volume and AI usage.

  • Retain and grow strategic accounts: You manage our largest chains proactively, so risk is spotted early and churn does not concentrate in a few accounts.

  • Drive expansion: You carry the upsell and cross-sell targets across our portfolio (factoring, payments, software).

  • Build the growth motion: You design the funnel, pipeline stages, playbooks, tooling and enablement.

  • Lead and develop the team: You coach through 1:1s, call and deal reviews, and coach a team that is moving from service to commercial ownership.

  • Lead large deals yourself: With practice chains, you negotiate eye-to-eye with managing directors and owners.

  • Automate: You use AI and automation to surface upsell signals from usage and billing data and free up the team's time for customer conversations.

  • Work cross-functionally: You partner closely with Product (prioritization based on customer potential), Finance (pricing, packaging) and Marketing (nurture, bottom-up signals).

  • Prepare for scale: You design a tech-touch model for our 2,000+ smaller practices and build the team to run it.

What you'll bring:

  • A track record in growing existing accounts: You have 8+ years of experience in B2B Account Management or similar and have demonstrably grown an existing customer portfolio commercially.

  • Leadership experience: You have led a commercial team with its own targets for 3+ years, ideally with 8 or more direct reports.

  • A playbook you built yourself: You have built or rebuilt a Customer Success or Account Management organization, including segmentation, funnel stages, playbooks and forecast logic.

  • C-level deal experience: You have led and closed complex deals with managing directors or business owners.

  • Scale-up experience: You have delivered in an environment where processes, data and tooling were still incomplete.

  • Languages: German C2, because our customers speak German, and fluent English.

Our Interview Process:

  • Intro call with your TA Partner, online (30 min)

  • Conversation with our VP Customer Success, online (60 min)

  • Case study, on site (90 min)

  • Conversation with our founders (30 min, online)

What we offer:

  • A real mandate to shape: You don't inherit a finished CS team: you build a revenue-focused growth function and define how Support, Key Account and Growth work together.

  • Trust and ownership: You own a clear target (NRR), a team and a budget, and decide how to get there.

  • The best team wins: You work with people who hold themselves to high standards, with a direct line to leadership.

  • Benefits: a learning budget, 4 weeks of workation and hybrid working, plus the Deutschlandticket and an Urban Sports M Membership

  • AI-first engineering: drive AI-first workflows across all your teams, invest in reusable tooling and enablement, and set standards and ROI targets for how we build with agents, from planning to code review to release.

Your impact is department-wide: you'll be part of the engineering leadership team, help shape engineering-wide decisions, and step in to lead engineering when needed.

What success looks like

  • Teams plan on real capacity with Product and deliver predictably, in small increments.

  • Every area has a clear owner, and teams are shaped around clear mandates.

  • Experience leading distributed teams across countries and time zones.

  • Clear, direct communication with engineers, product leaders and executives.

How we'll assess you

  • Leadership: broad engineering leadership across several sub-domains; a strategic thinker who can judge direction for areas you don't personally know in depth.

  • AI fluency: you already embed AI in how your teams work, and you can take it to the next level for a whole function: AI-first workflows across teams, shared tooling, clear standards and measurable return.

title: Director of Software Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Role:

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 

The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 


What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title. 


What You Will Work On:
 

Technical Leadership 

  • Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
  • Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
  • Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
  • Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
  • Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture 

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
  • Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
  • Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
  • Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation 

  • Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
  • Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
  • Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence 

  • Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
  • Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
  • Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
  • Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
  • Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
  • Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
  • The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
  • Experience writing performance software in Rust
  • Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
  • Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.

ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Distinguished Leader to provide the overall technical leadership for our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration programme, part of our quantum-safe product portfolio targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. As the most senior technical authority of the programme, you will own the end-to-end architecture, from cryptographic algorithm and standards strategy to an FPGA-based product architecture with a clear path to ASIC, and you will set the technical direction across the cryptography, hardware, software and security disciplines involved. This is a rare opportunity to shape a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.

Responsibilities:

You will define the system architecture and microarchitecture of a multi-algorithm PQC accelerator implementing ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS: hardware/firmware partitioning, throughput and lane sizing derived from real customer traffic models, and a stable core-interface specification that lets cryptographic cores evolve behind a frozen contract. You will own the algorithm and standards strategy (NIST FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3), drive make/buy and IP-licensing decisions, and shape the security and certification architecture together with our side-channel and compliance specialists. You will set the technical roadmap, arbitrate the hardest cross-domain design decisions, mentor the senior engineers who own each domain, and represent the programme externally with customers, standards bodies, certification laboratories and executive stakeholders.

  • Own the end-to-end architecture and technical roadmap of a PQC hardware-acceleration product line (algorithms, microarchitecture, interfaces, and security/certification strategy) from concept to shipping product
  • Act as the programme’s most senior technical authority: set direction across disciplines, mentor senior engineers, and represent the technology with customers, standards bodies and executives

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Cryptography or a related field and fifteen or more years of experience architecting complex digital security hardware, including deep, hands-on exposure to cryptographic implementation with genuine post-quantum depth. You are a recognised authority in your field, evidenced by shipped market-defining security products, contributions to standards, publications or patents, and you have taken accelerators, secure elements or HSM-class systems from specification to production more than once.

You are equally credible discussing lattice-based cryptography with a cryptographer, timing closure with an FPGA designer, and certification strategy with a FIPS laboratory, and you can defend an architecture in front of a demanding customer or executive committee. You make well-reasoned build/buy/partner decisions under uncertainty and raise the technical bar of everyone around you. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

  • Recognised architect of cryptographic or security hardware products, with authoritative depth in PQC algorithms and standards (FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3)
  • Distinguished-level technical leadership: sets direction across domains, mentors senior specialists, and represents the company externally

Preferred Qualifications:

You thrive on ambiguity and ownership, turning a strategic mandate into an architecture, a plan and a working product. You lead through technical authority and clarity rather than hierarchy, you hold quality and security to an uncompromising standard, and you are motivated by building products that will help define quantum-safe infrastructure for the next decade.

  • A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world
  • A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence
  • Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career

title: E-Mail Marketing / CRM Manager | 100% Remote (d/w/m)
descriptionHtml:
Du klickst auf “Send” und deine ersten eigen-konzipierten Mails werden an 100-tausende Interessenten verschickt. Schon kurz darauf folgt super Feedback in Form von zahlreichen Bestellungen von interessierten Kunden.

Wow – auch so kann der Start in einem neuen Job sein.

Bei uns musst du in der ersten Woche keine langweiligen Test-Aufgaben bearbeiten, erstmal deinen Laptop einrichten und dich überall einlesen.

Wir sind eine wachsende E-Mail Marketing Agentur und unsere Kunden (E-Commerce Unternehmen) kennst du wahrscheinlich schon von Höhle der Löwen & deinem Instagram Feed. In den letzten 2 Jahren sind wir von 2 auf 20 Leute gewachsen und dieses Jahr werden wir uns nochmal stark wachsen.

Das klingt genau nach dem, was du suchst? Dann lies dir jetzt unsere volle Stellenausschreibung durch. Wir suchen nämlich jemanden für unser Team:

Aufgaben

  • Kunden: Du arbeitest mit Online-Shops zusammen, bei denen du selbst gerne einkaufst (Kosmetik, Schmuck, Nahrungsergänzungsmittel, Fitnessprodukte, Fashion etc.)
  • Kommunikation: Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und dem Team. Durch regelmäßige Check-in-Calls und enge Zusammenarbeit baust du starke Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden auf und trägst die volle Verantwortung für die Planung, Koordination und Umsetzung der Projekte.
  • Team: Eigenes operatives Umsetzungsteam für Copywriting, Grafikdesign und technische Implementierung. Dein Hauptfokus besteht in der Strategieentwicklung
  • Best Practices: Versandvolumen, die dich in deiner Arbeit und uns als Company nach vorne bringen, damit unsere Kunden stets am Puls der Zeit sind
  • Ideen: Unsere Kunden sind immer für innovative Tests offen, und wir verfügen über die nötigen technischen Ressourcen, um deine Ideen Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen.
  • Verantwortung: Du hast direkten Einfluss auf die Wachstumsrate & Profitabilität unserer Kunden

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung: Du hast bereits 1-3 Jahre im E-Mail Marketing oder CRM gearbeitet und möchtest dein Wissen weiter vertiefen.
  • Technisches Know-how: Vorkenntnisse in Klaviyo sind von Vorteil, aber deine Bereitschaft, dich in neue Tools einzuarbeiten, ist entscheidend.
  • Kommunikationstalent: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, und deine positive Ausstrahlung macht es anderen leicht, mit dir zu sprechen.
  • Analytischer Verstand und Kreativität: Du kannst Daten interpretieren und daraus kreative Marketingstrategien entwickeln.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast solide Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Payment: Faires Gehalt + Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten zum Team Lead
  • Teamkultur: Komplett Remote mit entsprechender Flexibilität (z.b. Sport in der Mittagspause) & gleichzeitig klarer Meetingstruktur
  • Incentive: Mit dem Ablauf der Probezeit bekommst du eine Sachbezugskarte (Kreditkarte die jeden Monat mit 50€ aufgeladen wird)
  • Entwicklung: Mentoring durch deine Führungskraft, unsere externen Berater und unser stetig wachsendes Company Wiki
  • Abwechslung: Arbeite mit vielen unterschiedlichen Kunden wie z.b. Everdrop, FITTASTE, Junglück & Giesswein
  • Workation: Regelmäßiges Zusammentreffen an verschiedenen Orten: Arbeite, wo andere Urlaub machen!

Konnten wir dein Interesse wecken? Was für eine Frage – wenn du schon bis hier hin gelesen hast, freuen wir uns sehr über deine Bewerbung.

Thomas und das ganze Team von MAILODY freuen sich von dir zu lesen!

Disclaimer: Dein Alter ist nicht ausschlaggebend. Obwohl wir ein sehr junges Team sind, sind jegliche Altersklassen gerne gesehen. Diese Stellenausschreibung beschränkt sich rein auf Deutschland.

title: EMC/EMI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated EMC/EMI Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing design recommendations and establishing test policies related to Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) for our spacecraft applications. This role requires a thorough understanding of EMC/EMI principles, spacecraft systems, and industry standards to ensure the reliability and functionality of our spacecraft in harsh space environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design and Development:

    • Provide expert guidance on EMC/EMI design practices to ensure spacecraft systems meet all relevant standards and requirements.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate EMC/EMI considerations into the design phase of spacecraft systems and subsystems.

    • Review and analyze design documents, schematics, and layout plans to identify potential EMC/EMI issues.

  1. Testing and Validation:

    • Develop and implement comprehensive EMC/EMI test plans and procedures for spacecraft systems.

    • Conduct EMC/EMI testing, including pre-compliance and compliance testing.

    • Analyze test data, identify non-conformities, and recommend corrective actions to resolve EMC/EMI issues.

  1. Standards and technological watch:

    • Ensure all designs and test procedures comply with relevant EMC/EMI standards

    • Stay updated with the latest developments in EMC/EMI standards and incorporate them into design and testing processes.

  1. Documentation and Reporting:

    • Prepare detailed technical reports, test summaries, and design documentation related to EMC/EMI activities.

    • Maintain accurate records of all test results, design recommendations, and corrective actions.

  1. Collaboration and Support:

    • Work closely with system engineers, hardware designers, and other stakeholders to address EMC/EMI challenges throughout the product development lifecycle.

    • Provide technical support and training to engineering teams on EMC/EMI best practices and mitigation techniques.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in EMC/EMI engineering, preferably in the aerospace or defense industry.

  • Strong knowledge of EMC/EMI principles, test methods, and mitigation techniques.

  • Experience with EMC/EMI standards, such as MIL-STD-461, CISPR, and DO-160.

  • Proficiency in using EMC/EMI testing equipment, including spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and EMI receivers.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with spacecraft systems and subsystems.

  • Knowledge of signal integrity and power integrity as they relate to EMC/EMI.

  • Experience with simulation tools for EMC/EMI analysis.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Engineering Manager, Rapid Response Assignment (UK)
descriptionHtml:
Engineering Manager, Rapid Response Assignment - UK

Location: Remote (Cheltenham, UK)

Team: Product & Engineering

Employment Type: Full-Time

About VulnCheck

Exploitation prevention is only as strong as the intelligence driving those efforts, and most of the industry is still running on intelligence that lacks exploit context. VulnCheck, The Exploit Intelligence Company, delivers structured exploit intelligence on what is actively weaponized in the wild, purpose-built for the data lakes, ETL pipelines, automation, and AI and LLM workflows your infrastructure already runs on, raising the capability of everything it powers.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Rapid Response organization - regionally-based teams in the US, UK, and APAC that keep our customers unblocked around the clock. You’ll manage engineering teams of senior ICs directly, set the technical and operational bar for the group, and make sure work is prioritised correctly across a demanding mix of urgent and long-term needs.

This team sits at the intersection of Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales. Your teams handle urgent pre-sales requests, urgent customer issues, and other customer-driven feature requests, alongside the backend maintenance and integration work that keeps the platform stable. You’ll need to be equally comfortable setting engineering standards, coaching engineers, and triaging competing priorities across time zones. This is a 100% remote role, with preference for candidates located in Cheltenham, UK 

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and grow engineering teams based in the US, UK, and APAC, providing hands-on people leadership, coaching, and career development
  • Set priorities across urgent pre-sales requests, urgent customer issues, customer feature requests, and backend maintenance/integration work, balancing reactive and proactive work
  • Ensure continuous, follow-the-sun coverage for urgent customer and pre-sales needs across time zones
  • Partner closely with Customer Success and Sales leadership to understand customer and deal-critical needs and translate them into engineering plans
  • Partner with Product and other Engineering teams to ensure customer-driven work is integrated into the broader platform roadmap
  • Own the team's engineering quality bar, including code quality, root-cause practices, and long-term fixes over one-off patches
  • Drive hiring, onboarding, and performance management across all three regional teams
  • Establish and refine on-call, escalation, and incident response processes for the team
  • Report on team health, throughput, and customer outcomes to engineering and company leadership
  • Remove blockers for your teams and stay close enough to the technical work to make credible calls under pressure

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience managing software engineers, ideally across distributed or multi-region teams
  • Experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, or threat intelligence
  • Prior experience as a senior or staff software engineer, with credibility to engage in technical discussions and unblock your team
  • Experience managing customer-facing, support, sustaining, or reliability engineering teams
  • Proven ability to prioritize and sequence competing demands—urgent customer issues, pre-sales asks, and longer-term maintenance work
  • Experience managing teams across multiple time zones and regions, with strong async communication habits
  • Solid understanding of backend systems, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
  • A customer-obsessed mindset and a track record of turning technical challenges into strong customer outcomes
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers, Sales, Customer Success, and other Engineering teams
  • Experience working with data pipelines, ETL systems, or high-volume data processing is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience managing a customer reliability, sustaining, support, or escalation engineering function
  • Familiarity with CVE, NVD, KEV, or exploit intelligence datasets
  • Experience supporting pre-sales or deal-critical technical requests
  • Background in high-growth or startup environments

What We Offer

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted, and valued. VulnCheck offers benefits designed to meet a wide range of needs and lifestyles, tailored to your country of employment:

  • Generous, flexible time off
  • Retirement/pension plan contributions (e.g., 401k with match in the US; local pension schemes elsewhere)
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous paid parental leave
  • Remote-friendly environment with flexibility
  • Support for home office costs (phone & internet)
  • Ongoing professional development, coaching, and learning resources
  • Opportunities for career advancement within a fast-growing team

Specific benefit details vary by country and are confirmed during the offer process.

Why Join Us

Built on over two decades of cybersecurity experience, our team of experts understands the intricacies of vulnerabilities, their exploitation in the wild, and how to leverage this data to build more effective cybersecurity products that produce better outcomes for organizations.

title: Environment Artist
descriptionHtml:
About Techtive Games

Techtive Games is a Germany-based video game developer creating Ardem, an open-world survival game. Built by former modding veterans, the studio combines AA-level ambition with an independent mindset to push development practices forward and build immersive worlds built to be played, modified, and expanded.

We're looking for an Environment Artist to join our team as we move into full production on our debut game Ardem, an open world survival game developed in Unreal Engine 5.

In this role, your focus is asset production, with a strong emphasis on architecture and modularity. Our world artists build Ardem's world —> you create what they build it with: modular architecture kits, bespoke landmark structures, and the environmental assets that make the world feel believable and lived-in. You won't be doing level design yourself, but you need the instincts of someone who could — assets only work if they're made with world-building in mind. At Techtive, we believe in a creative workflow where everyone contributes to the final look and feel of the world. It's a team effort: you'll work closely with World Art, Tech Art, and 3D Art, using cutting-edge UE5 tech to push visuals to new heights.

One thing we care about a lot: we're hiring from our community. We want people who actually play survival games — not as market research, but because it's your genre. If you know from hundreds of hours in the genre why a base location feels right, why a ruin tells a story, or why clutter placement can make or break immersion, you already understand half the job. That's also why we'd love it if you share your Steam profile with your application — not as a gate, we're just genuinely curious where your gaming interests lie and how much they overlap with what we're building.

We value creativity, ownership, and personal growth. Rather than working through rigid ticket pipelines, our team members are encouraged to actively shape systems, improve workflows, and grow together not only on Ardem, but on future projects as well.

If you love building worlds players want to get lost in — and you've survived a few of them yourself — we'd love to hear from you.

Tasks

On a day to day basis, you will:

  • Create high-poly and low-poly models for environmental objects — with a clear focus on architecture: modular building kits, structures, and props

  • Overhaul and optimize our existing asset kits: consolidate materials, reduce poly counts, and bring everything to a consistent, performant standard

  • Create assets for bespoke landmark locations — the kind of places players remember

  • Design with modularity and reusability in mind, so our world artists can build more with less

  • Rework existing vegetation and natural assets to a cleaner, more maintainable standard where needed

  • Work from photo reference and concept art to hit a believable, grounded look

  • Produce clean, efficient UVs and game-ready assets that respect the technical limitations of a large open world

  • Work closely with World Art, Level Design, and Tech Art to ensure requirements are met

  • Help troubleshoot and fix problems as they arise, from a visual, technical, and production perspective

Requirements

  • Previous experience on professional game projects

  • A portfolio with clear examples of your own asset production — not just set dressing or kit-bashed scenes. On team pieces, tell us exactly which parts you made yourself; we do check.

  • Solid experience building modular asset kits, and a real understanding of how worlds are constructed from them

  • Strong modeling skills and experience in a major 3D package (Blender, Maya, 3ds Max)

  • Sculpting experience with software like ZBrush

  • Good understanding of the PBR material pipeline

  • Solid grasp of baking and texturing using the Substance Suite and Photoshop

  • Basic knowledge of shader creation

  • Ability to resolve issues from a visual, technical, and production perspective

  • Strong communication skills — you can articulate ideas and questions across departments, and give and receive constructive feedback

  • We’d appreciate a link to your Steam profile, so we can get a feel for where your interests lie and where they overlap with ours

  • Fluent spoken and written English

Bonus Skills

  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine 5

  • Knowledge of foliage creation

  • Experience with procedural workflows (e.g. Houdini)

  • Experience working on open world games

  • Experience working in an indie or small team environment

Working Model

  • Fully remote

  • Freelance, with a full time option for candidates based in Germany

  • Flexible working hours with a strong focus on ownership and trust

  • Direct collaboration within a small, focused team

Benefits

  • Work on Ardem, a highly anticipated survival game — and help set a new benchmark for the genre you love

  • Small team with high impact, results-driven mindset and fast decision-making

  • High ownership and creative freedom — shape the world, don't just fill tickets

  • Flexible working hours (results > green dots)

How We Hire

  1. First interview — We talk about Techtive, Ardem, and the role, and get a high-level picture of your skills and how you work.

  2. Art test — If the first conversation goes well, you'll receive a small art test: a basic brief with a few guidelines and some inspirational screenshots from Ardem. Everything you build should work as part of a larger environment — we're not looking for isolated beauty shots that would fall apart in an actual game world. There's no fixed deadline, but we'll ask you to track roughly where your time went.

  3. Second interview — We go through your art test together: your decisions, your process, and where you spent your time.

  4. Culture fit — The final conversation is less about craft and more about people: how you like to work, what you expect from a team, and whether we actually fit each other. We're a small, fully remote crew — who you are matters as much as what you build. The practical side (contract, conditions, start date) gets sorted here too.

We know an art test is a real time investment, and not everyone can afford that easily — we don't take it for granted. It's the fairest way we've found to judge actual craft over a polished portfolio, and it's the basis for a much better conversation in round two.
