title: Head of Business Development, Investor Network
descriptionHtml:
We're hiring a business development leader to take over the team that builds and runs our investor network: six associates, one number, and a direct line to both co-founders.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and those investors join our network as members. Founders pay for the access to those relationships and for the investor relations work our team does around every introduction, and that work is ultimately the product we sell.

The two co-founders have led this team themselves until now. It has grown to around six associates, which is past the point where two founders can coach it hands on while running the rest of the company, so we are hiring the person who takes it over.

The role
You lead the investor relations team and report to both co-founders. Each associate holds a book of investor members and runs several things at once, new investor relationships, the nurturing of existing ones, and the introductions we make for our clients, plus the follow-up work from there. Your job is to make that team excellent and keep it at full leverage, which means every associate knows what is expected, gets coached every week, can measure their own progress, and hears it the same day when something is off.

What you will do

  • Run the weekly rhythm, a pipeline and network review (CRM), a review of every win and loss, KPIs, and a one to one with every associate.

  • Coach every associate on their calls and their introductions.

  • Hire, onboard and, when needed, let people go, against a written bar for what good looks like.

  • Own the health of the entire Pairs network, more active members every month, and every member getting founders that fit at the pace they asked for.

  • Work with our client success team on each client's plan, so what your team works on matches what the client expects, and with our founder relations team, who build relationships with top founders long before they become clients.

  • Spot the constraint that holds the team back and fix it, with a process or together with our engineers, which takes someone who knows which problem is worth solving.

  • Bring the two co-founders the weekly numbers, investor calls, newly active members, introductions sent, founder calls and referrals, and what you are changing because of them.


What you bring

  • You have run a sales, business development or investment team of five or more for at least two years, the number you carried was the team's, and you can name what the team achieved under you and who you promoted.

  • People respected you and still wanted to work for you, without you needing to be liked. You give straight feedback and you hold the standard when it is uncomfortable.

  • Ego and politics are not part of how you work. You talk about the team's results before your own, and your last team would say the same about you.

  • Systems are how you think. You have built the CRM discipline, the reporting or the playbook that others then ran on, and you can find the one constraint in a team and remove it.

  • Incentives and retention make sense to you. You know what makes the right behavior pay and what makes a team stick together, and you have the retention to show for it.

  • You play the long game. You would not squeeze one month at the cost of the next three, and you go for quality over quantity with investors and founders alike.

  • The investor world is one you know well enough to coach. You have sold high ticket to senior buyers, raised capital, or built an investor or executive network yourself, and years in venture capital or at a fund are a plus on top of the team you led.


Backgrounds we expect to see are high ticket competitive sales, consulting, banking and investment teams. This is not the seat for a great dealmaker who has never led a team, our associate role is the right application for that, and investor relations at a listed company or LP reporting at a fund is a different job from this one.

What good looks like

  • By day 30 you have familiarized yourself closely with the associate work and what we expect from it.

  • Ninety days in, the weekly rhythm runs on your numbers and every associate has a written plan they measure themselves against.

  • Every month the network has more active members and every client's introductions went out on fit and on time.

  • Every quarter one constraint is gone from the team's way, through a process or through engineering.

  • After a year the associates have grown, and the relationships with investors and founders are stronger than they were, since everything here is built to compound over years.


Compensation and how we work
US$200K to US$300K+ total compensation, base plus a bonus on the team's results. Fully remote, your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours. The best AI tooling is paid for, so the admin runs itself and your hours go to people. You work next to our client success lead, our founder relations team and our engineers, each of them running their own lane.

How to apply
Hit apply, which takes you to a short form with four questions. The two co-founders read every application. The process from there is a first call, final conversations with both co-founders, and three references.

No ego is the first rule here, the team's result comes before anyone's name, the co-founders included. And everything is built to compound, so every relationship and every number should be stronger next year than it is now.

Compensation: $200K – $300K

title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

As Head of Compliance Monitoring, you'll own Lendable's risk-based compliance monitoring programme and lead the team that delivers it. You'll provide independent second line assurance that the business meets its legal and regulatory obligations, and evidence the outcomes customers actually receive rather than the processes behind them.

You'll report to the Head of Compliance (SMF 16, Compliance Oversight) and deputise for them, including at Board meetings and sub-committees. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who has built a second line monitoring function in a UK FCA regulated consumer credit firm and wants the autonomy to shape one in a fast-growing fintech. The role is not itself a Senior Manager Function.

What you’ll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Own the compliance monitoring plan and methodology, refreshing it annually and in-year in response to emerging risks, regulatory change, MI, complaints and FCA publications

  • Maintain a monitoring universe covering PRIN and the Consumer Duty, CONC, SYSC, DISP, SMCR, MCOB, the Consumer Credit Act, financial promotions and UK GDPR

  • Scope and deliver thematic and BAU reviews across the customer journey, including affordability (CONC 5), financial promotions (CONC 3), arrears and forbearance (CONC 7), vulnerability, fees and charges and complaints handling (DISP)

  • Test the design and operating effectiveness of first line controls, and provide second line assurance over first line quality assurance

  • Issue clear, evidence-based reports setting out findings, root cause, risk ratings and owned actions, then track remediation to closure and validate that it worked

  • Escalate actual or potential customer harm promptly, and assess it for redress and for notification to the FCA under Principle 11 and SUP 15

  • Produce monitoring MI for the Head of Compliance, executive management and the Board, and present it at committees

  • Support FCA supervisory engagement, information requests and skilled person (s166) reviews, and coordinate coverage with Internal Audit, Risk and first line QA

  • Bring data protection into scope, testing UK GDPR and DPA 2018 compliance alongside the Data Protection Officer

  • Lead, coach and develop the compliance monitoring team, planning resource against the plan and building capability through data, analytics and better tooling

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrable compliance monitoring experience within a UK FCA regulated firm, including designing, owning and delivering a risk-based compliance monitoring programme

  • Experience of leading, managing and developing a team

  • Consumer credit experience, with a strong working knowledge of CONC and the Consumer Credit Act

  • Strong working knowledge of the FCA Handbook, in particular PRIN and the Consumer Duty, SYSC, DISP and SMCR, and of FCA expectations of a second line monitoring function

  • Data protection knowledge, covering the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018

  • Ability to write clear, concise, evidence-based reports and to present findings credibly to senior management, the Board and its committees

  • Sound judgement and personal resilience, with the independence and confidence to challenge the business constructively and to escalate where necessary

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to deliver a plan across competing priorities

Highly desirable

  • Internal audit experience gained in a third line function, and/or a relevant professional qualification (for example IIA, ICA or CISI)

  • Secured lending experience, from either a second or third line perspective, including knowledge of MCOB

 

Interview process

  • Screening stage: a 15 minute remote cognitive exercise and a 30 minute interview with the Talent Partner

  • 40 minute interview with a Compliance Business Partner (remote)

  • Final onsite interview:

    • 45minute interview with the Head of Compliance

    • 30 minute interviews with CRO

    • 30 minute interview with a product MD

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: Head of Engineering, Cards
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Cards is one of the largest revenue lines at Tide. The domain owns everything that happens on the card: issuing and processing across the UK, EU and India, each with its own processors, card schemes and regulators.

This includes prepaid, debit, multi-currency and team cards, alongside products such as Apple Pay and Google Pay tokenisation, 3DS, card controls and settlement.

The teams are cross-functional, working closely with product, design, commercial and operations. Engineering comprises three teams, with engineers based in Bulgaria, Lithuania and India.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Head of Engineering, Cards, you will lead the engineering organisation across the UK, EU and India, shaping the next phase of the Cards platform.

With the core platform transformation largely complete, your focus will be on:

  • Product and member experience: Partnering with Product and Design to improve card experiences, including tokenisation, payment journeys, team controls and reducing false declines.
  • AI-led engineering: Embedding AI coding agents across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, delivery speed and quality.
  • Platform and commercial ownership: Completing the transition from our legacy processor, strengthening partner relationships and driving improvements in cost efficiency and unit economics.

You will set the technical direction, develop engineering leadership and ensure the platform remains reliable, scalable and commercially sustainable.

As Head of Engineering, Cards, you will:

  • Lead and develop engineering managers and senior engineers across distributed teams.
  • Define the technical strategy and architecture for the Cards domain.
  • Drive reliability, scalability and cost efficiency across card issuing and processing.
  • Embed AI-assisted and agentic development practices across engineering teams.
  • Partner with Product, Design and Commercial teams to prioritise and deliver the roadmap.
  • Own technical relationships with card processors and schemes, including integrations and certifications.
  • Strengthen engineering capabilities, particularly at Staff and senior IC levels.
  • Collaborate with other engineering leaders across Payments on shared infrastructure.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for an experienced engineering leader with a strong technical foundation and a track record of leading large, distributed engineering organisations.

Experience and background

  • Experience leading engineering managers and large engineering teams.
  • Strong experience in cards, payments or banking, with a deep understanding of card issuing, processing and card scheme operations. Experience on either the issuer or processor side is a strong plus.
  • Experience building and operating distributed engineering teams across multiple locations.
  • Proven ability to improve engineering delivery, productivity and quality.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Commercial and Finance leaders on business outcomes and unit economics.
  • Experience managing third-party technology providers and strategic partnerships.

Technical expertise

  • Strong understanding of microservices, event-driven architecture and cloud-native systems.
  • Experience with relational databases, distributed systems and large-scale transaction processing.
  • Ability to challenge architectural decisions and engage in technical and production-level discussions.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and their application across the software development lifecycle.

Leadership

  • Ability to set technical direction and drive execution through engineering leaders.
  • Strong commercial acumen and data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • A strong focus on developing engineering talent and building high-performing teams.

OUR TECH STACK: 

Java and Spring Boot microservices running on AWS, with PostgreSQL as our primary datastore. We use SNS/SQS for asynchronous and event-driven messaging. Observability is Coralogix. CI/CD runs through GitHub with automated testing and security scanning. Mobile is Flutter, web is Angular.

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

  • Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts.
  • Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
  • Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

title: Head of Engineering, Platform (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:

Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. title: Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

We are seeking an experienced Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA to lead new business acquisition across EMEA. We are investing aggressively to capture the Enterprise opportunity in front of us, and we are moving upmarket fast. We are looking for a builder: someone who will pave the way upmarket and build a real Enterprise sales playbook from the ground up, rather than inherit one.

Our segmentation reflects where we are on that journey. Enterprise is currently defined as companies with 400 or more employees, which makes it a broad segment. You will lead a team running a high volume of mid-sized deals at the lower end alongside the larger, complex enterprise deals at the top. Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role.

What you’ll do as a Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA at Vanta:

  • Define and build the Enterprise motion in EMEA: setting a clear multi-year vision aligned to GTM objectives, creating the playbook, processes, and deal strategy behind it, and evolving it as the market shifts

  • Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment

  • Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta

  • Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles

  • Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy

  • Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy

  • Bring the voice of the EMEA Enterprise buyer back into the business, influencing product priorities, pricing, packaging and regional investment

  • Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region

How to be successful in this role:

  • Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots

  • Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company.

  • Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region

  • Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it

  • Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders

  • Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity

  • Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change

  • Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

This role requires an in-office hybrid schedule, with 3 days per week in the London office.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

title: Head of Technical Operations
descriptionHtml:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Technical Operations Team 👋

Technology and Data is where Trainline invests most as we build on our position as Europe’s most downloaded travel app. Innovation is at the heart of how we work, and we keep challenging ourselves to move faster, raise quality and manage cost wisely, while making the most of emerging technology trends. The Technical Operations team brings together budget, resourcing, vendor and performance information to give a clear view of where we invest, what we get back and where we can go further.

As Head of Technical Operations, you will be a trusted partner to senior leaders across Technology, Data, Finance and Product. You will shape the insights and recommendations that guide investment and efficiency decisions across the whole portfolio. You will own the technology budget, capacity planning and external vendor relationships, and lead a team of skilled professionals. Working closely with Directors, VPs and executive leaders, you will turn complex information into clear, compelling stories that help everyone move forward together.

In this role as the Head of Technical Operations, you will...🚄

  • Own and manage the Technology budget, working with teams across the department to align spend with our strategic goals and make sure we use our money wisely across teams, tools and initiatives

  • Lead headcount and capacity planning in collaboration with Engineering, Product and Talent, supporting workforce planning and our hiring roadmap so that teams have the right people at the right time

  • Manage relationships with external technology vendors and partners, leading contract negotiations, performance reviews and renewals, while continually improving the value we get for our spend

  • Build and maintain dashboards and operational measures that give clear visibility of delivery progress, incidents and team efficiency, turning data into insight that helps leaders make faster, better-informed decisions

  • Partner across Technology and Data to form clear views and recommendations on how we improve efficiency and get the most from our investment, including where to reallocate spend, reduce waste and speed up delivery

  • Track the benefits we gain from our investments and share what we learn, so that future decisions are even stronger

  • Build trusted relationships with Directors, VPs and executive leaders across Technology, Data, Finance and Product, crafting clear narratives that bring complex financial and operational data to life and encourage confident decisions and action

  • Lead, support and develop your team, creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work

We’d love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Significant experience in a senior technology operations or technology programme management role, with a record of leading teams and delivering results in a complex environment

  • A solid understanding of budget management and financial modelling within a technology setting

  • Experience managing vendor relationships and negotiating contracts that deliver good value

  • Hands-on experience using dashboards, tools and key performance measures to give technology teams clear visibility of how they are performing

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a talent for explaining data through clear, engaging stories

  • The ability to build trust and influence Directors, VPs and executive leaders, shaping narratives that lead to decisions

  • A commercial, curious mindset, with the confidence to form a point of view and make clear recommendations on investment and efficiency

  • Ideally, experience in a high-volume digital or consumer business such as travel, e-commerce or fintech, and familiarity with Agile ways of working in cross-functional teams. We warmly welcome transferable experience from other sectors

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

title: Hoofd Servicemonteur Warmtepompen
descriptionHtml:
Hoofd Servicemonteur
Als Hoofd Servicemonteur ben jij het technische boegbeeld van onze serviceafdeling. Waar een reguliere servicemonteur de standaard onderhoudsbeurten en reparaties uitvoert, kom jij in beeld bij de complexe uitdagingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het optimaal laten draaien van onze vloot aan warmtepompen door heel Nederland. Je coacht je collega-monteurs in het veld en bent de schakel tussen de praktijk en ons engineering-team.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Specialistische Service: Je lost complexe, niet-alledaagse storingen op die een diepgaande analyse vereisen (zowel mechanisch, thermodynamisch als softwarematig).

  • Technisch Coach: Je bent de achterwacht (2e lijns support) voor je collega-servicemonteurs. Als zij vastlopen in het veld, bellen ze jou voor technisch advies of kom je ter plaatse ondersteunen.

  • Kwaliteitsbewaking: Je analyseert servicerapporten, signaleert terugkerende problemen en doet verbetervoorstellen om de betrouwbaarheid van onze systemen te verhogen.

  • Customer Excellence: Je zorgt dat de servicebeleving voor onze klanten van topniveau is en traint je team in hoe zij klanten het beste kunnen adviseren over hun warmtepompsysteem.

  • Feedbackloop: Je koppelt bevindingen uit het veld direct terug aan de productontwikkelaars in Den Haag om de volgende generatie warmtepompen nóg beter te maken.

Wie zoeken wij?

  • De Expert: Je hebt uitgebreide ervaring in het servicen van CV-installaties, koeltechniek of warmtepompen. Je leest technische schema’s als een krant.

  • Analytisch: Je vindt het leuk om diep in de data en de techniek te duiken om de oorzaak van een probleem te vinden.

  • Mentor-rol: Je krijgt er energie van om jouw kennis over te dragen aan minder ervaren collega's en hen te helpen groeien.

  • Opleiding & Certificering: Een afgeronde MBO-4 opleiding (Installatietechniek/Elektrotechniek).

  • Communicatie: Je kunt complexe techniek simpel uitleggen aan zowel een klant als aan een meer junior collega.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Sleutelpositie: Een verantwoordelijke baan in de frontlinie van de energietransitie bij een ambitieuze scale-up.

  • Ontwikkeling: Mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar Field Lead of Technisch Specialist binnen de R&D afdeling.

  • Topmateriaal: Een luxe servicebus met de modernste meetinstrumenten en gereedschap.

  • Cultuur: Werken bij een innovatieve werkgever met veel vrijheid, korte lijnen en een jong, gedreven team.

  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Een salaris dat recht doet aan jouw expertise en senioriteit (€3500-€5000), goede pensioenregeling en 38 vakantiedagen.

Over DeWarmte

Wij geloven dat verduurzaming makkelijker én slimmer kan. Met onze warmtepompen bieden we een innovatieve oplossing voor de Nederlandse huishoudens. Ons serviceteam is cruciaal voor het vertrouwen van de klant in deze nieuwe techniek.

title: HPC Security Researcher
descriptionHtml:
About the Role



As an HPC Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in high-performance computing, software development in C/C++ or Rust/Python, backed by a minimum MSc in HPC, Scientific Computing, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with SLURM, AI workloads, advanced algorithms, parallel computer architectures, Linux, network protocols in high performance computing. You excel at modeling HPC threats— resource exhaustion, lateral movement across compute nodes, Slurm exploits—and translating them into practical security defenses.
You will be one of Haste's first HPC security researchers pioneering defenses for supercomputing clusters alongside AI and quantum workloads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Investigating Threat Actors & Attack Vectors: Identifying, analyzing, and documenting threats targeting HPC systems and ecosystem trends and developments.
  • Developing Defenses and Mitigations: Designing detection logic and mitigation methods for HPC-specific threats that do not significantly degrade performance.
  • Security Modeling: Developing threat models for HPC infrastructures with Cyber threat intelligence input in adjacent technologies to predict potential attack paths.
  • Developing HPC-Specific Detection Rules: Authoring custom security rules for monitoring tools (e.g., SLURM, PBS) to detect abnormal user behavior, such as suspicious logins, resource usage, and data transfers.
  • Engineering Collaboration - Translating HPC security research into production-grade detection requirements for Haste's threat engine and HPC integration.
  • Documentation & Reporting- Creating technical reports, whitepapers, and proof-of-concept exploits to document vulnerabilities and share findings within the organization, to the public or conferences.
  • Securing Heterogeneous Environments: Designing security for complex, hybrid platforms integrating cloud, AI/ML workflows, and on-premise, bare-metal hardware.

Requirements

  • University degree in a relevant field.
  • Current residence in Germany or Austria.
  • Full-time availability from December 1, 2026, remote from Germany or Austria only.
  • experience with SLURM

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Our Value Engineers (VE) are the trusted advisor for customers and work on the intersection of technology and business. Value Engineers partner with sales and customers to create compelling solutions to critical business problems.

The Role:

Value Engineers are the trusted advisors for our prospects and customers and leverage product expertise and business acumen to solve our prospects’ and customers’ most pressing challenges You will gain experience in executing proof of value projects and take part in technical/business discussions with stakeholders. By creating customer-based business cases, you support the strategic business development activities for the French market.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. title: Internship
descriptionHtml:
About Nomos

Europe pays more than twice as much for electricity as the US or Asia. To reach competitive price levels, Europe has to lean on solar and deliver the flexibility that makes this feasible. Nomos is building a full-stack power company to unlock that flexibility by connecting millions of homes to Europe’s energy markets.

At Nomos, we care about our craft and take full responsibility for what we build. We hire for spikes, not an absence of weaknesses, and look for exceptional ability backed by a record of achievement. This has brought together IMO and IOI medalists, former founders and Olympic athletes in a team whose individual strengths reinforce one another.

 

What you’ll do

We build software that connects the energy market to thousands of physical assets, and we own almost all of it ourselves. You’ll be directly responsible for building the product, on real projects rather than intern projects.

  • Own real engineering projects end to end, from working out the problem to shipping it.

  • Work on our own stack, with AI as part of how you build every day.

  • Work directly with commercial teams, because the hard problems here are not purely technical.

 

Exciting challenges

  • Own an entire challenge. Recent interns built forecasting functions around seasonality and temperature and owned the build-out of a data analytics pipeline and a liquidity risk monitoring system.

  • Work where the market meets the physical world. Market events have to reach thousands of devices correctly, and the rules change while the assets are already running. Nobody hands you a defined task.

 

Who you are

  • You’ve excelled at something. You can point to an achievement that took unusual discipline and sustained effort. We want to understand what you accomplished and the work it took to get there.

  • You’ve demonstrated ownership. You’ve taken responsibility for a project, product, or initiative and seen it through. You can explain your decisions and show the result.

  • You go where the complexity is. You want to understand the hard part of a system well enough to solve it.

 

References

Vera Lavrova

 

Why join us?

As an early member of Nomos, you’ll help shape the company and share in its financial upside. Backed by Index Ventures, we’re building a European category leader in one of the world’s largest industries, making electricity affordable and Europe more competitive.

Building a power company from scratch brings complex, rewarding challenges and the chance to solve Europe’s energy crisis for the long term. You’ll learn from people with exceptional depth in their fields, challenge each other’s thinking and take responsibility from the start.

title: Internship - Junior Venture Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About Marble

Marble is a climate tech venture studio. We partner with scientists, engineers, and operators to create companies solving hard climate problems in the world's largest industries.

Our first 15 companies are building transformative products across energy, industry, agriculture, and climate resilience. 100% have been successful in raising follow-on to date. We are looking to partner with exceptional individuals to create our next venture.

About The Role

We are hiring a Junior Venture Analyst intern to join the Marble team and support the market and commercial exploration of key opportunity areas in climate tech.

You will work directly with Partners, senior team members, and brilliant founders on a mission to turn the tide on the climate crisis. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with some of the brightest and most mission driven individuals you’ll meet!

You will be immersed into the worlds of climate and deep tech venture creation. Expect direct exposure to the many aspects of running a climate tech studio: developing new opportunity theses, supporting founders on strategy and fundraising, running customer reserach, and forming a view on which companies are worth building.

This internship is a great fit for a student with a passion for climate tech and venture, with prior exposure in fast-paced environment where they had to own work, navigate ambiguity, and help shape key decisions (e.g. startups, scaleups, VC, corporate dev, consulting, etc.)

Location: HQ in Paris, Station F

Language: English fluency required. French fluency preferred.

Period: 6-month internship starting as soon as possible

Responsibilities

Founder & company-building support. You'll partner with our Founders in Residence as they turn a technical idea into a real business. That starts with validating their assumptions through market research — forecasts, policy drivers, competition maps, key insights — and goes further into helping them shape business-model options, go-to-market and expansion strategy, roadmap, and fundraising plans. This is effectively strategic consulting: you have a direct say in how an innovation becomes a company, and you diligence each opportunity with full objectivity — do you genuinely believe this will be a fund-returner for Marble?

Opportunity & thesis research. You'll work alongside the venture team as they develop new theses and decide where Marble should build next. Your job is to bring the business lens to that work — sizing markets, mapping the competitive landscape and market structure, identifying the real gaps, and pressure-testing whether an opportunity is genuinely venture-scale. You are the commercial and investor eye in the room.

Fundraising Operations. Support Partners on fundraising for our second startup studio vintage, as well as potential new vehicles. This includes: investor research (e.g. HNWIs, Family Offices, Fund of Fund, other LPs), data room material preparation, CRM updates, meeting scheduling and follow-ups, etc.

Customer development. You'll help run our structured outreach to connect with leading experts and gather insight through interviews, and you'll build out the customer pipeline as we push to "sell" the vision as far as it will go.

Portfolio & studio support. On an ad-hoc basis you'll support portfolio companies after spin-out, with, for instance, their first external fundraise post-Marble. You will also contribute to the studio operations that shape how Marble builds going forward, by notably drafting guides and templates used by founders regarding their commercial and financial deliverables while in program.

Across all of them, you'll turn your work into clear deliverables — memos, decks, and spreadsheet models (including light financial modeling such as cap tables and projections) — that feed directly into real decisions.

Requirements

This internship is a unique opportunity for a entrepreneurial individual who’s excited to operate in a fast-paced, high-context environment

  • You are studying for a Master’s degree at a top engineering, business school, or university

  • You already had exposure (e.g. internship, school project, etc) to startups, strategy consulting, VC or corporate development.

  • You are fluent / native in English, and ideally in French as well.

Your ability to learn on the job is more important than ticking every single box. However we would especially love to hear from you if:

  • You’re passionate about climate tech, startups, industry, energy, venture creation. You are familiar with the key trends and relevant ecosystems.

  • You’re organized, responsive, and can manage many moving parts without dropping the ball.

  • You’re a strong communicator and take pride in creating clean, structured deliverables.

  • You’ve done basic financial modeling and are comfortable working with cap tables and business plans.

  • You are comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks with a "learning by doing" attitude.

  • You excel at using modern software and AI products to increase your work leverage, such as Claude, Gemini, Notion, Slack, Airtable, Google Suite, etc. Familiarity with CRMs and specialist AI tools (e.g. Lemlist, Exa, Clay, etc) is a welcome plus.

What We Offer

  • €1,600 monthly internship stipend

  • Office located at Station F in Paris. Flexible remote days are possible

  • 5 days off

  • Meal vouchers (Swile), 50% transport refund

  • Exposure to our network of top founders, investors, and advisors

  • High ownership, rapid learning curve, and meaningful scope

  • A chance to help build the next generation of Marble companies

We believe that a diverse group of minds is key to solving the climate crisis. We encourage women and people of colour to apply. Studies have shown that under-represented candidates are less likely to apply for an opportunity unless they feel they meet every single qualification. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and mission-driven cohort. If you’re excited about the programme but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with what you read on our website, we encourage you to apply anyways!

Compensation: €0 – €1.5K per month

title: iOS Developer - AI Finance Agent
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: IT Specialist Frontend Platform
descriptionHtml:
Wie ben jij

Jij bent een pragmatische IT‑specialist met een sterke operationele basis. Je houdt van techniek, maar krijgt vooral energie van het stabiel en voorspelbaar laten functioneren van platformen. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek, operatie, regie en samenwerking. Je behoudt overzicht in complexe ketens en weet prioriteiten te stellen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • HBO werk‑ en denkniveau richting IT;

  • ervaring als IT Specialist, Application Engineer of Platform Engineer;

  • ervaring met services en (SaaS) oplossingen op Microsoft Azure;

  • praktische kennis van Kubernetes / containers / application gateways (bij voorkeur AKS);

  • ervaring met informatie analyse, operations, beheerprocessen en incidentafhandeling;

  • kennis van monitoring tooling (pré: Dynatrace);

  • ervaring met CI/CD en OTAP‑omgevingen;

  • kennis van networking, routing, firewalls en DNS, App en Lowcode oplossingen;

  • affiniteit met security, identity en toegangsbeheer (AD / Entra ID);

  • ervaring met samenwerken en regie op leveranciers of MSP‑partijen;

  • je communiceert helder, werkt gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat ga je doen

Bij Univé werken we iedere dag aan zekerheid voor onze leden. Dat doen we niet alleen met verzekeringen, maar ook met betrouwbare digitale dienstverlening. Binnen IT Kern bouwen en beheren we het fundament waarop onze dienstverlening draait. Betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, continuïteit en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Het team Frontend Platform speelt hierin een cruciale rol. Wij zorgen ervoor dat onze websites, klantomgevingen en digitale contactkanalen stabiel, veilig en toekomstbestendig functioneren. Denk hierbij aan frontendplatformen, CRM‑omgevingen, monitoring, identity & access management, cloudplatformen en integraties met andere ketens. Vanwege verdere professionalisering van ons platform zoeken wij een IT Specialist Frontend Platform. Een pragmatische IT‑specialist die techniek begrijpt én overzicht houdt in de keten. De komende jaren staan onder andere een managed service partner transitie, implementatie van ons ledencontact platform, verdere standaardisatie, lifecyclemanagement, security‑verbeteringen en professionalisering van beheerprocessen centraal. Deze thema’s sluiten aan op de bredere IT Kern doelstellingen rondom stabiliteit, schaalbaarheid, monitoring, governance en professionalisering van IT‑processen.

Als IT Specialist Frontend Platform zorg jij ervoor dat onze platformen stabiel, voorspelbaar en veilig functioneren. Jij bent de verbindende factor tussen techniek, operations, leveranciers en interne teams. Je bent niet alleen technisch sterk, maar begrijpt ook hoe processen, beheer, changes en samenwerking in de praktijk werken. Je overziet de gehele keten en weet verstoringen structureel op te lossen. In deze rol ligt de nadruk nadrukkelijk op continuïteit, regie, beheer en samenwerking binnen de keten. Daarbij werk je zowel hands‑on als coördinerend.

Wat bieden wij

Een inhoudelijk sterke rol binnen een cruciaal platform voor Univé. veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen Frontend Platform. Een afwisselende rol waarin techniek, beheer en samenwerking samenkomen. De mogelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van IT Kern.

Hybride werken vanuit Zwolle en thuis.

Overige Arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • jaarsalaris is minimaal € 57.487 en maximaal € 81.163 op basis van een 38-urige werkweek (inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning);

  • 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld;

  • variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38‑urige werkweek;

  • goede pensioen- en studiekostenregeling;

  • thuiswerk- en reiskostenvergoeding;

  • korting op schade‑ en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.

Drie focusgebieden

De IT-organisatie is vanaf 1 januari 2025 ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders.

Het team Frontend Platform
Binnen Frontend Platform werken we aan het beheer en de continuïteit van platformen die direct bijdragen aan de digitale dienstverlening van Univé. Daarbij werken we nauw samen met DevOps‑teams, architectuur, security, leveranciers en andere platformteams. Het team richt zich onder andere op:

title: KYC & AML Operations Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Vestlane

Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm.

Du machst seit Jahren fundierte und pragmatische KYC- und AML-Arbeit und bist bereit, mehr zu verantworten, als die Karriereleiter über dir zulässt? Du möchtest mit modernen Tools und KI am Puls der Zeit in einem dynamischen Team arbeiten? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich!

“KYC/AML Services” ist Vestlanes jüngstes Team, das die operative KYC- und AML-Arbeit für Fonds- und Asset Manager-Kunden in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg erbringt. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of KYC & AML Operations zusammen und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins und hast direkten Investoren- und Kundenkontakt. Deinen Entwicklungspfad gestaltest du aktiv mit, erfolgsabhängig, statt getrieben vom nächsten Beförderungszyklus.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Investorenakten von A bis Z: Du führst KYC-Prüfungen, Risikobewertungen und Enhanced Due Diligence für Investoren und Assets in Fondsstrukturen in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg durch – mithilfe unserer KI-gestützten, digitalen Plattform.

  • Screening-Treffer bearbeiten: Du bewertest und dokumentierst Treffer aus Namens-, Sanktions- und Adverse-Media-Screening und bereitest klare, entscheidungsreife Bewertungen vor – mithilfe nativer KI-Agenten.

  • Geldwäschebeauftragte der Kunden unterstützen: Du erstellst Eskalationsvermerke und Reportings, damit Geldwäschebeauftragte und Responsables du Contrôle unserer Kunden auf solider Grundlage entscheiden können.

  • Die Maschine mitbauen: Du wirkst an Policies, Checklisten, QA-Standards und Tooling unserer Abteilung aktiv mit. Du hinterfragst kritisch, denkst Prozesse neu. Du willst KYC/AML als Geschäftschance verstehen und nicht als Last.

  • Das Produkt verbessern: Du zeigst auf, wo die Vestlane-Plattform KYC-Arbeit schneller und sicherer machen kann, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam um.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre operative KYC/AML- oder vergleichbare Erfahrung, etwa bei einer Big-4- oder Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, einem Fondsadministrator, einer KYC/AML-Beratung oder in der AML-Funktion eines Fonds oder Finanzinstituts.

  • Sichere Kenntnisse des deutschen und des Luxemburger Rechtsrahmens: GwG und BaFin-Auslegungspraxis auf der einen Seite, CSSF-Anforderungen und das Luxemburger AML-Gesetz auf der anderen. Du kennst beide Welten und weißt, wo sie sich unterscheiden. UK-Erfahrung ist ein Plus.

  • Erfahrung mit Fondsstrukturen und ihren Investoren (Institutionelle Anleger, Gesellschaften, Trusts, verschachtelte UBO-Ketten). Private-Markets-Erfahrung ist ein starkes Plus.

  • Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA) sind willkommen, keine Voraussetzung.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch. Französisch hilft in Luxemburg, ist aber keine Bedingung.

  • Präzision und Urteilsvermögen: Du dokumentierst sauber, eskalierst im richtigen Moment und willst, dass deine Arbeit jeder Prüfung standhält. Gleichzeitig bist du pragmatisch, du weißt, dass Risiko aus “Impact” und “Likelihood” besteht.

  • Du siehst dich als Unternehmer innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als reiner Checklisten-Abhaker. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust.

Benefits bei Vestlane

  • Teammitglied mit klarem Entwicklungspfad, wenn der Kundenstamm wächst

  • Direkter Kundenkontakt ab Tag eins, keine fünf Ebenen zwischen dir und den Menschen, für die deine Arbeit zählt

  • Kompetitives Gehaltspaket

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA)

  • Büro in Bonn

  • Flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen

  • Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor

Abschluss

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges Anschreiben. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat drei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Dann ein 45-minütiger Termin mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag der Abteilung, damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung.

Fragen vor der Bewerbung? Melde dich bei uns!

We own the AI features that shape how buyers and sellers experience the marketplace, from agentic workflows in the customer journey to LLM-powered tooling for our dealer network.

What we build goes into the hands of real sellers and thousands of verified dealers, usually within weeks. When it works, someone sells their car more easily. When it doesn't, we hear about it. That feedback loop is short, and it shapes how we work. We have a track record of successful deployments and a strong reputation as a result.

Over the next two years the function scales from shipping AI features to running a serious GenAI platform.

About the role

We're looking for a Lead GenAI Engineer to set the technical standard for AI work across the function, and to build the hardest parts of it themselves.

You'll own the architecture and standards for complex, product-facing GenAI work. You'll hold sign-off on the systems that carry real risk, and you'll be the person a squad comes to when they've hit something genuinely hard. This is a player-coach role: your own code sets the bar others refer back to, and you'll spend as much energy making senior engineers better as you do building.

Most of what makes a GenAI feature good sits around the model rather than in it. The prompting is rarely the hard part. Retrieval quality is, and so is the data feeding it, evaluation you can trust, sensible behaviour when things fail, and getting it live and keeping it there. The standards that matter most here are the ones that make that work repeatable across teams. We're not precious about the route you took to this kind of engineering.

In this role, you will:

  • Set the architecture standard for complex GenAI work across the function, not by mandate but by building things others learn from and want to adopt.

  • Hold sign-off on materially complex AI systems, catching architectural, safety and reliability problems before they reach production.

  • Own the shared foundations that determine feature quality across teams: retrieval patterns, evaluation infrastructure, data pipelines, and the tooling that makes good practice the easy path.

  • Build the hardest pieces of work directly, acting as the technical escalation point for the function's toughest problems.

  • Design for systems that stay up and stay affordable, covering graceful degradation, fallback behaviour, and cost and latency at production scale.

  • Develop the senior engineers around you by handing them harder problems, room to own decisions, and honest feedback.

  • Shape how we hire and review, bringing a clear and defensible view of what good looks like.

  • Bring specific, actionable industry insight into planning, explaining what a development means for our architecture rather than noting that the field moves fast.

About you

  • You've set technical direction that other engineering teams actually adopted, and you can talk about where that worked and where it didn't.

  • Strong Python, and SQL you genuinely use. A lot of this work is data work: grounding data, golden datasets, and understanding why something failed.

  • Deep, current expertise across the GenAI stack, including retrieval at scale, vector stores, agentic orchestration, multimodal work, evaluation infrastructure and fine-tuning where it earns its place.

  • You're fluent in the layer underneath: MLOps tooling, deployment and cloud infrastructure (we run on AWS and GCP), and you can tell the difference between a choice that matters and one that doesn't.

  • You design systems that survive contact with production, and you've been on the hook when they didn't.

  • A strong point of view on evaluation, including the difference between evals that catch regressions and evals that provide comfort.

  • Your direct contributions set a quality bar for the people around you.

  • You explain hard technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders without either condescending or losing the substance.

  • Self-awareness about where your knowledge runs out, and the instinct to bring in expertise early.

You could be a great fit if

  • You build with taste, preferring simple systems that work over clever ones that nearly do.

  • You use authority sparingly. You're not a blocker, but you'll stop a bad decision from shipping.

  • You get satisfaction from the unglamorous work that makes AI features actually good, not just the part that demos well.

  • You enjoy making other engineers better as much as building things yourself.

  • You've levelled people up in a way they'd recognise, whether through a talk, a review, or how you work day to day.

  • You hold a two-to-three-year view without losing touch with what's shipping this month.

BENEFITS

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway's success

  • 25 days holiday

  • Flexible working (2 days a week in our London office, with socials and snacks galore)

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • 1 paid volunteering day a year
