title: Lead Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.

Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.

Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

The Opportunity

We are at an inflection point in our journey. Our platform now serves tens of thousands of learners, demand for AI skills is accelerating, and we are investing seriously in the product and technology that will take us to the next stage of scale. This is a role for someone who wants to build the product that gets more people into transformative learning, and upskill people with critical data and AI skills faster.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Prescribe: the product that helps a prospective learner find the right programme for their skills and their employer's goals, then takes them to a confident commitment and a successful start. You will be the strategic counterpart to a Senior Engineering Manager, working alongside design and data, and closely with our go-to-market and fulfilment teams.

Growth at Multiverse means getting more people from first interest to a confident start, and it is a product problem, not a marketing problem. You will own the conversion metrics, set the strategy, run the experiments, and drive the outcomes. AI will drive much of the improvement, and you will decide where it helps.

As a Lead, you will work regularly with the most senior leaders across the company. You will report to the Single Threaded Leader for Diagnose & Prescribe and will not manage other product managers. The role is based in London, hybrid, three days a week in the office.

What You'll Own

AI-native product experiences

  • Shape new conversational, AI-first experiences that help learners and customers understand the best programme for their skills and career development.

  • Decide where AI genuinely improves a match and where it only adds noise, and build the evaluation and guardrails that keep it trustworthy in front of real users.

  • Turn learner and customer behaviour into product direction.

Prescription and eligibility

  • Own the logic that connects a learner's skills to a programme and to a customer's levy funding, where mistakes carry a real financial and regulatory cost.

  • Work with Legal, Compliance and Fulfilment to make eligibility and compliance rules configurable and explainable, so business owners can change them without a rebuild.

  • Make every recommendation something a learner and a customer can understand and challenge.

Recommendation, commitment and finalisation

  • Own the journey from recommendation to a learner committing and starting.

  • Identify high-leverage drop-off points and own the experimentation roadmap.

  • Design product interventions that adapt to learner needs and behaviour and shorten the time to a confident start.

  • Collaborate with GTM, Operations and Data teams to improve attribution and the quality of what enters the funnel.

Metrics and experimentation

  • Own conversion from prospect to committed learner, with retention and programme fit as the guardrails.

  • Champion a culture of hypothesis-led, structured experimentation.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Co-own the strategy and roadmap with your Senior Engineering Manager, with disagreement surfaced early and alignment as your shared deliverable.

  • Involve GTM, Fulfilment and Support before changes ship. They run what we build, so know their biggest pain points.

  • Author the narratives the group needs, from the press release and FAQ (PRFAQ) for your area to the sales-facing briefing for a launch.

  • Represent Prescribe in roadmap conversations with senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

The best candidates will have owned a growth-critical product before, ideally in a B2B or ideally a B2B2C context. You should have hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features and the ability to navigate complexity without losing sight of the learner.

Must-have experience:

  • Substantial experience as a PM with a track record of improving measurable growth metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, automation).

  • Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards.

  • Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments.

  • Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies.

  • Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts.

  • Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content.

  • AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies.

Strong signals we look for:

  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) in a B2B context.

  • Experience designing personalisation systems, including data models and trigger logic.

  • Previous work in a company that has scaled from hundreds to thousands of users.

  • A point of view on where AI genuinely improves outcomes versus creating noise.

  • A bonus if you've done this in a regulated environment, such as funding, eligibility or compliance-heavy products. Knowledge of UK apprenticeships and the levy is an additional plus.

How you work:

  • Solve for Customer Value: You're direct about data, even when it challenges existing priorities.

  • Drivers, Not Passengers: You think in systems, take completion seriously, and raise bad news as quickly as good.

  • Be Decisive, Even in Ambiguity: You're comfortable with ambiguity and define structure in new spaces.

  • AI to Deliver Outcomes: You have a bias for action (ship, measure, iterate) and ask "how would AI help do this?" before scoping the work.

Not for you if:

This role won't fit if you'd rather write specs than stay close to the data, the design, and the customer. It also won't fit if you see AI as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a product team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on a product that genuinely changes economic trajectories.

  • A team that takes craft seriously and holds a high bar.

  • Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence over product direction.

  • A place in a company rebuilding itself as product-powered and AI-native, where you help define the result rather than inherit it.

Benefits

  • Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days).

  • Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub.

  • Equity for all: we believe that when Multiverse wins, we all win, which is why every permanent employee receives share options.

  • Financial security: life insurance at 3x salary, a workplace pension with 4% contribution from us, Cycle to Work and a Tech Scheme.

  • Family support: enhanced maternity and paternity leave, adoption and shared parental leave, paid leave after pregnancy loss, and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office - except for Coaches & Instructors who come into the office 1 day per month. Plus 10 days a year to work from anywhere.

  • Work perks: quarterly team socials, company-wide events, happy hours, lunch delivered to the office once a week, fully stocked snack bar and a drinks fridge!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

title: Legal Engineer Manager, Germany
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Munich. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects.

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Legal Engineers, setting clear performance expectations and building a high-trust, high-output team culture

  • Own the quality and consistency of Harvey's pre-sales legal engineering function, ensuring demos, discovery conversations, and deal support are delivered to the highest standard

  • Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities

  • Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to ensure the team's field insights are feeding into positioning, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.


What You Have

  • Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment

  • Must have prior experience managing a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance

  • Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions

title: Machine Learning Engineer II - Growth & Personalisation
descriptionHtml:

What You'll Need to Thrive

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

title: Machine Learning Engineer

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. title: Machine Learning Engineer, Pre-training
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on Pre-training, you will own the engineering behind our next open foundation model, Boltz-3: the data, training and evaluation systems that let us train it at scale and release it with state-of-the-art structure prediction. Every Boltz model starts here, and the open release is what 100,000+ scientists build on.

You will work closely with the Pre-training team's research scientists, Research Engineering, who own training speed and cluster tooling, our Post-training team, and Platform Engineering.

This role is ideal for an engineer who wants to build the systems behind a frontier open model and see it used across biotech and academia.

What you'll do

  • Build and scale the data pipelines behind pre-training: ingesting, filtering, clustering and versioning large structural and sequence datasets.

  • Own the pre-training codebase and large training runs with research scientists, keeping experiments reproducible and runs healthy.

  • Build the evaluation and benchmark suites that show state-of-the-art antibody–antigen and small-molecule structure prediction.

  • Build inference infrastructure for large sampling runs, to measure how performance scales with inference-time compute.

  • Get each model ready for open-source release: packaging, documentation, inference code and community feedback that flows back to the team.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Senior or Staff-level experience building ML systems for large-scale training, with strong Python and PyTorch.

  • Experience with distributed training and data processing on multi-node GPU clusters.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean, tested, maintainable code and reproducible experiments.

  • A track record of shipping models or ML infrastructure that others relied on, such as a released model, a widely used codebase or a production system.

  • Close collaboration with research scientists, and enough ML intuition to judge how engineering choices affect results.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with structure prediction, protein or molecular data, or diffusion models.

  • Experience maintaining open-source ML projects; early-stage startup experience.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or open-source contributions.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Build the systems behind open foundation models used by 100,000+ scientists.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Technical interview

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us at [email] and we'll make it work.

title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering - Munich
descriptionHtml:
About the team
OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team partners with our customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We embed with users to solve high-leverage problems, move fast from prototype to deployment, and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of field delivery and internal development, working closely with Product, Research, and Go-To-Market (GTM).

About the role
As a foundational FDE manager, you’ll lead FDE through high-stakes, ambiguous customer deployments and own technical and business value outcomes end to end. You’ll grow a team that can operate under pressure and help OpenAI learn from the field.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Research, Sales, and GTM to ensure fieldwork informs roadmap priorities, drives new exploration, and supports safe deployment at scale. Your decisions will influence how OpenAI is trusted by the customers closest to our deployment work. Your success will be measured by how consistently your team ships, how clearly you deliver signal to Research and Product, and how durable your team and delivery model prove to be.

This role is based in Munich. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. This role also will require travel up to 25%.

In this role you will

  • Lead and grow a team of FDE delivering production systems with frontier models

  • Own end-to-end delivery outcomes through clarity, speed, tight coordination, and technical quality

  • Codify what works into tools, playbooks, and roadmap inputs that create leverage for both OpenAI and our wider developer community

  • Notice early indicators and raise them with urgency, whether in product behavior, customer environments, or delivery practices

  • Use judgement to distinguish what requires action and what does not

  • Set a high bar for FDE performance and support each person’s growth through direct, actionable feedback

  • Define how we staff and support field teams that can scale without added complexity

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Bring 8+ years of engineering or technical delivery experience, including 2+ years managing high-performing FDE or customer-facing engineers

  • Have led high-pressure technical projects from prototype to production

  • Write and review production-grade code across frontend and backend using Javascript or Python

  • Simplify complex work and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

  • Elevate team performance through clarity, not process

  • Operate with urgency in ambiguous or evolving environments

  • Translate field experience into sharp, actionable feedback for Product and Research

  • Build deep trust with your team by modeling calm, focus, and judgment when it matters most

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Manager Strategy & Operations - Success Department (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

---------

Au sein du département Partner Success (100+ collaborateurs), nous ne déployons pas seulement un logiciel ; nous orchestrons la transformation digitale d'une profession entière.

Notre mission est critique : sécuriser des migrations de données sensibles, garantir l'interopérabilité des systèmes et accompagner le changement humain.

Former, conseiller, sécuriser : nous sommes le moteur de la réussite de nos clients et les architectes de la modernisation de leur métier.

Pour accompagner l'expansion du département Partner Success, nous recrutons un Manager Strategy & Operations.

Vous êtes le garant de l'architecture opérationnelle de l'entreprise et agissez comme un vecteur de performance durable. À l'interface de la vision stratégique et de l'excellence d'exécution, vous concevez, pilotez et optimisez les systèmes et processus qui permettent à notre organisation de scaler avec agilité.

Le candidat idéal a vu le cycle complet du management (faire le job pour prouver le besoin > recruter > onboarder > développement des talents > départ > remplacement) et a idéalement déjà managé des managers. Il doit être capable de co-construire la direction stratégique de l'équipe Partner Success (go to market, organisation interne) tout en sachant gérer ses propres projets et entrer dans le détail.

1. Management d’équipe et pilotage de l’activité.

  • Management direct : Vous pilotez une équipe de 5 collaborateurs (Strategy & Ops Analysts) ; vous fixez et suivez les objectifs individuels, accompagnez leur montée en compétences et leur développement en collaboration avec notre HRBP.
    Nous prévoyons une croissance de cette équipe.

  • Contrôle qualité et challenge : Vous revoyez et challengez les livrables de l'équipe (analyses, workflows, outils) pour garantir leur pertinence, leur rigueur et leur impact.

  • Pilotage de la roadmap : Vous définissez et maintenez la feuille de route du pôle Strategy & Ops en cohérence avec les priorités globales du département Partner Success.

  • Arbitrage et priorisation : Vous déterminez l'ordre de priorité des chantiers, arbitrez les ressources et cadrez précisément le scope d’intervention de l’équipe pour maximiser l'impact business.

2. Architecture opérationnelle.

  • Garantie de l'architecture interne : Vous êtes responsable de la conception et de la cohérence de l'architecture des processus au sein du département. Vous veillez à ce que chaque étape du parcours collaborateur soit documentée, logique et efficace, en phase avec les besoins des utilisateurs finaux.

  • Fluidité de la collaboration : Vous agissez comme le liant entre les différentes équipes (Sales, Produit, Partner Success). Vous concevez des interfaces de travail claires pour assurer une collaboration sans friction.

  • Adoption et compréhension : Au-delà de la création, vous vous assurez de la bonne compréhension et de l'appropriation des processus par l'ensemble des collaborateurs. Vous mettez en place les mécanismes de formation et de feedback nécessaires.

  • Gouvernance de la Stack : En collaboration avec l’équipe CRM, vous supervisez l'évolution de la stack logicielle du département (notamment Salesforce) afin de répondre aux besoins métiers tout en garantissant l'intégrité des systèmes.

  • Scalabilité : Vous concevez des solutions d'automatisation permettant d'absorber la croissance du volume de cabinets sans perte de qualité.

3. Pilotage de la performance et aide à la décision.

  • Partenariat stratégique et bras droit : Vous agissez comme le bras droit du Directeur Partner Success. Vous l'accompagnez dans sa prise de recul en apportant un regard analytique et critique sur l'activité globale du département.

  • Planification et Forecasting : Vous contribuez à la construction des modèles de prévision, au pilotage du forecast de l'activité, à l’anticipation des besoins de staffing à court et moyen terme pour garantir l'adéquation entre la charge de travail et les ressources.

  • Recommandations stratégiques : Au-delà du constat, vous émettez des recommandations concrètes sur la stratégie du département (évolution du modèle de service, priorités d'investissement, leviers de productivité) fondées sur vos analyses de données.

  • Pilotage de la performance : En lien avec les équipes Data, vous fiabilisez les KPIs critiques et produisez les tableaux de bord permettant un pilotage proactif du département.

4. Interface transverse et coordination globale.

  • Point d'entrée du département : Vous agissez comme l'interlocuteur privilégié pour les autres départements (Produit, Sales, Marketing, Care). Vous centralisez les sollicitations externes, évaluez leur faisabilité et assurez leur intégration cohérente dans la roadmap du Partner Success.

  • Coordination des ressources transverses : Vous orchestrez la contribution des équipes transverses fonctionnelles (Data, CRM/Salesforce). Vous influez sur leur roadmap respective pour garantir l'alignement de leurs chantiers avec les besoins du Partner Success.

  • Cadrage et anticipation des impacts : Avant le lancement de toute initiative, vous menez une analyse d'impact approfondie. Vous identifiez les dépendances critiques (techniques, humaines, temporelles) et déterminez le dimensionnement (sizing) nécessaire pour garantir la réussite du projet sans déstabiliser l'organisation existante.

  • Fluidification des échanges : Vous êtes garant de la circulation de l'information entre toutes les parties prenantes de l'organisation. Vous identifiez les points de friction entre départements et proposez des solutions pour fluidifier les workflows de bout en bout.

🥇 Profil recherché

Formation et Expérience :

  • Formation : Master (Bac+5) en gestion, ingénierie ou école de commerce.

  • Expérience : minimum 8/10 ans d'expérience dans dans des fonctions d'Opérations, de Conseil ou de gestion de projets complexes. Une expérience en scale up ou dans une organisation de 1000+ personnes qui a connu une phase de forte croissance est un plus.

  • Langues : Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais (contexte international).

Compétences Managériales & Leadership :

  • People Management : Aptitude démontrée à l'encadrement d'équipe et à l'accompagnement du changement sur un minimum de 2 ans.

  • Fédération : Expérience dans le pilotage d'équipes transverses et fonctionnelles sans lien hiérarchique direct.

Expertise Technique & Opérationnelle :

  • Systèmes : Maîtrise approfondie des environnements CRM/ERP (Salesforce, etc.) et de l'automatisation de workflows.

  • Gestion de projets longs : Succès prouvés sur des déploiements d'envergure (nouvel outil, structuration d'équipe, migration logicielle).

  • Rigueur méthodologique : Capacité à concevoir des architectures de processus robustes et documentées.

  • Analyse de données : Capacité à piloter la performance via des KPIs structurants.

  • Forecasting : Aptitude à modéliser des prévisions d'activité et des plans de staffing.

Mindset & Posture :

  • Problem Solver : Mentalité orientée vers la résolution de problèmes complexes avec pragmatisme.

  • Vision long terme : Capacité à bâtir des systèmes scalables sur le long terme, tout en sachant déployer des solutions tactiques (workarounds) adaptées aux ressources et à l'urgence du contexte de croissance.

  • Agilité opérationnelle : Capacité à alterner entre la réflexion stratégique et l'exécution concrète sur le terrain ("hands-on").

------

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. title: Manufacturing Systems Support & Data Lead
descriptionHtml:
Manufacturing Systems Support & Data Lead

This is a home-based role with regular travel across our manufacturing sites, including extended periods supporting key projects where required.

Join our snack-loving team
We’re looking for a Manufacturing Systems Support & Data Lead to join us at KP Snacks. If you’re ready to bring your ideas to the table, grow your skills and be part of a team that values what makes you, you – this could be your next big move.

Who are we?
We’re KP Snacks, part of the Intersnack family. Across more than 30 countries, over 15,000 of us work together to make the snacks people love – from Hula Hoops to McCoy’s. In the UK, we’re a team of around 2,400 colleagues, based across seven sites and our Slough HQ. We’re proud of our close-knit culture, where we speak up, celebrate differences and push boundaries together.

About the role

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in KP Snacks’ digital manufacturing journey. As our Systems Support & Data Lead, you’ll be responsible for supporting, developing and improving the manufacturing systems and data platforms that help our sites operate effectively.

Working across Engineering, Operations, Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT), you’ll act as the link between technology and operational performance. You'll lead the governance and continuous improvement of systems including Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Energy Monitoring Systems, Litmus Edge and reporting platforms, ensuring data is trusted, accessible and used to drive better decision making.

While the role includes supporting manufacturing systems across our sites, a significant focus will be on digital transformation projects, data analytics, machine optimisation and emerging technologies, including AI and machine learning. You'll also play an important role in supporting major business initiatives and helping shape the future of manufacturing technology across KP Snacks.

What’s in it for you?
We believe in rewarding our colleagues and helping them thrive. Here’s a flavour of what we offer:

  • Competitive annual salary, annual salary review and annual bonus opportunity (target 5%)

  • Business needs car allowance

  • KP Pension Plan with up to 7% matched contributions

  • 25 days holiday, with the option to buy up to five additional days, plus additional holiday after five years’ service

  • Comprehensive healthcare including Single Cover Private Healthcare, Health Cash Plan, Digital GP and Employee Assistance Programme

  • Electric Vehicle Car Scheme, supporting more sustainable and cost-effective travel

  • KP4ME benefits platform with discounts, cashback and wellbeing support

  • Enhanced family-friendly policies to support colleagues at every stage of life

What will you be doing?

  • Leading manufacturing systems support and governance
    Providing technical ownership of key manufacturing systems, ensuring they remain reliable, secure, standardised and aligned to business needs

  • Driving data-led performance improvement
    Developing dashboards, reporting solutions and performance metrics that improve operational visibility, support decision making and unlock opportunities for continuous improvement

  • Supporting digital transformation projects
    Leading and supporting projects focused on manufacturing systems, digitisation, machine optimisation and emerging technologies, helping KP Snacks maximise the value of its technology investments

  • Building strong partnerships across the business
    Working closely with Engineering, Operations, OT, IT and external partners to deliver improvements, resolve complex issues and ensure manufacturing requirements are represented in key projects

  • Developing capability and future ways of working
    Coaching site-based systems contacts, driving standardisation across sites and supporting the adoption of AI, machine learning and advanced analytics solutions


We’d love to hear from you if you can bring:

  • Manufacturing systems experience
    Experience supporting Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) or similar manufacturing technologies within an FMCG, manufacturing or industrial environment

  • Strong data and analytics capability
    The ability to analyse operational data, create meaningful insights and use reporting tools such as Power BI to support business performance

  • Experience delivering technology improvements
    A track record of identifying and implementing system enhancements, automation solutions or digital initiatives that deliver measurable business value

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills
    The ability to build relationships and influence colleagues across Engineering, Operations, OT, IT and external suppliers

  • A passion for innovation and continuous improvement
    An interest in emerging technologies including AI, machine learning and Industry 4.0, combined with a desire to improve the way manufacturing systems support business performance

  • Flexibility to travel across our sites
    A willingness to spend time at different KP Snacks locations to support projects, system implementations and continuous improvement initiatives

Our purpose
At KP Snacks, we're passionate about creating happy snacking moments through our great tasting snacks and iconic brands. Every day, millions of people enjoy our products, including Hula Hoops, McCoy's, KP Nuts, Tyrrells, Skips, POM-BEAR and Butterkist, making us one of the UK's leading snack manufacturers.

For decades, we've been delighting consumers by combining well-loved favourites with exciting innovations that reflect changing tastes and expectations. We're equally passionate about our people and committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow, develop and make a real impact.

As part of the Intersnack Group, one of the world's leading snack manufacturers, we combine global expertise with a shared commitment to creating happy snacking moments every day.

We’re committed to inclusion
We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. If you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you – your unique perspective could be just what we need. And if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you, just let us know.

title: Marketing Graduate at United Media
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Marketing Graduate.

About us

SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.

SetSales is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. 

What we offer you

As our Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.
  • Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.
  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - (Nordics)
descriptionHtml:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.

Bitwarden is expanding its sales footprint and is looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive. This position is open to candidates currently residing within the UK.

We are seeking an energetic and motivated sales professional with strong sales skills and channel experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 4-8 years of new account or business development experience with a proven track record of engaging the Partner ecosystem to drive success. In your role, you will be responsible for achieving an assigned quota number while also managing lead flow, closing deals, recruiting partners and developing geographical go to market plans.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Predominant focus on closing business in companies with between 51 and 1000 employees

  • Focus on activities and opportunities delivering short term and long-term revenue
  • Effective and regular networking to attract and influence Partner sales and grow our Partner relationships
  • Use your existing relationships to recruit and onboarding new partners, get them to agree to engage in proactive demand generation activities
  • Maintain a regional partner plan mapping partner strengths (customer relationships, vertical focus, technology specialty) to accounts and target opportunities
  • Track and manage lead flow both inbound and outbound between partners and the Bitwarden Sales team. Proactively communicate with Bitwarden sales leaders on the channel pipeline and forecast
  • Work closely with marketing to deliver marketing events/programs/campaigns that create interest and awareness among partners' customers. Build and execute joint partner business plans with measurable success
  • Set financial goals for focus partners and ensure goals achievement

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • 4-8 years of outside high-tech IT sales experience. IT security product experience is desirable but not mandatory
  • Experience at a startup or pre $100M revenue company is desirable
  • A proven track-record of driving continued partner growth and revenue
  • Knowledge and strong relationships with SMB and SME focused resellers and MSP partners within a multistate region will be necessary

  • Motivated and focused self-starter with strong leadership skills who can multitask, work independently or within a team

  • Must demonstrate a consistent track record of achieving annual quota targets while providing specific details on key customer wins
  • Possesses a competitive attitude, strong work ethic and thrives in a fast pace, high growth and matrixed organizational environment
  • Positive history of collaborative selling
  • Must be a proficient user of CRM tools and other Gsuite and MS Office tools

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

  • Screening call with our Recruiting Manager
  • Interview with our Head of Sales Enablement
  • AE Roleplay Interview
  • Final Interview with our CEO

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations.

title: Mitarbeiter im Kundenservice (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Für viele Mandant:innen bist du der Mensch, der endlich Klarheit bringt. Damit du dich voll darauf konzentrieren kannst, bekommst du bei uns digitale Tools, ein Team ohne Ellenbogen und ein Umfeld ohne Callcenter-Druck.

  • Nur eingehende Anfragen
    Du rufst niemanden unaufgefordert an und verschickst keine ungefragten E-Mails. Du betreust ausschließlich Menschen, die sich selbst bei uns gemeldet haben und Hilfe suchen.
  • Kein Callcenter-Feeling
    Bei uns gibt es keine Fließbandgespräche, keine starren Skripte und kein anonymes Großraumbüro. Du arbeitest in einem überschaubaren Team mit eigenem Arbeitsplatz und kurzen Wegen, auch zur Geschäftsführung.
  • Digitale Tools statt Zettelwirtschaft
    Wir arbeiten digital und mit System, zum Beispiel mit HubSpot. Keine Excel-Listen und keine Zettel, sondern durchdachte Prozesse, die dir die Arbeit erleichtern.
  • Faires Gehalt & Sicherheit
    Wir schätzen deine Arbeit mit einer fairen, guten Bezahlung und geben dir mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag eine langfristige Perspektive.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Du unterstützt Menschen dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Am Ende des Tages weißt du, dass du vielen eine Sorge abgenommen hast.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und ein leistungsstarker Laptop, egal ob MacBook oder Windows.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Zentrale Lage, sehr gute ÖPNV-Anbindung und Mitarbeiterparkplätze direkt um die Ecke. Dazu ein Innenhof für die Pause und ein eigener Fitnessraum im Haus, kostenlos und jederzeit zugänglich.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Ellenbogenmentalität gibt es bei uns nicht, dafür echte Wertschätzung im Alltag und Events wie Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder Halloween-Sause. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin mit Massagen und kleinen Auszeiten für Entspannung.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Mitarbeiter im Kundenservice (w/m/d) bist du für viele Mandant:innen die erste Stimme von Migrando. Du beantwortest Fragen, gibst Orientierung und sorgst dafür, dass sich niemand mit seinem Anliegen allein gelassen fühlt.

  • Erste Anlaufstelle über alle Kanäle
    Ob Telefon, Ticketsystem oder Social Media: Du hilfst schnell und freundlich weiter, egal wo die Anfrage reinkommt.
  • Fragen rund um die Einbürgerung beantworten
    Du gibst Auskunft zu unseren Leistungen und erklärst, wie der Weg zum deutschen Pass bei uns abläuft.
  • Statusauskünfte zum Verfahren
    Du schaust im System nach, wo ein Vorgang gerade steht, und erklärst den nächsten Schritt so, dass ihn auch jemand ohne Fachwissen versteht.
  • Zuhören und verständlich erklären
    Viele unserer Mandant:innen lernen gerade erst Deutsch. Du hörst nicht nur, was gefragt wird, sondern erkennst, was dahintersteckt, findest Worte, die ankommen, und erklärst auch gern ein zweites Mal.
  • Termine und Rückrufe
    Du stimmst Rückrufe und Gesprächstermine ab und behältst im Blick, wer wann eine Rückmeldung erwartet.
  • Nachforderung fehlender Unterlagen
    Du erinnerst freundlich an offene Dokumente und erklärst, warum sie gebraucht werden.
  • Saubere Dokumentation
    Du hältst fest, was besprochen wurde, inklusive Rückmeldungen, Beschwerden und Lösungen. So haben alle Kolleg:innen den gleichen Stand.
  • Schnittstelle zur Sachbearbeitung und zum Anwaltsteam
    Wenn eine Frage tiefer geht, leitest du sie mit dem nötigen Kontext weiter und sorgst dafür, dass niemand zweimal dasselbe erzählen muss.
  • Umgang mit Beschwerden und Unmut
    Wenn jemand ungeduldig oder enttäuscht ist, bleibst du ruhig, nimmst das Anliegen ernst und findest gemeinsam eine Lösung.
  • Muster erkennen und Verbesserungen anstoßen
    Wenn dieselbe Frage ständig kommt, sagst du Bescheid. Daraus bauen wir bessere Infos, damit das Problem gar nicht erst entsteht.

Dein Profil

Bei uns zählen keine Abschlüsse oder Zertifikate, sondern wie du mit Menschen umgehst und wie du arbeitest. Rechtliche Vorkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, die Hintergründe zur Einbürgerung und unsere Systeme lernst du in der Einarbeitung kennen.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Menschen
    Du hast schon in einem Job mit viel direktem Kontakt zu Menschen gearbeitet, ob im Kundenservice, im Einzelhandel, in der Gastronomie, im Hotel oder in der Beratung, und weißt, wie es ist, den ganzen Tag im Gespräch zu sein.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
    Deutsch ist dein tägliches Arbeitswerkzeug, am Telefon wie schriftlich. Alle weiteren Sprachen sind ein echtes Plus.
  • Klare, einfache Kommunikation
    Du kannst komplizierte Sachverhalte so erklären, dass sie auch ohne Vorwissen verständlich sind.
  • Empathie und interkulturelle Offenheit
    Du arbeitest gern mit Menschen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Ländern und Lebenslagen und begegnest allen auf Augenhöhe.
  • Geduld und Ruhe
    Manche Fragen kommen zum dritten Mal, und manchmal ist jemand verärgert. Für dich ist das kein Problem: Du bleibst sachlich, freundlich und gelassen.
  • Zuverlässigkeit und Struktur
    Du behältst den Überblick, auch wenn viele Anfragen gleichzeitig reinkommen, vergisst keine Rückmeldung und dokumentierst sorgfältig, weil davon die Arbeit deiner Kolleg:innen abhängt.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit dem PC
    E-Mail, Telefon und digitale Tools sind für dich Alltag. Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen oder CRM-Systemen wie HubSpot ist ein Plus.
  • Diskretion
    Du gehst mit sensiblen Daten verantwortungsvoll um. Verschwiegenheit ist für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Kundenorientierung und Teamgeist
    Du willst den Menschen am Telefon wirklich helfen und arbeitest gleichzeitig gern mit deinen Kolleg:innen zusammen.

title: Office Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

Overview

We're looking for someone hungry to learn to join us as our Office Manager!

You'll get an inside look at how a high-performing tech startup operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth startup moving and who have a passion for making things run smoothly around them.

Your day-to-day will involve hands-on support across logistics, workflows (onboarding, offboarding, IT), office administration and socials, events and internal operations. Beyond this, you'll have the opportunity to assist with projects wherever an extra set of capable hands is needed, including exposure to finance and other internal teams. Along the way, you’ll gain practical insight into startup life and how different functions collaborate with one another.

This is a rare opportunity to learn first-hand from a uniquely high-performing team as we scale a category-defining tech startup at speed.

What You Can Expect

  • Operational Cadence: You’ll help handle the admin, workflows and logistics that free up our leaders to focus and enable the entire business to move faster. You'll be part of running our onboarding, offboarding, contracting, scheduling, and administrative workflows - so being good with technology is a big plus!

  • Beating heart of keeping the office culture running: you will help maintain our office environment (weekly food orders, office moves and fit-outs, managing our service providers for cleaning and reconfiguration) and plan our regular London socials and events.

  • Wide exposure: You'll assist with administrative projects across all of Operations, whether it's helping out with month-end bookkeeping or regular payment runs, or helping the sales team plan their quarterly kick-offs.

  • Learn by doing: Get involved in a range of tasks - help with onboarding, audits, events, socials, merch and scheduling. Where we have our company monthly meetings, you will also get exposure to IT and AV to make our hybrid events a great experience.

  • Momentum: You’ll get a front row seat to what it's like to scale a company just as we enter a phase of high growth, with the systems, challenges, and excitement that come with it.

About you

We’re looking for someone curious, proactive, and ready to roll up their sleeves. You might be a recent grad, early in your career or pivoting from a different field - what matters is your energy, problem-solving mindset, organisational skills, and desire to learn.

  • You’re organised, resourceful, and detail oriented: you like systems, details, and getting things done well. you get a lot of satisfaction from knowing that all the I's are dotted and the T's are crossed. you take satisfaction from knowing that things are ordered and up-to-date

  • You’re technical for a non-technical person: you you can figure out how to do stuff with new tech tools pretty easily

  • You’re exceptional at time management: you can comfortably manage changing priorities and are able to switch gears with ease and aren't thrown off by people making regular requests at the last minute

  • You’re humble: we're seldom the stars of the show in operations, and parts of the job are not as glamorous! You take satisfaction in a job well done without needing to feel you own the limelight

  • You’re good with people: you’re just as comfortable chatting to a senior leader as you are with a new hire - you'll be one of the first people that a lot of our new joiners meet.

  • You're excited about startups: not just as a job, but as an environment where you can learn quickly, contribute meaningfully, and build the kind of hands-on operational expertise that only comes from being at the centre of a fast-growing company.. You adapt quickly, handle ambiguity, and keep things moving forward.

  • You're based in London or nearby: this is an in-office role in Victoria.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Opto-Mechanical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

We are looking for an Opto-mechanical Engineer to join our Manufacturing team and play a critical role in the design, integration, and manufacturing of opto-mechanical systems for our photonic products. This role will sit at the intersection of mechanical design, optics, and manufacturing, helping us translate optical designs into robust, manufacturable hardware.

You will take ownership of designing and validating opto-mechanical assemblies, including mounts, and alignment structures for optical and photonic components. You will work closely with Hardware, and manufacturing engineering teams as well as vendors from across the world to ensure designs are optically sound, mechanically robust, and ready for scalable production.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role suited to someone comfortable moving between CAD design, optical modelling, and physical prototyping and testing. You will be expected to troubleshoot mechanical and optical integration issues, iterate on designs quickly, and help establish repeatable, production-ready opto-mechanical solutions. Fresh graduates with strong relevant project, internship, or academic experience are welcome to apply.

What you'll be doing

  • Design opto-mechanical components and assemblies (mounts, housings, brackets, alignment stages) using SolidWorks

  • Model and analyse optical systems and tolerances using Zemax

  • Translate optical design requirements into manufacturable mechanical designs

  • Perform tolerance analysis to ensure optical alignment and performance across manufacturing variation

  • Build and test prototypes to validate opto-mechanical designs against optical performance targets

  • Support fibre-to-chip and free-space alignment integration for photonic assemblies

  • Work closely with manufacturing team and vendors to ensure designs are suitable for production and assembly

  • Investigate and resolve mechanical or thermal issues affecting optical performance (e.g. misalignment, drift, stress-induced effects)

  • Create and maintain design documentation, drawings, and version-controlled files

  • Collaborate with suppliers on machining, coatings, and assembly processes

  • Support root cause analysis for opto-mechanical failures identified in test or field use

What we're looking for

  • Proficiency in SolidWorks for mechanical design and drafting (2+ years of hands-on experience)

  • Experience with Zemax or similar optical design/simulation software (2+ years of hands-on experience)

  • Solid understanding of optics fundamentals (alignment, tolerances, beam propagation, focusing)

  • Some industrial, internship, or substantial project experience in opto-mechanical, mechanical, or optical engineering

  • Ability to perform tolerance stack-up analysis for optical and mechanical systems

  • Comfortable working hands-on in laboratory and prototyping environments (hands-on lab /manufacturing experience)

  • Strong troubleshooting mindset with a practical, iterative approach to engineering

  • Ability to communicate clearly with cross-functional engineering teams

  • Able to travel to vendor sites to transfer knowledge and troubleshoot problems.

Even better if you have

  • Experience with photonic or semiconductor packaging and assembly

  • Familiarity with fibre alignment, free-space optics, or laser-based systems

  • Experience with thermal or structural analysis (FEA) as it relates to optical performance

  • Exposure to manufacturing or production environments

  • Understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing, and its application to precision optical assemblies

  • Familiarity with material selection for optical and thermal stability

We are open to candidates from Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or related technical disciplines. Fresh graduates with strong relevant experience through projects, internships, or research are encouraged to apply.

This is an opportunity to work on genuinely challenging problems across optics, mechanics, and manufacturing, with direct influence on how advanced AI hardware is designed and built.

You will also have access to cutting-edge equipment, collaborative engineering teams, and the chance to help shape opto-mechanical design capability from the ground up.
