title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Partner Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:

You will build the relationships that make those partners successful, hold their delivery to a high standard, and stay accountable for the AI value customers realise from their work. You will support the sale of services routed to the channel, drive the retention of your partners' managed services engagements, and act as the primary connection between monday.com and the organisations delivering at scale on our behalf.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our London office.

Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of delivery partners and the professional services and managed services engagements running inside it, ensuring successful outcomes through high-value, on-time, and on-budget delivery.

  • Drive AI value realisation across your portfolio, tracking realised consumption against the plan agreed at sale and working with partner delivery teams where adoption gaps or unbuilt workflows hold it back.

  • Stay accountable for the retention of the ongoing services your partners deliver, monitoring engagement health and intervening with the partner or the customer where value is going unrealised.

  • Partner with Account Owners to support the sale of services routed to the partner channel, matching scope to a partner with the right capability and capacity to deliver it.

  • Ensure partners adopt monday.com best practices and delivery methodologies within their engagements, using performance data to help them meet the same standard as work delivered internally.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with monday.com delivery partners to support successful project outcomes and the growth of the partner service practices.

  • Carry platform and roadmap context into your partners' practices, and bring the feedback their practice leads and delivery teams surface in the field back to Product.

  • Manage the operational machinery behind partner-delivered work, covering the staffing and procurement queue, partner capacity, assignment, and billing.

  • Identify the next outcome opportunity inside your portfolio and drive the additional services needed to deliver it, surfacing expansion and risk signals to the Account Owner.

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

The Direct Acquisition team at iwoca acquires customers profitably across paid and organic channels. Creative is the core growth lever for the channel. You'll work closely with a tight group of collaborators:

  • Paid Social Channel Lead: Sets strategy and manages performance.

We need someone genuinely obsessed with what makes people stop scrolling, who understands social platforms intuitively because they live on them, and can translate that into a disciplined creative operation that delivers results.

  • Develop the creative roadmap for paid social, working with the channel owners to translate performance data, testing insights, and cultural trends into a pipeline of concepts across video, static, UGC, partnership ads, and emerging formats.

Testing, Insights and Iteration

  • Work with the channel owners to build a creative testing framework connecting platform metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and landing page conversion to commercial outcomes.

title: Ph.D. Researcher. Knowledge Discovery: From Unstructured Data to Shared Cognitive Maps
descriptionHtml:
Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology

About the Position

The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).

This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks.

Key objectives include:

  • Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps.
  • Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge.
  • Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning.
  • Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction.

The overarching goal is to create systems that enable transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge, supporting both individual users and collaborative communities.

Applicant Profile

Mandatory requirements:

  • Holding recognized MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related discipline.
  • Students holding BSc degree and exhibiting outstanding performance and extraordinary potential can apply for fast-track PhD.
  • Strong mathematical background supported with experience in defining and developing knowledge-graph or information retrieval systems.
  • Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and their applications.
  • A track record of publications in AI/ML or related areas.
  • Documented experience in practical research work.
  • Strong skills in academic English writing (peer-reviewed papers, reports, or equivalent).

Funding & Appointment Terms

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

  • Monthly stipend of €1,650
  • Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)
  • Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month
  • Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)

Application Details

  • Expected start date: September, 2026

Application package must include: 

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV);
  • Academic transcripts ;

title: Photonics Design Engineer - III/V Components
descriptionHtml:
About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards deployment, you’ll have real ownership of your area and work alongside a highly technical team on a hard problem in AI infrastructure.

The role

You’ll join a multi-disciplinary research team in the UK to contribute to the development of III-V active components for integration with silicon photonics. You will help take devices from epitaxial stack and device design through fabrication with external partners, to characterisation, reliability and qualification.

What you’ll be doing

  • Contribute to the design and modelling of III-V active devices, including epitaxial layer structure, gain and power modelling, optical mode design, and electrical and thermal design

  • Help define device specifications for your area, translating system requirements into device design and integration targets

  • Contribute to mask design and tape-outs, including GDS layouts, test structures and design-of-experiment splits

  • Support fabrication runs with external epitaxy and foundry partners: follow process flows, review process and in-line data, and help resolve yield issues as the technology scales

  • Contribute to the characterisation strategy at wafer, chip and integrated-PIC level, including building and automating test setups

  • Analyse test data, correlate measured performance with design and process variations, and support design iterations to close performance gaps

  • Work with packaging and reliability engineers on burn-in, accelerated ageing, failure analysis and qualification

  • Share knowledge with colleagues and support the onboarding of new team members as the team grows

Essential requirements

  • PhD in physics, photonics, electrical engineering, optical engineering or a related subject with 2+ years’ relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 4+ years’ relevant experience, including at least 2 years’ hands-on development of III-V optical amplifiers or semiconductor lasers, preferably in industry

  • Experience contributing to taking III-V devices from concept through design, fabrication and test, ideally including exposure to qualification

  • Good understanding of semiconductor laser and amplifier physics: optical gain, carrier dynamics, quantum-well design, noise, gain saturation and nonlinearities, thermal effects and polarisation dependence

  • Hands-on knowledge of III-V epitaxy and fabrication processes (e.g. MOCVD/MBE growth, lithography, etching, passivation, metallisation, facet/AR coating), and experience working with external foundries

  • Experience characterising amplifiers or lasers, including optical spectrum analysis, gain and noise measurement, wafer-level probing, temperature-controlled testing and test automation

  • Experience with simulation and layout tools for photonic devices, such as Lumerical, Photon Design, Crosslight, RSoft, COMSOL, KLayout, L-Edit or Cadence Virtuoso

  • Ability to work effectively with colleagues across design, process, test and packaging functions

  • Excellent communication skills, critical thinking, attention to detail and self-motivation

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating III-V active devices with silicon photonics, including coupling design between III-V and silicon waveguides

  • Experience mentoring or supervising junior engineers or students

  • Experience with reliability testing and failure analysis of III-V devices

  • Experience developing PDK building blocks or compact models for active devices

  • Programming experience (Python, MATLAB or C++) for simulation, test automation and data analysis

  • Knowledge of photonic packaging, including fibre coupling, thermal design and TEC control

  • A track record of high-quality patents and research papers

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR: This is not a regular engineering job. We're looking for exceptional builders who help us design and ship systems that define how the world's largest companies operate in the age of AI.

WHY CONDUCT
The world's largest companies are slowed down by the software they run on. We're building the AI operating system that absorbs IT complexity and unlocks entirely new levels of speed, output, and ambition. We believe this is a generation-defining mission.

Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $60M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work at Conduct - we value ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we will make sure this is the place you do yours too.

WHO WE HIRE
We are relentless builders, and we're looking for people who share that obsession with shipping to customers.

As our founding Platform Engineer, your role is to build and scale a reliable, resilient, observable, performant and secure platform that makes our product engineers faster. We care about outcomes: you should be excited by building the foundations that let us ship a killer product fast, not by hard infrastructure problems for their own sake (though you'll have plenty of those).

You'll stand out if you:

  • Have owned infrastructure - networks, databases, deployments - through a period of real scale at a fast-growing startup or scale-up.

  • Treat infrastructure as code by default (Terraform or similar) and stay on top of the latest platform tooling

  • Simple, well-reasoned system design. Solutions that solve the problem and ship fast, rather than the perfect setup on a six-month roadmap

  • Have informed, strong opinions on the big calls - like whether to stay on Postgres or move to something like Supabase or PlanetScale

  • Understand how AI changes infrastructure - LLM gateways, caching, flaky providers, agent sandboxes, durable execution. You don't need to be an AI researcher, but you've played with the tools and have a point of view

  • Build clean abstractions and paved paths that other engineers actually want to use

We look for exceptional talent, regardless where you spike. Experience level matters less than the quality of your thinking and the evidence of what you've shipped; building and scaling platforms with modern tooling, rather than just maintaining them.

We hire the best to join our team in London, wherever they come from (we sponsor visas and provide relocation support!). We're convinced diverse teams ship better products and especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN
Everything that sits below the product code. Today that work is shared across the team; you'll own it, with the autonomy to set the direction, decide what matters most, as well as scope and prioritise work yourself with the backing of the broader engineering team. As our engineering team grows fast, every improvement you make compounds across everyone building Conduct.

  • Deployment: fully automated, repeatable deployments of the whole platform, so we can stand up new regions - starting with the US.

  • Enterprise-grade security: customer-provided encryption keys, network boundaries and tenant isolation that hold up to the scrutiny of the world's largest companies

  • Bringing core services in-house: running durable execution, vector search and agent sandboxes inside our own infrastructure rather than renting them as a service

  • Data: scaling and tuning our databases, and owning where our data layer goes next

  • Developer experience: a fast, reliable local setup, preview environments from any branch, and build tooling and CI that keep up with a growing team

  • Observability: end-to-end tracing, structured logging and alerting that product engineers can self-serve

  • AI infrastructure: our LLM gateway, model routing, cost monitoring and resilience to flaky providers

OUR STACK
Our stack prioritises what matters: shipping to customers—fast—without compromising on quality and engineering.

Fundamentals are more important to us than familiarity with any technology or tool: if you're strong, we're sure you'll pick it up fast.

Here's our setup:

  • Azure, managed with Terraform: everything as code, with multi-cloud integrations for LLM providers across AWS, GCP and others

  • Kotlin and TypeScript services in a containerised monorepo, with CI/CD on GitHub Actions

  • Temporal and PortKey: durable execution and enterprise-compliant LLM routing at the core of our platform

  • Postgres for our data layer, with TurboPuffer for vector search

  • Agent sandboxes running on Daytona and other providers

  • OpenTelemetry and Honeycomb for observability

title: Platform Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.


Why We Need a Platform Security Engineer Now

Omnea takes security seriously. In an era where exploits and supply chain attacks are being discovered and conducted faster than ever before, it’s vital that we stay on the cutting edge of keeping our systems and our customers’ data safe.

 

Hardening our systems is only part of the solution. As we scale out to more industries with their diverse security requirements, we want another individual who can help us attain and maintain higher levels of compliance certification.

 

What We're Looking For

We're hiring at both Level 3 (Senior) and Level 4 (Staff). For calibration, candidates typically bring 5+ years of platform engineering experience in high-growth, cloud-native SaaS environments, but we care more about impact than years. We’re looking for that “T”-shaped skillset where the candidate’s depth is in Cloud Security.

 

Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have a product engineering background but caught the bug for security and cares deeply about enabling people to work fast, safely. Finally, we’re looking for someone who sees security as an enabler and force-multiplier and answers questions with a “Yes, here’s how we do it securely” attitude as opposed to the flat “No” security teams are too often renowned for.

 

What You'll Do

  • Implement and take ownership of our Security roadmap. Working with the Platform Lead, a successful candidate will steadily take ownership over the Platform Security Roadmap, leading implementations and experiments to level up Omnea’s security posture.

  • Own Security Tooling. From safe-chain plugins to SAST/DAST tooling, we want someone who’s keen to get stuck in, onboard, and evolve our tooling to ensure our posture stays at the bleeding edge.

  • Deliver Compliance Programs. Omnea plans to tackle multiple additional compliance certifications to enable the business to serve some of the most regulated industries on the planet. You’ll have a massive hand in making sure we’re up to those standards.

  • Collaborate with our DevX streams. Omnea ships fast, and we want to ship even faster. Making sure we can enable that safely and securely will become your wheelhouse.

  • Implement hardening patterns. See an area where code security could be improved? Let’s do it, and do it in a way that can be scaled out across the entire codebase and easily implemented by the rest of the engineering staff.


What Can You Expect?

  • A strong team. You'll join a platform team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will push you to do your best work.

  • Modern, cloud-native stack. Everything serverless and IaC-driven (AWS, Pulumi, TypeScript end-to-end).

  • Continuous delivery. We deploy multiple times a day. Your work determines how fast and safely the whole engineering org ships.

  • Scalability challenges. As we 10x revenue, you'll be a part of evolving our infrastructure to defend against new security threats and keep us one step ahead.

  • Customer impact. Delivering on our compliance goals and successfully handling audits.

  • Massive ownership. You own problems end-to-end, from brainstorming through to production.

  • Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.


About You

  • Platform engineer & builder. You design reliable infrastructure and write clean production code (TypeScript or similar). You've built and maintained CI/CD pipelines, IaC, and security gates at scale.

  • Cloud-native. Deep knowledge of AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge, IAM, networking), or equivalent cloud-native experience. You understand serverless and its trade-offs.

  • Security as an enabler. You think about engineers and business as your customers. You automate toil, improve feedback loops, and care deeply about making other people productive.

  • Commercially minded. You understand that infrastructure & security exist to serve the product and the business. You make trade-offs with that in mind.

  • Bias for action. You iterate quickly, ship pragmatically, and automate everything.

  • Culture carrier. You coach teammates, share knowledge freely, and keep calm when things break.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Pulumi or similar IaC frameworks.

  • ISC2 (any level) certification.

  • Experience running SaaS compliance programs (ISO:27001, SOC 2 Type II).

  • Open-source contributions to security, infrastructure, or developer tooling projects.

title: Principal Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

ROLE

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Principal Data Engineer to join our Engineering and Technology team. You will own the data architecture across the company, setting the standards, patterns, and technology choices our engineers build on as we scale the platform. Your influence spans the full data stack: streaming telemetry off GPU compute and cooling systems, the data lake feeding hardware failure prediction models, the AI-native layers powering agent-based workflows, and the governance layer that keeps it all secure, discoverable, and compliant. You will be one of the most senior technical voices for data at Firmus: you make the architecture decisions the organisation lives with long-term, and you stay hands-on on the problems that are too complex or too consequential to delegate.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Data Architecture & Technology Strategy   

Own the data architecture across Firmus: the patterns, technology choices, and technical standards that teams build on. Make the build-versus-buy, storage-topology, and streaming-versus-batch decisions the organisation lives with long-term and own the outcomes they lead to. 

  • Platform Build & Operations 

Build the core of the data platform hands-on: the real-time and AI data pipelines, the storage layer, and the transformation and semantic layers that serve BI tooling, internal analytics, and customer-facing reporting. Collaborate with the data engineers and platform engineers to deliver and operate streaming and batch ingestion from GPU telemetry, cooling sensors, billing, and incident sources, with clear reliability, schema-evolution, and latency SLAs. Data components run as infrastructure-as-code on the self-hosted, bare-metal Kubernetes. You own their deployment, quality, and storage cost, and work with platform engineers on backup, recovery, and incident response. 

  • Governance, Quality & Compliance  

Define and enforce data contracts, lineage, and access control across teams. Set organisation-wide data quality and observability standards: schema contract enforcement, freshness SLAs, and anomaly detection. Extend Firmus' existing SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 controls to the data platform as it scales into new data centres and meet the regulatory requirements that apply to our enterprise and government customers. 

  • Technical Leadership 

Raise the standard of data engineering in Firmus. Run design and architecture reviews, drive the RFC process, and catch architectural problems before they reach production. Mentor engineers on data architecture, data quality, and operational practice, building capability rather than a dependency on you. 

  • Stakeholder & Customer Interface 

Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to the CTO and engineering leadership, direct about risks and clear about recommendations. Partner with the AI and application team so the architecture supports AI agent workflows and hardware failure prediction. Engage enterprise and government customers on architecture, lineage, or compliance when the conversation needs a senior technical voice. 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE  

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field. 
  • 10+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 5 years making platform-level decisions that other teams depended on. You are still hands-on and intend to stay that way. 
  • You have been the most senior data engineer or architect in an organisation before, owning the architecture rather than contributing to it. 
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of end-to-end data architecture: ingestion, storage patterns, transformation, semantic layer design, observability, and governance. 
  • Track record designing large-scale data platforms that integrate data across multiple regions or data centres. 
  • Production experience operating high-cardinality time-series and telemetry pipelines at high ingest and update rates. 
  • Production experience across columnar, time-series, relational, object, and vector storage patterns. You know when to use each one and what it costs to operate.

title: Principal Engineer (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Protofy

Wir sind Protofy, die Outcome Agency aus Hamburg, und entwickeln seit über 10 Jahren digitale Produkte, Plattformen und KI-Systeme, die messbar wirken. Technologie ist für uns kein Selbstzweck, sondern ein Business Case, den wir in Umsatz, Effizienz und Wachstum übersetzen.

Deine Rolle

Als technische*r Lead führst Du engagierte Teams und sorgst dafür, dass auch komplexe Projekte pragmatisch, sorgfältig und wirtschaftlich umgesetzt werden. Wir entwickeln Websites und Mobile-Apps für Branchen wie E-Commerce, Wissensmanagement und Sport. Unsere Projekte laufen drei bis neun Monate oder werden als Produkte langfristig weiterentwickelt. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin mit und hast ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Architektur.

Den Entscheider*innenunserer Kund*innen begegnest Du auf Augenhöhe: Du leitest Architekturworkshops eigenständig und unterstützt uns bei Pitches. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg*innen aus Produkt Designer*innen und Product Owner*innen verantwortest Du Spezifikation, Umsetzung, Testing und Deployment von Features.

Neue Technologien erschließt Du hands-on und machst sie für das Team nutzbar. Außerdem gestaltest Du professionelle Standards in der gesamten Organisation mit, insbesondere für KI-gestützte Entwicklung. Den Großteil Deiner Zeit arbeitest Du selbst im Code, daneben übernimmst Du Führung, Kundenkontakt und Themen der Organisation.

Deine typische Woche

  • Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner*in für die Entscheider*innen unserer Kund*innen und berätst sie strategisch

  • Du unterstützt Pitches, erarbeitest Slides und technische Konzepte und präsentierst sie

  • Du führst Projekte technisch ganzheitlich, von der Architektur bis zum Deployment

  • Du entwirfst neue Funktionen mit Produktmanager*innen und UX-Designer*innen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit Deinem Team um

  • Du baust neue Themen und Technologien hands-on im Projekt auf, z. B. neue Shopsysteme, Frameworks oder Cloud-Provider

  • Du begleitest Dein Team, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst Deine Kolleg*innen durch Tech-Mentoring

  • Du gestaltest Entwicklungsprozesse pragmatisch mit, insbesondere KI-gestützte Entwicklung (Tools, Workflows, Qualitätssicherung)

  • Du behältst die Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick: Du schätzt Aufwände, achtest auf Budgets und unterstützt das Projektmanagement

  • Du entwickelst die gesamte Organisation aktiv mit

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Web- oder App-Entwicklung

  • Du hast 4+ Jahre Erfahrung als Tech Lead bzw. in der technischen Führung von Teams

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der technischen Verantwortung mittelgroßer Projekte (500+ Personentage)

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Application Architecture und begleitest Teams dabei, Anwendungen auf der grünen Wiese aufzusetzen

  • Du kannst Projekte ganzheitlich technisch führen

  • Du behältst auch in intensiven Projektphasen einen klaren Kopf und gehst gelassen mit Unsicherheit um

  • Du übernimmst gern Verantwortung über Deine eigene Arbeit hinaus und lernst gern Neues

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch

Deine ersten Monate bei Protofy

In deinen ersten Wochen wirst du dich in unsere bestehenden Projekte und Architekturkonzepte einarbeiten und erste Features für unsere Kund*innen umsetzen. Du tauschst dich eng mit dem Team aus und übernimmst schrittweise die Verantwortung für die technische Ausrichtung von unser Kund*innen. Dann übernimmst du Verantwortung und steigst in Pitch Prozesse mit ein. Wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen auf Anhieb erfüllst, aber Lust hast dich schnell weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir dir

Bei uns bekommst Du 30 Urlaubstagen im Jahr. Wann und wo Du arbeitest, gestaltest Du flexibel: im Büro, im Homeoffice oder komplett remote in Deutschland. Firmenlaptop und passendes Home-Office-Setup gibt’s von uns dazu.

Wir investieren in Deine Weiterbildung und in Dein Wohlbefinden. Dafür gibt es Unterstützung für Deine mentale Gesundheit, ein Urban Sports Club und die Option auf ein Sabbatical, wenn Du mal eine längere Auszeit brauchst. Für Deine Zukunft sorgt die betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Dazu kommen du das Deutschlandticket Premium komplett finanziert.

Und weil Arbeit auch Spaß machen soll: Wir feiern regelmäßig zusammen bei Teamevents und Firmenfeiern. Getränke und Snacks gehen auf uns. Dein Hund ist im Büro herzlich willkommen.

Vergütung

Unser Gehaltsrahmen für diese Position liegt bei EUR 77.500–90.000€ im Jahr.

title: Principal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Note: We will begin reviewing applications from 5 October 2026 and will continue to consider them on a rolling basis until the role is filled. First-round interviews are expected to take place in mid October, with the process anticipated to close by the first week of November. Timelines are indicative and may change.

LOCATION: London, UK preferred. EU considered.

Most high-stakes moments in AI over the coming years will involve frontier company insiders having and raising concerns: within companies, to regulators, or through other pathways.

Those insiders tell us they face enormous uncertainty along the “concern raising” path -- from detecting concerns to whether and how to voice concerns with maximum impact and minimal risk, which even legally protected whistleblowing can carry.

To date, no organization has dedicated itself deeply to delivering the best strategic, frontier-AI-specific guidance to these individuals, their supporters, and their attorneys (our partners). We exist to ensure that each insider disclosure is maximally impactful and safe for the person making the disclosure.

Tasks

About the role

You will own all of AIWI's technology: architecture, implementation, deployment, security, and maintenance. Delivery will be hands-on and you will manage a budget for executing items defined on your roadmap.

You will work closely with the founders and our Head of Security, and translate requirements from our operations, research, and advocacy teams into working systems. The work is demanding, sensitive, and consequential; conviction in our mission is essential.

Areas of Ownership

  1. Internal tooling. We operate in a highly sensitive environment. Many commercial SaaS products, and hosted AI models in particular, do not meet our security and data sovereignty requirements. You will build and operate our self-hosted, primarily OSS stack end to end: A secure CRM tailored to our needs, state-of-the-art self-hosted AI models and agent systems integrated into knowledge management, call recording, communication tooling, other OSS software we self host, and in-house development of news tracking solutions. If you are excited about designing architecture that allows air-gapping and decentralized access, this role is for you.

  2. External-facing technology. You take offerings from prototype to production end-to-end: Zero-knowledge proof solutions for anonymous coordination, interactive scenario simulators, or automated legislation trackers. Projects can span months or require rapid 3-day delivery. You will also oversee the tech-side of our website. Your solutions will directly drive the impact and safety of AI whistleblowers.

This means you will frequently handle multiple projects simultaneously. You will be the first non-volunteer engineer working on AIWI dedicated technology. Across all areas, security is foundational. You will work closely here with our Head of Security.

Requirements

  • Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI safety and whistleblower protection.

  • 10 years in software engineering with DevOps experience in fast-moving settings.

  • Excellent proficiency across systems-, backend- and web-development; proficiency with systems languages (Rust, Go, C, C++ etc.) required.

  • Experience with JS/TS, HTML, CSS, web frameworks required.

  • Python for AI and Data pipelines required.

  • Excellent project management abilities and communication skills especially towards non-technical colleagues.

  • Strong grasp of CI/CD, security hardening, cloud and self-hosted infrastructure.

  • IaC experience (Ansible, OpenTofu, etc.) required.

  • Experience deploying and integrating existing AI models and tooling (self-hosted open-weight models, agent frameworks, APIs where appropriate) — this is systems integration, not ML research or model training.

  • Ability to rapidly execute and ability to distinguish between levels of QA and security required for different projects.

  • Rigorous approach to threat modeling and operational security. You do not have to be a security expert as you will be working with our Head of Security — but should bring a strong mindset and strong foundational knowledge.

Benefits

Package

  • GBP £70,000 - £90,000 commensurate with experience

  • Up to 9% on UEL pension contribution

  • 25 days of annual leave plus public bank holidays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Professional development budget

  • A home office or equipment stipend for hybrid staff

  • Wellness budget

  • Paid for co-working space in London

  • Flexible scheduling; occasional out-of-hours work required

Why join?

  • Work as part of an ambitious team committed to a high leverage intervention: A single whistleblower disclosure can move the world if handled well. We get up every morning to make it go well.

  • Work on a vast breadth of technological challenges and varying project sizes.

  • Ownership and responsibility from day 1.

  • Chance to define your personal career development.

  • Coaching by an AIWI board member and serial entrepreneur/CTO as well as close collaboration with an extremely experienced Head of Security.

Who you'd be joining:

AIWI is an independent non-profit launched in late 2024. We are ~4 team members today and are scaling to ~15 within the year, spread across the Bay Area, DC, and London. Joining now, you will significantly shape what the future of AI insider support looks like. We are funded until 2029.

Examples of our work to date:

  • Policy: We pushed for and shaped the EU AI Office's channel, the world's first AI whistleblowing channel. In the US, we support the federal AI Whistleblower Protection Act and have provided expert research input on implementing SB 53's incident reporting mechanisms through a research coalition, which we helped set up. Read our work in Tech Policy Press, the Institute for Law & AI, and Transformer, and see our AI Whistleblowing Law Best Practice Guide.

  • Insider education & support: Our online campaigns have reached thousands of company employees. We produce guides (available upon request), online courses, and help establish connections to our great partner attorneys and support (e.g. on legal advice and defense funding).

  • Advocacy: Anthropic published its whistleblowing policy and OpenAI strengthened theirs following our Publish Your Policies Campaign.

  • Network: We closely collaborate with the world's leading whistleblowing and AI organizations.

Our ambition is to ensure that each insider disclosure is maximally impactful and safe for the person making the disclosure. Joining us means dedicating yourself to achieving that goal with us.

Hiring process:

  1. Application review

  2. Intro call (15 min): Jenny, Head of People & Ops

  3. Get-to-know + Pairing assessment call (30 min + 1 hour): Max, Technology Advisor

  4. Finish coding assignment at home: ~1 hour

  5. Final interview** (1 hour): competency-based, plus meet Karl (Founder) or Jenny

  6. References

* This interview slot is 1.5 hours, if you pass the first 30 minutes of call, we go straight to a code pairing exercise. Once complete, Max may ask you to finish task.

** Ideally, we would like to meet you in our London office.

Referral program:

We provide a reward of £4,000 for successful referrals upon completion of a 6-month employment period. Allocation will occur based on a successful applicant's attribution in the case of multiple referrers.

How to apply:

  • Apply by submitting your application via Join.com.

  • We will begin reviewing applications on a rolling basis from 5 October.

  • The first round is set to take place in mid October.

  • Therefore, anticipated close date is early November.

Work authorization:

  • For London-based roles, we can sponsor UK visas.

Equal Opportunity:

AIWI is an equal opportunities employer, in line with the UK Equality Act 2010. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to a workplace free from discrimination.

descriptionHtml:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Our Commerce & Technology division helps leading global brands design, build and run the commerce platforms behind their growth. We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to lead solution in business pursuits and account growth, across enterprise commerce. 

You will be the person in the room who understands how the whole commerce estate fits together, from web storefront and mobile app through commerce platform, data and ERP.   You will turn that understanding into a clear case for business value, win the trust of senior client stakeholders, and when it helps, build a working demonstration to show them what good looks like. 
 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Architect Enterprise Commerce: Design end to end commerce solutions across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, HCL and composable (MACH) solutions, spanning web, mobile apps, data and back office systems.  
  • Lead with value: Frame every solution around commercial outcomes, cost and return, so clients can see clear cases for change rather than a technology shopping list.  
  • Serve as an outward-facing, energetic leader who runs workshops, participates in governance, and collaborates with commercial teams to identify and shape technical growth opportunities. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Client Engagement and Discovery: Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders. Run discovery workshops, ask the questions that uncover what really matters, and cut through complexity to the decisions that count. 
  • Solution Design and Architecture: Produce clear architecture diagrams and solution designs covering storefront, mobile apps, commerce platform, search, content, order management, product information, payments, data and other integrations. Recommend the right platform and approach for each client rather than defaulting to one. 
  • Platform Selection and Replatforming: Guide clients through platform choices and migrations, including the move from monolithic to composable, weighing total cost of ownership, speed to market, risk and operating model. 
  • Data, Integration and Back Office: Get into the detail of how commerce connects to ERP (such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle), order management, warehouse, customer data and analytics, and design integration patterns that hold up at enterprise scale. 
  • Mobile and Omnichannel: Shape mobile app strategy and architecture (native, cross platform and headless) alongside web, store and marketplace channels, so the customer experience is joined up. 
  • Business Case and Value: Build business cases, value models and roadmaps that link technology decisions to revenue, conversion, margin and cost to serve. 
  • Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept: Stand up demo storefronts and prototypes quickly, such as a Shopify store or a composable proof of concept, to show clients what is possible and take risk out of their decisions. 
  • Proposals and Pitches: Own the solution story, architecture, assumptions and effort estimates in proposals, and present them with confidence at pitch. 
  • Handover and Delivery Assurance: Make sure what is sold can be delivered, with a clean handover to delivery teams and continued involvement through mobilisation. 
  • Market and Partner Leadership: Stay across the commerce market, including cloud (AWS, GCP), AI in commerce and agentic commerce. Share that knowledge to strengthen our propositions and our partner relationships. 

What we want from you 

  • Enterprise Commerce Experience: Extensive senior experience in enterprise commerce across retail, consumer brands or B2B, gained in digital agencies, consultancies or large brands. 
  • Breadth Across Platforms: Strong working knowledge of Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopify, plus composable and MACH (microservices, API first, cloud native, headless) components such as Commerce tools, Contentful, Algolia, Akeneo or similar. 
  • Presales and New Business: A track record of shaping and winning significant commerce deals, running workshops, writing proposals and presenting to senior audiences. 
  • Commercial Acumen: Understands how clients make money. Speaks confidently about value, cost and return, and can hold a commercial conversation with a Chief Executive or Chief Financial Officer as easily as with a Chief Technology Officer. 
  • Data and ERP Integration: Hands on understanding of how commerce connects with ERP, order management, product information, customer data and analytics, and the integration patterns that make it work. 
  • Mobile Apps: Solid understanding of mobile commerce app architecture and delivery, including native and cross platform approaches and how apps connect to headless commerce services. 
  • Architecture and Communication: Excellent diagramming, written and verbal skills. Able to turn complex estates into simple pictures and clear stories for senior audiences. 
  • Hands On Credibility: Comfortable building a demo store, configuring a platform or proving a concept yourself, rather than relying on slides alone. 
  • Presence: Energetic, confident and credible with clients. Able to cut through noise and lead the room. 

If you know some of this, even better 

  • Certifications across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce B2C Commerce or Shopify, MACH 
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional) and experience running commerce on Cloud solutions.  
  • Order management, product information management and marketplace platforms 
  • B2B commerce, including complex pricing, catalogue and account structures 
  • Agentic commerce concepts and emerging standards (ACP, AP2, A2A) and practical use of AI in commerce 
  • Total cost of ownership and business case modelling 
  • The C4 model and diagrams as code 

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Permanent only

title: Principle Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSIONAt Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes with industry leading products and platforms developed through an AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle.ABOUT USRedwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

CORE VALUES

  • One Team. One Redwood
  • Make Your Own Weather
  • Obsess over Customer Success
  • Work the Problem
  • Be Curious
  • Own the Outcome
  • Respect Each Other

YOUR IMPACT

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader and strategic influencer shaping Redwood’s RunMyJobs platform. You will drive high-impact technical decisions, own complex system designs, and lead initiatives that span teams and domains. Your work will translate business needs into scalable, resilient full-stack solutions that meet both functional and non-functional requirements. 

In this fast-paced, agile environment, you will lead projects from concept through delivery, collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, finance, and customer success teams to ensure alignment and success. You will set the standard for engineering excellence by mentoring engineers at all levels and championing a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and technical rigor.

A key part of this role is to ensure development teams follow best practices, coding standards, and technical requirements. You will provide hands-on technical guidance and architectural direction, including code and design reviews, while creating and maintaining design and code standards. Understanding, communicating, and enforcing Redwood’s software architecture strategy will be fundamental. 

You will proactively identify critical technical challenges related to quality, scalability, observability, and performance. By spotting early risks in architecture or implementation, you help prevent issues before they affect delivery or user experience. Leveraging data analysis, code reviews, and collaboration with cross-functional teams, you ensure that solutions are robust, efficient, and scalable, driving Redwood’s platform forward with confidence.

You will work directly with the Engineering manager for your teams and collaborate closely with Redwood’s Architecture team to ensure technical alignment, consistency, and strategic direction across the platform. As a key member of the engineering leadership group, you will influence architectural decisions and contribute to the evolution of our engineering strategy.

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical ownership and no direct people management responsibilities.

Your responsibilities will also include:

  • System Architecture & Design: Lead the design and implementation of large-scale distributed systems, focusing on resilience, low-latency, and fault tolerance within the Java ecosystem.
  • Prompt Engineering for SDLC: Apply advanced prompt engineering techniques to maximize the efficacy of generative AI tools for writing comprehensive unit/integration tests, drafting technical documentation (Javadoc, API specs), and generating code refactoring suggestions.
  • CI/CD and Observability: Oversee and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines (CI/CD, Kubernetes/Docker) in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure/GCP), leveraging AI tools for proactive anomaly detection and monitoring.
  • Collaborating with the product management team to define, design, and implement new functionality that enhances Redwood's software solutions.
  • Diagnosing and resolving complex technical challenges and system issues to ensure platform reliability.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. You should have over eight years of software development experience, with at least three to five years in a senior or staff software engineer role. This position requires proven experience in workload automation, job scheduling, and orchestration technologies.

  • Deep proficiency in Java (11/17+), with strong experience in modern frameworks and libraries.
  • Strong background in microservice architecture, containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) and RESTful API design.
  • Experience with frontend technologies including ReactJS, MobX, and TypeScript.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
  • Strong understanding of database technologies (SQL, NoSQL, data modelling).
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with tools like Git, GitHub, Jira and Bamboo from Atlassian.
  • Proficiency in testing frameworks such as JUnit, Jest and Playwright with a focus on driving quality automation and testability by design.
  • Commitment to engineering best practices, including code reviews, static analysis and continuous quality improvements.
  • AI Tool Fluency: Demonstrated ability to proficiently use AI-powered developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, CodeWhisperer) in a production environment.
  • Code Judgment: Proven track record of evaluating and overriding AI-generated suggestions that are technically correct but architecturally flawed or non-compliant with security and performance best practices.
  • Prompting Proficiency: Experience writing clear, contextual, and effective prompts for generative AI to produce usable code, tests, or documentation.
  • Adaptability & Learning: High degree of curiosity and a proactive approach to learning new AI tools and techniques that continuously reshape the development workflow.
  • Domain & Architectural Focus: The capacity to abstract away from low-level coding details to focus on high-value business logic and systemic architectural integrity.

If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy.

I started Anima to change that.

Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima.

We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions.

Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them.

If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives.

-- Shun

Base salary £110k-£140k, plus equity
London, Farringdon
At least two days a week in the office

The role

Design software that makes complex clinical work feel simple.

You’ll own product problems from discovery through launch and beyond, working directly with customers and engineers. That could mean rethinking a workflow clinicians repeat hundreds of times a day, or taking a new product from its first idea to daily use.

This is a hands-on IC role with real influence over what we build. We don’t have Product Managers: you’ll help decide which problems matter, make the product trade-offs and stay close to the details that make great software. You’ll also help shape our design standards and how we work as the team grows.

What you’ll do

  • Get close to users. Join customer calls and visit GP practices to understand how care actually happens, where people struggle and what would make a difference.

  • Own problems end to end. Turn ambiguous needs into clear product decisions, test ideas and work with engineers to ship them.

  • Make complexity feel simple. Design intuitive workflows and polished interfaces for people making consequential decisions under pressure.

  • Keep improving after launch. Use customer feedback and product usage to understand what worked and where to go next.

  • Raise the standard. Develop reusable patterns, improve our design tools and help the team ship excellent work consistently.

What you’ll bring

  • Excellent design craft. A sharp eye for visual and interaction design, with care for the details that make software feel effortless.

  • Evidence of shipped work. Experience designing complex B2B software and improving it through real use, with clear examples of your contribution and its impact.

  • Strong product judgement. An instinct for what matters to users, backed by evidence and the ability to turn messy problems into simple, useful solutions.

  • Technical fluency. An understanding of how software is built, plus curiosity about using code, prototypes and AI tools to bring ideas to life.

  • High agency and drive. The resourcefulness to keep work moving through ambiguity and obstacles, taking responsibility for the outcome.

  • Thoughtful collaboration. Clear reasoning, openness to challenge and a willingness to change direction when someone has a better idea.

What we offer

Anima should be where you do your life’s best work. We support that with:

  • Time off: 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 UK public holidays, with flexible additional time off.

  • Health cover: private medical, dental, vision and mental health insurance.

  • Parental leave: 12 weeks’ maternity leave at full pay, rising to 24 weeks after two years; 4 weeks’ paternity leave at full pay.

  • Pension: 4% employer contributions, with salary sacrifice and 100% of the employer National Insurance savings passed on to you.

  • Learning: £1,000 annual budget for your development.

  • Fitness: gym subscription matching up to £50 per month.

  • Equipment: a high-spec MacBook and a home office budget.

descriptionHtml:

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

We are looking for a Product Manager – Web Personalization to join the Bloomreach Engagement product team.

In this role, you will own the Web Personalization area of Engagement – everything that powers how our customers personalize experiences on their websites and web apps: weblayers, on‑site personalization blocks, web experiments, and the orchestration of these experiences alongside email, SMS, and mobile channels. Working in one of our Central European offices or from home on a full-time basis, you’ll become a core part of the Engagement product team.

You will:

  • Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for Web Personalization.
  • Partner closely with design, engineering, and GTM teams to build capabilities that:
    • Make web personalization simple and powerful for marketers.
    • Integrate deeply with our core data & decisioning capabilities.
    • Differentiate Bloomreach vs. competitors in web & app personalization.
    • Lead the transformation of this area into the era of AI, Agents and LLMs.

About the Team / Product Area

Bloomreach Engagement is our marketing automation product, used by digital-first brands to orchestrate cross-channel journeys across email, SMS, mobile, web, and ads.

The Web Personalization product area includes (non-exhaustive):

  • Weblayers / onsite experiences (banners, pop-ups, forms, etc.).
  • Web experiments (A/B tests, variations, targeting).
  • Scenario orchestration for website experiences (e.g., weblayers in scenarios).
  • Supporting components: web SDKs, targeting, frequency capping, templates, analytics.

Your mandate is to make this stack:

  • More powerful (better decisioning, targeting, personalization).
  • Easier to use (for marketers, not just technical users).
  • Better connected (to Engagement data, AI, and other channels).
  • AI native (transforming existing approaches to new experiences).

Tasks and Responsibilities

As Product Manager for Web Personalization, you will:

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and evolve the product strategy for Web Personalization aligned with Engagement’s overall vision.
  • Maintain a clear roadmap for your area, balancing:
    • Customer-impacting improvements.
    • Strategic differentiators (e.g. AI-driven personalization, agentic orchestration).
    • Technical investments (performance, scalability, UX simplification).
  • Translate strategy into clear problem statements, outcomes, and success metrics.

Discovery & Problem Definition

  • Run structured discovery with customers, prospects, and internal teams (CS, Sales, PS, Support) to deeply understand:
    • How they run on-site personalization and experiments today.
    • Where Bloomreach falls short vs. alternatives.
    • The biggest usability and adoption blockers for web personalization.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to prioritize problems and validate opportunities.

Delivery & Execution

  • Work day-to-day with engineering, design, and data to deliver high-quality features:
    • Write clear PRDs / specs and success criteria.
    • Ensure usability risk is addressed via close collaboration with UX and research.
    • Manage trade-offs and scope while preserving the customer value.
  • Drive end-to-end delivery:
    • From design → implementation → rollout → measurement → iteration.

Cross-Channel Orchestration

  • Ensure Web Personalization is deeply integrated into:
    • Scenarios (journey builder).
    • CDP capabilities (segments, events, attributes, predictions).
    • Other channels (email, SMS, mobile, ads).
  • Partner with other Engagement PMs to provide a unified omnichannel experience for marketers (e.g., single orchestration workspace combining web and messaging).

Go-to-Market & Adoption

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Docs, Academy, and CS to:
    • Shape positioning and messaging for Web Personalization.
    • Create launch materials, internal enablement, and best-practice playbooks.
    • Support pricing & packaging discussions for web personalization capabilities.
  • Monitor adoption, usage, and funnel metrics for your features and run experiments to improve activation and long-term engagement.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the single-threaded owner for Web Personalization:
    • Communicate priorities, trade-offs, and timelines to internal stakeholders.
    • Represent your area in roadmap reviews, QPRs, and field-facing sessions.
  • Ensure tight collaboration with:
    • Engineering & Design (for delivery).
    • Customer Success & Solutions (for feedback and validation).
    • Sales & Product Marketing (for competitive differentiation and GTM).

What We Expect of the Candidate

Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience working with web personalization, experimentation, customer engagement, or related digital experience tools in a practitioner role.
  • Strong practical background in at least one of:
    • Web personalization / experimentation platforms
    • Marketing automation / CDP products with strong web capabilities
    • Web experience / CMS / front-end tools (e.g. A/B testing tools, on-site personalization, web SDKs)
  • Experience using Bloomreach Engagement is strongly preferred; experience with similar platforms such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization, Dynamic Yield, Monetate, or comparable tools is also valuable.
  • Experience as a product manager is a plus, but not a requirement.
  • Mobile app personalization experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate real customer and implementation needs into clear product, use case, or solution requirements.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Customer-centric problem solver: You can turn messy feedback into crisp problem statements. You are comfortable saying “no” and explaining trade-offs.
  • Strong product discovery skills: Comfortable running interviews, validating hypotheses, and working with UX/research.
  • Technical fluency: Able to discuss architecture and constraints of web SDKs, tag managers, APIs, and front-end rendering with engineers. Can work with tracking concepts (events, attributes, experiments) and understand their implications.
