title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
descriptionHtml:
Sales Development Representative

Edinburgh

 

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The Role

We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to spearhead our outbound engine and book high-quality opportunities with in-house legal teams.

This is the frontline of our growth. You’ll be responsible for finding the right accounts, crafting compelling outreach, and breaking into companies. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our Account Executives (AEs) and Marketing teams to build a predictable pipeline.

This is an early-stage environment. Things move fast, priorities shift, and there isn’t always a clear playbook. You’ll need to be resilient, highly organized, and willing to experiment with new ways to get a prospect’s attention.

What you’ll do

  • Build and execute targeted outbound campaigns (email, cold calling, LinkedIn) to general counsel and legal leaders.

  • Consistently hit and exceed monthly meeting-booked and pipeline targets.

  • Partner closely with AEs to strategize on key accounts and ensure smooth handoffs.

  • Act as a feedback loop for Marketing and Product by tracking what messaging resonates most with the market.

  • Maintain meticulous CRM data — keeping track of accounts, prospects, and outreach activity.

What we’re looking for

  • SaaS sales or lead generation experience (experience selling to legal, finance, or compliance is a major plus, but not required).

  • A relentless work ethic — you aren't afraid of the phone and view "no" as data, not a deterrent.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can cut through the noise with clear, value-led messaging.

  • High curiosity and coachability; you want to master the product, the market, and the art of sales.

  • High ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just logging activities.

  • Organized, consistent, and reliable with excellent time management.

How we work

We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office our out visiting clients as your default.

This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.

There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.

This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy.

 

Why Wordsmith

We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

Security Architect - Contract

Responsibilities
  • Own the solution architecture through Gate 1 (18 Jan) and MVP go-live (29 Mar), aligned with Greene King’s architects and engineers.
  • Design partner identity and access on Okta CIC: OIDC, passkeys, step-up auth, re-registration, and per-object authorisation across partners, sites and roles.
  • Lead threat modelling, security NFRs and secure-SDLC controls in Azure DevOps.
  • Shape the Azure platform: Front Door/WAF, API Management, Container Apps, Key Vault, managed identities, monitoring.
  • Run contract-first integration with the orchestration layer (OpenAPI, mocks, contract tests).
  • Support a phased, reversible move of partners off the old portal.
Essential
  • Solution architect on customer-facing web or mobile products on Azure.
  • Production experience with OIDC/OAuth, the BFF pattern and fine-grained authorisation.
  • Threat modelling and secure design for apps handling financial or personal data.
  • API-led integration with enterprise systems; Bicep and Azure DevOps.
Desirable
  • Okta CIC / Auth0, passkeys/WebAuthn.
  • ASP.NET Core; PWA/Capacitor app store releases.
  • Delivering with AI coding agents.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

title: Security Engineer (Remote - Netherlands)
descriptionHtml:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you’ll own application security for a fast-growing AI companionship platform. This is a hands-on AppSec role: you’ll review code, find real vulnerabilities and drive fixes across the stack. You’ll be the main security person in the company, reporting directly to our CTO and Co-Founder. You’ll set direction yourself and explain risk clearly to non-security colleagues. Our product includes AI-generated content, including NSFW content, and you’ll also keep an eye on AI-specific threats like prompt injection. Real ownership from day one.

This isn’t an infrastructure, networking or DevSecOps role: we’re looking for application security depth.

Key Responsibilities

Application security (the core of the role)

  • Review code every week to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

  • Find, prioritize and drive fixes for real vulnerabilities across the stack, not surface-level issues

Audits and pentests

  • Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests

  • Challenge findings where needed, and follow them through to fixes

Engineering and automation

  • Automate security work and build the tools you need to scale it

  • Use AI tools daily in your security work: code review, pentests and scripting

Ownership and communication

  • Own security end to end with little support, and decide what matters most

  • Explain technical risk in plain words to the team and leadership

  • Cover security alerts, including occasional night and weekend on-call

Also part of the role (lighter)

  • Keep a simple risk register and GRC documentation up to date

  • Share security updates with the team and run awareness training

  • Watch emerging AI threats (prompt injection, jailbreaks, content filter bypass) and incidents at our AI providers

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

  • 2+ years of hands-on security experience

  • Hands-on AppSec, not compliance only: you review code regularly and can walk us through a real vulnerability you found and fixed

  • Audits and pentests: you’ve coordinated an external audit or pentest and followed the findings through to fixes

  • Engineering workflows: you ship code with Git/GitHub, script in Python or Bash, and have recent hands-on work on a modern web stack (e.g. Rails, Node; GCP, Heroku or similar)

  • Ownership with little support: you’ve been the sole or lead security person, or owned a security area on your own. You’ve reviewed code or tested systems every week in the last 2 years, and you explain risk clearly to non-technical people

  • AI in your daily work: you use AI tools every day in your security work

  • A hacker mindset: You love breaking things to make them safer, and security isn’t only your job: you do it for fun too, through bug bounties, CTFs, research, write-ups or your own tools.


Nice-to-haves

  • ⭐ AI/LLM security testing (prompt injection, jailbreaking): a strong plus

  • Experience at an AI company or a scale-up

  • GRC awareness

  • Familiarity with MDM and access management


Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🧢 Goal-orientated, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable working in an environment with products that are based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: €65K – €115K • Multiple Ranges

  • Mid • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €65K – €85K
  • Senior • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €85K – €115K

title: Senior Account Executive - Healthcare PR
descriptionHtml:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for driven, savvy game changers who are ready to dive into the trenches and make an immediate impact. We are currently seeking a Senior Account Executive with client services experience in a healthcare communications agency. The position offers a great opportunity for an individual with a passion for healthcare to work with leading clients in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices and health IT fields, across a range of global PR and communications accounts to support our growing team.

What You'll Do:

  • Take responsibility for exceptional client service and account management activities for 2-3 accounts
  • In collaboration with junior team members and supported by senior management and our internal team, drive flawless and timely project execution and high-touch client communication
  • Participate in development of clients’ marketing strategies and tactics
  • Support overall account development, resourcing fiscal performance and growth
  • Support day-to-day client contact in executing ad hoc requests and delivering planned activities and materials
  • Develop draft scope of works, contracts, presentations, creative briefs, PR and marketing materials and other internal/external communications
  • Ensure client feedback is gathered, understood and addressed as appropriate across deliverables and internally
  • Document status and otherwise communicate need-to-know information to all project stakeholders to ensure progression along critical path
  • Sets meetings, provides agendas and contact reports
  • Ability to run client calls or meetings independently
  • Manage account finances; must be able to track budget, raise invoices and POs

Who are you?

  • Experience working at an Account Executive or Senior Account Executive level in a healthcare PR/Communications agency.
  • Highly organized with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration
  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment
  • Has good understanding of social media vehicles and is comfortable managing and drafting communications around them
  • Strong written and oral communication and presentations skills
  • Able to devise and articulate solutions to problems on an ongoing basis
  • Ability to develop project scopes and client and vendor contracts
  • Demonstrated experience with media monitoring, research and taking on projects with limited supervision

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.

*Notice: Real Chemistry and its affiliates' names are being misused by scammers through messaging services, fake websites, and apps. Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. We are working to stop these unauthorized activities and protect our community. Read more here.

Dann bewirb dich und werde damit Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte und das gemeinsam mit ca. 3.000 motivierten Kolleg:innen in Frankreich, Deutschland und Italien! Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst den gesamten Vertriebsweg vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss 

  • Du bist maßgeblich verantwortlich für unseren Umsatz (MRR), für die Aktivitäten und somit für das Wachstum Deiner Region

  • Du trackst regelmäßig Dein Sales Reporting und Forecasting mittels Salesforce um Deinen Erfolg zu messen

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stelle!

Du könntest unser nächstes Teammitglied werden wenn:

  • Du glänzt mit exzellenten Hunting - & Pitching Skills

  • Du hast ein hohes Energielevel, Spaß am Verkaufen und überzeugst mit sicherem, positiven und professionellem Auftreten

  • Du hast ein Entrepreneurial Mindset, bist ergebnisorientiert und besitzt ein hohes Organisationsgeschick 

  • Du zeichnest dich durch sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten aus (schriftliche & mündliche Deutschkenntnisse auf min. C1 Niveau)

  • Du hast einen Führerschein der Klasse B

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem: 

  • Du konntest erste Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen bzw. E-Health Bereich sammeln

Was wir Dir bieten  

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit tollen Zusatzleistungen

  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält

  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner 

  • Einen Firmenwagen 

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

Der Interview-Prozess 

  1. Interview mit unserem Talent Team (remote - 20')

  2. Interview mit der/m Hiring Manager:in und Teamlead aus der Abteilung (remote - 60')

  3. DoctoDay - verbringe einen Tag mit Deinem zukünftigen Team und erhalten einen ersten Einblick in den Job als Account Executive

  4. Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung

Job Details

  • Festanstellung 

  • Vollzeit

  • ab Sofort

Unsere Philosophie

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr kann unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern. Deshalb laden wir dich ein, dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung. Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in Deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben, wie Fotos, Alter verzichten. title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer (m/w/d)- Beratung und Umsetzung im Mittelstand
descriptionHtml:
Du verstehst KI-Systeme bis ins Detail. Und Du kannst sie einem Geschäftsführer so erklären, dass er die richtige Entscheidung trifft.

Wir wollen die KI-Expert:innen im Mittelstand sein. Nicht die, die am lautesten über KI reden, sondern die, die wissen, warum ein RAG-System schlechte Antworten liefert, welches Modell lokal betrieben werden kann und welcher Use Case in drei Monaten Wirkung zeigt. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die beides mitbringen: echte technische Tiefe und Erfahrung darin, Kunden durch Projekte zu führen.

Als Senior AI Solutions Engineer bei Neurawork verantwortest Du Kundenprojekte von der ersten Analyse bis zum Go-live. Du nimmst Prozesse und Datenlage auf, bewertest Use Cases auf Machbarkeit und Wirkung, entwirfst die Architektur und setzt die Lösung selbst um, auf Basis unserer standardisierten Produkte und bis zur vollständigen Integration in die Systemlandschaft des Kunden. Der Kunde vertraut Dir, weil Du technisch weißt, wovon Du sprichst.

Wir arbeiten nach unserem eigenen Operational-AI-Vorgehensmodell. Wir sind keine Automation-Agentur und keine Custom-Softwareentwickler: Standardisierte Produkte sind unser Hebel, und wir passen sie bis zur vollständigen Integration an. Wir schaffen echten, messbaren Mehrwert und stehen dafür ein.

Aufgaben

Was Du bei uns machst

  • Projekte verantworten: Kundenprojekte im Mittelstand führen, vom Kick-off bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb

  • Bewerten: Prozesse und Daten beim Kunden verstehen, Use Cases auf Machbarkeit, Kosten und Grenzen prüfen und nach Wirkung priorisieren

  • Selbst bauen: Architektur entwerfen, unsere Produkte konfigurieren und erweitern, Retrieval und Prompting optimieren, Qualität messbar machen

  • Integrieren: Schnittstellen, Datenanbindung, Sicherheit und Betrieb gemeinsam mit der Kunden-IT umsetzen

  • Beraten mit Substanz: Fachabteilung, IT und Geschäftsführung fundiert begleiten, Erwartungen klar steuern, Roadmaps entwickeln, die technisch tragen

  • Menschen mitnehmen: Workshops moderieren und Teilnehmende befähigen, damit die Lösung im Alltag ankommt

  • Weitergeben: Erkenntnisse in unsere Frameworks und Produkte zurückspielen; Live-Sessions in unserer KI-Ausbildung mit TÜV Süd Zertifikat und im KI-Business-Coaching

Nicht passend für Dich, wenn...

Nicht passend für Dich, wenn …

  • Du KI-Projekte bisher gesteuert oder begleitet, aber nicht selbst technisch umgesetzt hast,

  • Deine KI-Systeme ausschließlich mit No-Code-Tools entstanden sind,

  • Du am liebsten nur im Code bleibst und Kundentermine, Workshops oder Gespräche mit der Geschäftsführung lieber anderen überlässt

Qualifikation

Was Du mitbringst

Technisches Fundament:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im MINT-Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Data Science). Alternativ mehrere Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung. Zertifikatskurse und Weiterbildungen ersetzen das nicht.

  • Mindestens ein KI-System, das Du selbst konzipiert und umgesetzt hast und zeigen kannst, z. B. eine RAG-Pipeline, einen produktiven Agenten oder eine technisch verantwortete Automatisierung

  • Du programmierst sicher (z. B. Python) und arbeitest mit APIs, Datenbanken und Deployment. Reine No-Code- oder Low-Code-Erfahrung reicht für diese Rolle nicht.

  • Du kannst technische Entscheidungen begründen, z. B. warum Du ein Modell, eine Chunking-Strategie oder einen Cloud- statt lokalen Betrieb gewählt hast und wo deren Grenzen liegen

Beratungserfahrung:

  • 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens 2 Jahre mit direktem Kundenkontakt in technischen Projekten, z. B. als Technical Consultant, Solutions Engineer, Solution Architect, Data-/AI-Consultant, technische Projektleitung oder Freelancer mit eigenen Kunden. Interne Fachbereiche als Kunden zählen auch.

  • Du hast Anforderungen aufgenommen, Workshops moderiert und Entscheidungen bei Stakeholdern herbeigeführt, auch auf Geschäftsführungsebene

  • Du kannst einem Kunden sagen, dass sein Wunsch-Use-Case keinen Sinn ergibt, und ihm eine bessere Alternative zeigen

Außerdem wichtig:

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) in Wort und Schrift

  • Gutes Englisch, Wohnsitz in Deutschland und Bereitschaft zu Kundenterminen vor Ort

Was wir bieten

  • Projektverantwortung ab dem ersten Mandat, ohne Layer über Dir; direkter Draht zum Founding-Team

  • Beide Welten in einer Rolle: selbst bauen und selbst beraten, ohne Übergaben zwischen Beratung und Entwicklung

  • Ein Team, das technisch auf Augenhöhe diskutiert: Austausch mit der KI-Elite in Deutschland

  • Framework-driven statt ad hoc, und Du gestaltest die Frameworks mit

  • Wert statt Stunden: Uns zählen Ergebnisse, nicht Tagessätze

  • Moderner Tech-Stack und Raum zum Experimentieren

  • Sichtbarkeit als Expertise über unsere KI-Business-Coaching-Community und die TÜV-SÜD-Kooperation

  • Voll-remote möglich; Teamtage und Kundenworkshops vor Ort, üblicherweise 2–4 Tage im Monat im DACH-Raum

Bewerbung: Bring Dein Projekt mit!

Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte kurz zwei Fragen:

  1. Dein Projekt (3–5 Sätze): Welches KI-System würdest Du uns im Zweitgespräch zeigen? Was löst es, wie ist es aufgebaut, welchen Teil hast Du selbst umgesetzt, und welche technische Entscheidung hast Du dabei bewusst getroffen? Ein Link zu GitHub, einem Demo-Video o. Ä. ist willkommen.

  2. Dein Kunde (2–3 Sätze): Beschreib eine Situation, in der Du einen Kunden oder Fachbereich von einer technischen Entscheidung überzeugt oder seine Erwartungen korrigiert hast. Was war die Ausgangslage, was hast Du getan, was kam heraus?

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich, Dein Projekt und Deine Kundengeschichte kennenzulernen!

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior Applied AI Engineer (all genders), you work like a forward deployed engineer, embedded with our internal teams. AI is reshaping how we work: you find where it has the highest impact, decide what is worth building, and then build it. You work closely with team leads across departments and within our Data & AI team.

The role combines discovery and hands-on engineering: you split your time between working with teams and building the solutions yourself. User pain points are often vague at first, and priorities change as we learn which use cases hold up. Once a solution works, you hand it over and move on to the next problem.

Pure coding, pure advisory work or polishing a single system for months are not part of the job. If turning unclear problems into working AI solutions is your thing, you’ll feel at home here.

As we are looking for a hands-on engineer, a coding interview is an integral part of our interview process.

What to expect

  • Discovery: Shadow processes and interview the people doing the work. Quantify and validate where time and quality are lost.

  • Prioritization: Prioritize use cases across departments by impact, not by what is easiest or needs the most advanced tooling, and say no to the ones that don’t hold up.

  • Make or buy: Test existing tools and new AI providers against our use cases before building.

  • Build and ship: Build the solution yourself: LLM based systems, traditional ML, rule based automation, or a combination, depending on the problem. Ship a first usable version within weeks, integrated into the tools people already use, and iterate based on feedback.

  • Measure success: Define success upfront: business outcome, adoption and metrics that measure output quality.

  • Own the outcome: Own each solution until it has a clear outcome: handed over to our Platform team or the domain team, or shut down.

  • Platform: Build on our AI & Data platform and feed back what it needs next.

Inspire us by

  • Background: 5+ years in software engineering, data science or ML engineering, including at least 1 year shipping LLM based products. Scale-up experience and close work with business teams such as operations or sales are a plus.

  • Discovery experience: You have found and scoped problems yourself, working directly with users, and turned them into a quantified case for or against solving them.

  • Technical skills: Strong Python skills and a solid understanding of core GenAI concepts and building blocks, including RAG, tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, and evaluation (Evals). Experience with traditional machine learning techniques (e.g., XGBoost) and SQL is a plus.

  • End-to-end delivery: You have taken at least one AI project from an unclear business problem to production, implemented it end to end and can show how you measured its output quality.

  • Analytical thinking & communication: You bring structure to ambiguous problems and explain technical trade-offs to non technical teams. You defend your decisions on which use cases to pursue and work as an equal with stakeholders.

  • Mindset: Proactive and comfortable driving topics in unclear situations. You don’t wait for requirements, you find the problem worth solving.

  • Language skills: Fluent English (C1); German is a plus.

What we offer

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward senior engineers to be part of our early team at Resonance. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you’ll lead Resonance’s most ambitious client engagements. You will design and build production AI systems to drive a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier, own end-to-end deployments, and lead a team of AI engineers to build at pace. You’ll set the technical direction, advising CTOs and engineering leads of leading enterprises and owning security, reliability and governance for everything we put into production. You’ll lead the build from first prototype to production while staying hands-on in the code, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems, and setting the bar for code quality, evals and observability. You’ll grow the firm by building Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning patterns from client work into reusable components, and coaching the engineers on your team as one of our first technical leaders.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency and a bias for action, thrive on ambiguity, and are AI-obsessed, getting hands-on with new models and tools the day they hit the market. You typically have 5+ years building software, including technical lead or architect responsibility for a production AI system. You might be a senior, staff or principal engineer at an AI-first company or scale-up, a lead forward deployed engineer, a technical lead at an AI consultancy or an AI lab’s applied team, or the founder of your own company. You write production Python or TypeScript, have designed and shipped LLM systems in production, including agents, retrieval and evals, and design for how they fail. You’ve led engineering teams and raised their bar, make clear decisions under uncertainty, and are commercial and comfortable problem solving with technical and non-technical execs.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Most engineers get one shot at a startup. Here you build many products, not one: our own AI products and platform, and several production AI systems a year across industries. Your work drives tangible outcomes for consequential companies, alongside a team aiming to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe and worldwide. Europe is falling behind on AI, and every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity chasm. As one of our early joiners, you’ll shape how we build, operate and grow.

Logistics: London, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in the UK and Europe. English is our working language. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Apply

Send your CV, your GitHub profile and a short note on the AI system you're proudest of shipping and the impact it delivered.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Senior Applied Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Meet the team

You’ll join the Traffic Control Features team within TomTom’s Automated Driving organization. The team builds the technology that turns real-world observations into reliable map information about traffic signs, traffic lights, stop lines and road markings.

You’ll work with applied scientists and software engineers to develop algorithms and machine-learning solutions that detect, position and connect these features to the right roads and driving directions. The goal is to deliver accurate, scalable map content that supports navigation and advanced driving experiences. TomTom measures these features using quality dimensions such as recall, precision, and road-relation accuracy.


What you will do:
  • Develop algorithms and ML solutions for traffic signs, traffic lights, road markings, and other traffic-control features, including projects with Computer Vision and Image Recognition.
  • Design and productionize solutions that extract reliable map information from diverse, large-scale and noisy real-world data sources, including car sensor data and unstructured information.
  • Improve how features are detected, positioned, and associated with the correct road/lane and driving direction.
  • Drive measurable improvements in recall, precision, and overall map quality against customer-facing targets.
  • Own components of production pipelines, from input data and feature extraction through evaluation and validated map output.
  • Solve complex problems involving geospatial geometry, map matching, computer vision, image recognition, noisy observations, ground-truth quality, and large-scale evaluation.
  • Run experiments, translate successful approaches into production solutions, and clearly document outcomes.
  • Use AI tools, such as Claude Code, to support problem solving, data analysis, implementation, and engineering productivity.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Ledger Platform
descriptionHtml:
Senior Backend Engineer - Ledger Platform

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Ledger Platform team.

You'll design and build iwoca's new ledger platform – the distributed system that records every movement of money, starting with the business credit card and moving on to loans.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Ledger Platform team is rebuilding all of iwoca’s ledgers as one platform, starting with the ledger for the business credit card. Every card payment, loan repayment, and payout will end up there. Finance, Accounting, and Capital Markets rely on that record, so it has to be right every time.

The team is small – a principal engineer who leads it, a staff engineer, another engineer, and you. It works closely with the product teams that build on its ledgers, and with Finance.

The role

You'll lead projects from design to production, and decide with product what the team builds and how. With the principal engineer, you'll design the platform's service boundaries and the APIs and event streams other teams build on. Most of the platform is still to be built, and you’ll own part of it yourself. It’s a hands-on individual contributor role with high ownership and no line management.

Every payment a small business makes with iwoca crosses several services and network hops before it reaches the ledger, and any of them can fail. You'll build services that record each one exactly once, with no single point of failure, safe timeouts and retries, and graceful degradation when a dependency is down. When something breaks in production, you'll fix it so it doesn't break again.

You’ll learn iwoca’s financial products in depth, so you can challenge requirements and explain technical trade-offs to Finance. When the answer isn’t obvious, you’ll scope and prototype, and use domain modelling to find the simple design behind a complicated problem. You’ll influence which parts of a problem need solving now, which can wait, and which aren’t worth solving at all.

Live project examples:

  • New ledgers. Building the ledgers for Flexi-Loan and iwocaPay.

  • Account migration. Moving existing loan accounts onto the new ledgers with zero downtime and no data lost.

  • Credit card ledger. Building new features for the credit card ledger, from real-time card holds to daily interest and monthly statements.

  • Reconciliation and journals. Reconciling the ledger with banks, payment providers, and the card scheme, and producing the accounting journals Finance relies on.

  • Funding facilities. Recording how loans move between iwoca’s funding facilities.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Distributed systems. You’ve built and run fault-tolerant services in production, and handled the hard parts: durable communication between services, idempotency, transactional correctness, and partial failure.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You’ve written and run backend services in it.

  • Databases. You’ve worked in depth with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, and solved data integrity, concurrency, and performance problems in them.

  • Ownership. You’ve led projects involving several engineers end to end, and mentored the people around you.

  • Testing. You’ve tested for edge cases and failures as carefully as you designed for them.

  • AI leverage. You’ve built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Financial systems. You’ve built ledgers, billing, or payment systems, including the audit trails and reconciliation that prove they’re correct.

  • High volume. You’ve worked at a company where the volume of data or transactions shaped how you designed systems.

  • Migrations. You’ve moved live systems and data onto a new platform with zero downtime.

  • Python. You’ve used Python in production, with a web framework such as Django, FastAPI, or Flask. It’s the language the team works in.

  • Data tooling. You’ve built pipelines with Snowflake and dbt, or similar, that turn ledger data into reports for Finance.

  • Messaging. You’ve built asynchronous messaging with queues or topics, such as Kafka.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £120,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation: £100K – £120K

title: Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders), you will own the development of safety-critical electronics for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. You will design compact, high-density mixed-signal hardware that accurately monitors, controls and protects large lithium-ion battery assemblies during charging, ground operation and flight.

This is a hands-on role covering the complete hardware lifecycle: requirements, architecture, circuit design, prototype bring-up, verification, qualification, production release and certification evidence.

Working closely with BMS software, battery systems, safety, PCB layout, mechanical integration, thermal systems, testing and manufacturing, you will turn the propulsion battery’s safety and control concepts into flight-ready, certifiable electronic hardware.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the architecture and detailed design of battery management units, cell-monitoring electronics and associated sensing, communication and protection circuits.

  • Translate system, interface and safety requirements into complete, traceable and verifiable hardware requirements.

  • Design accurate measurement circuits for cell voltage, temperature, pack voltage, current and other battery sensors.

  • Develop high-density mixed-signal electronics incorporating battery-monitoring AFEs, balancing circuits, microcontrollers, watchdogs, memory, isolated communications and power supplies.

  • Define the PCB architecture and layout constraints for multilayer HDI assemblies, including fine-pitch components, microvias, grounding, signal and power integrity, EMC, thermal management, creepage and clearance.

  • Perform circuit simulation, tolerance analysis, worst-case circuit analysis, component derating, FMEA/FMECA and reliability assessment.

  • Work with Systems and Safety Engineering to implement fault detection, diagnostic coverage, independence and safe-state behaviour in accordance with the allocated Design Assurance Level.

  • Develop and maintain DO-254/ED-80 lifecycle evidence, including hardware requirements, design data, traceability, verification results, review records and problem reports.

  • Lead prototype bring-up, debugging, integration and fault-injection testing using cell simulators and flight-representative hardware.

  • Support DO-160G environmental and EMC qualification, DO-311A battery-system testing and transfer into repeatable production through DFM, DFT and manufacturing-test development.

  • Collaborate closely with BMS software, battery systems, PCB layout, mechanical, thermal, testing, manufacturing and certification teams.

  • Lead hardware design reviews, resolve test and production failures and mentor less-experienced engineers.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related field.

  • Seven or more years of experience developing complex electronic hardware from architecture through verification and production release.

  • Proven experience with BMS hardware, battery-monitoring electronics or comparable high-channel-count, safety-critical mixed-signal systems.

  • Strong expertise in precision analogue measurement, ADC signal chains, filtering, current and voltage sensing, galvanic isolation and fault-tolerant power supplies.

  • Demonstrable experience designing high-density multilayer electronics, including HDI technology, fine-pitch BGA/QFN devices, microvias, power distribution, grounding and thermal constraints.

  • Strong digital-hardware knowledge involving microcontrollers, memories, watchdogs, CAN/CAN FD, SPI, I²C and isolated serial interfaces.

  • Hands-on experience developing airborne electronic hardware under DO-254/ED-80 is essential. Experience at DAL B or DAL A and supporting formal certification reviews is strongly preferred.

  • Proficiency with professional ECAD and simulation tools such as Altium Designer, Cadence, Siemens EDA, LTspice or equivalent. Altium experience is preferred.

  • Confident laboratory skills and experience with prototype bring-up, automated testing, environmental qualification, failure analysis and electronics manufacturing.

  • Familiarity with CS-23, ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-160G and DO-311A is advantageous.

  • Fluent English is essential; German is beneficial.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Senior Business Analysts specializing in M&A transactions and strategy consulting to support the origination, evaluation, and execution of acquisitions, divestitures, investments, and strategic partnerships. The role bridges corporate strategy with rigorous commercial and financial analysis, evaluating companies, assets, and transactions across a broad range of industries.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct commercial, financial, and operational due diligence on target companies and assets, integrating inputs from legal, tax, technical, and other specialist advisors.

  • Build and maintain financial models (DCF, LBO, merger and accretion/dilution, sum-of-the-parts, comparable transactions and companies) for valuations and corporate transactions.

  • Support the full M&A deal cycle, from origination and screening through valuation, structuring, negotiation support, and closing, on both buy-side and sell-side mandates.

  • Deliver corporate and business-unit strategy work, including market sizing, industry and competitive analysis, growth strategies, portfolio reviews, and investment theses.

  • Prepare investment memoranda, information memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board- and investment-committee-level presentations.

  • Monitor M&A activity, capital markets, sector trends, and the competitive landscape to identify and prioritize opportunities.

  • Support deal execution, including data room management, coordination with legal teams, advisors, and counterparties, and review of transaction documents (term sheets, SPAs, shareholder agreements).

  • Assess regulatory, geopolitical, ESG, and integration risks, and contribute to synergy assessment and post-merger integration planning.

  • Structure and evaluate transaction alternatives, including asset vs. share deals, joint ventures, minority stakes, earn-outs, deferred and contingent consideration, and structured or hybrid financing (e.g., royalties, streams, prepays, offtakes), and assess their impact on value and counterparty risk.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in M&A, investment banking, transaction advisory, private equity, corporate development, or strategy consulting.

  • Hands-on exposure to live M&A transactions (buy-side and/or sell-side) is highly desirable.

  • Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).

  • Demonstrated experience with strategy consulting methods and structured problem solving (hypothesis-driven analysis, market and competitive assessment).

  • Working knowledge of transaction structures and documentation (term sheets, SPAs, shareholder agreements) and of acquisition financing instruments.

  • Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.

  • Ability to translate complex commercial, operational, and financial information into clear investment recommendations.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with financial databases (e.g., Capital IQ, Bloomberg, PitchBook) is an advantage.

  • English fluent

  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.

  • Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.

Preferred / Advantageous

  • Sector experience in mining and metals, agribusiness, or infrastructure.

  • Experience with cross-border transactions.

  • Additional languages and willingness to travel to target companies, assets, and counterparties.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Senior Client Enablement & Coaching Lead (F/H/X)
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

  • Fluent English & French is a prerequisite

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • You are based in and around Paris and are willing to go to the office 2-3 times per week

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

Please submit your resume in English 🇬🇧

This position involves travelling across different European countries 🚃.

You may see this role listed as "Client Enablement and Coaching Lead". This is to help the right people find it. The actual job title is Client Delivery Lead.

title: Senior Content Writer at Retail Insights
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about finding or creating great stories and content? If so, you might be our Senior Content Writer.

About us

Retail Insights is Northern Europe’s leading retail forum. We are strengthening the retail ecosystem by building a platform for insights, inspiration, and networking, connecting more than 3,000 leaders yearly from more than 15 countries.

Retail Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

As our Senior Content Writer you have the unique opportunity to be part of building the greatest brand within Insurtech. By providing you with the ownership of our magazines, we want to constantly push you out of your comfort zone. You’ll be working out of our HQ in London and to ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

• An opportunity for getting operational experience in a scale-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matters to the business
• A chance to work closely together with our CEO
• Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally

• Thoroughly research industry-related topics and ideas for stories and articles

• Construct the magazines including photos, design and artwork (with help from our Graphic Designer)

title: Senior Cryptography Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1893 

ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.

Responsibilities:

You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.

  • Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS
  • Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.

You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

  • Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C/C++/Rust skills
  • Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise

Preferred Qualifications:

You want to grow into a world-class applied cryptographer by working on real products with demanding correctness and security requirements, and you enjoy the discipline of code that must be provably right.

What We Offer:

  • A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world
  • A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence
  • Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career
  • Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track
  • A career development plan within the IonQ group’s companies
  • A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts
  • A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

title: Senior Data Product Manager - HF
descriptionHtml:
Senior Data PM, Paris

Un dashboard de plus qui dort dans un drive. Tu as déjà vu ça, et tu sais ce qui manquait : quelqu'un qui décide.

Ce qui t'intéresse maintenant, ce n'est plus la donnée. C'est ce qu'on en fait.

Chez Hubvisory, tu relies la stratégie data de grands comptes à de la valeur produit concrète, à l'échelle d'un programme entier. Tu penses portefeuille de cas d'usage. Tu arbitres entre plusieurs squads. Et quand la priorité data numéro un d'un client n'est pas la bonne, tu le lui dis.

Ce que tu fais

Tu décides

  • Tu choisis les cas d'usage data à fort impact métier, sur tout un portefeuille

  • Tu construis la roadmap (innovation, industrialisation, run) avec une vision qui dépasse le trimestre

  • Tu tranches les choix structurants : architecture, qualité des sources, mise en prod

Tu fais avancer plusieurs squads en même temps

  • Tu coordonnes Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers et ML Engineers, en parallèle

  • Tu garantis la fiabilité en production : SLO, monitoring, alerting, post-mortems

Tu prouves que ça sert

  • Tu définis les KPIs de valeur et tu mesures l'adoption réelle de ce que tu déploies

Tu fais monter les autres

  • Tu structures la montée en compétence de PM Data plus juniors, sur un domaine qui bouge vite

Où ça te mène
PM Data de référence en environnement grand compte. Puis, selon ton appétence : Product Leader, référent Data & IA ou Manager Conseil.

Ce que tu gagnes à nous rejoindre

  • Des missions data et IA chez des leaders : Danone, Kering, SNCF

  • Une progression qui n'attend pas : revalorisation salariale tous les 6 mois

  • Une part du résultat : intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits, redistribué à parts égales

  • Une montée en compétence réelle : formation immersive à l'arrivée, 1000h de contenus au Hubvisory Campus, et Rocketto, notre plateforme e-learning IA maison

  • Un cadre qui compte : Hubvisory est signataire du Parental Challenge

Rémunération
52-58K€ bruts fixes (Paris) + variable + participation aux résultats (jusqu'à 22% des bénéfices) + prime vacances (1% du fixe)

Ton profil
5 à 6 ans en Product Management, dont au moins 3 ans sur des produits data, Analytics ou IA, avec une vraie autonomie stratégique.

Les incontournables

  • Une culture data solide : data warehouse, ETL/ELT, cloud, SQL, concepts ML et Analytics

  • La capacité à challenger un sujet technique (APIs, modèles de données, architecture)

  • Une expérience de mentorat auprès de profils plus juniors

Ce qui fera la différence

  • MLOps (Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow), dataviz (Power BI, Looker), gouvernance data (RGPD, IA Act)

  • Plusieurs produits data menés jusqu'en production, à l'échelle d'un programme

  • Un passage en grand compte ou en conseil

Côté posture : rigueur analytique, leadership transverse qui dépasse ta squad, communication qui s'impose face à des interlocuteurs de haut niveau.

Le process

  1. Échange avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist pour valider le fit mutuel

  2. Cas pratique en live avec un manager (90 min)

  3. Entretien de projection avec un VP

  4. Proposition d'embauche par téléphone

Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum.

Si tu veux pousser encore, je peux durcir l'accroche (par exemple "Ton dashboard est beau. Personne ne l'ouvre.") ou raccourcir la partie missions.
