title: Senior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Wolt powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Berlin team. In this role, you'll drive high-quality decision-making to maximise impact.

We're hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.

About Our Data Science Organisation

We have an outstanding Data Science organisation, with a mission to drive the highest quality decision-making across our marketplace. We work throughout the company, in product, operations, and platform teams and are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Wolt. We are great communicators, and move fast to serve our customers a little better every day.

Our community is highly active, and Data Scientists can progress equally as IC leads or managers.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science; many are not.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the front lines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Our humble expectations

  • 5+ years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science position.
  • Expertise in statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing and experimentation (A/B testing and causal inference) using statistical software packages in Python, R, or equivalent for product development.
  • Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets.
  • Prior experience building intuitive data visualizations and dashboards that influence business decisions, utilizing tools like Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar.
  • Clear and concise communication with strong cross-functional partnership experience.
  • Relentless pursuit of new ideas and data sources, and the ability to systematically tackle ambiguous problems with a data-driven, hypothesis-based approach.
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English.

What we offer

  • The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
  • You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Helsinki or Stockholm. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the locations above 💙
  • You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Product+ Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via -----

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: (Senior) Data Systems Lead
descriptionHtml:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality.

Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets.

We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.

OEGEN Data, Tech & Transformation Team

We are embarking on a comprehensive transformation program designed to drive significant advancements in our business operations and technology landscape. Our primary goal is to transition from our current reliance on legacy systems and specialized off-the-shelf tools to a more integrated, AI-driven, and data-centric operational model.

Leveraging insights and guidance from our other technically mature entities like Kraken and OE, we plan to adopt cutting-edge tools and capabilities, particularly in AI and Python-driven solutions.

By investing in a diverse range of skills, we aim to create a hybrid team capable of operating in both our legacy and future environments, ultimately transforming OEGEN into an efficient, data-driven organization.

About the role

The tools are already here. Like the rest of OE Group, OEGEN runs on Databricks, we're moving onto our own Microsoft 365 tenant, and Octopus Energy Group gives us access to a powerful set of shared data and AI capabilities. What we're missing is someone whose job is to make all of it work together for our Fund Management business - and then build genuinely useful things on top of it.

This is a two-sided role. On one side, you'll integrate: wiring third-party systems, internal apps and document storage into the environment we already have, setting sensible guardrails around access and cost, and adopting existing Group capability wherever it does the job rather than rebuilding it. On the other, you'll build: turning those connections into data products, internal tools and AI-enabled workflows that fund management, asset management and finance use every day. Tying the two together, you'll develop and own the playbook - the documented, repeatable patterns for how a new system gets connected, how a tool gets built and shipped, and how both get supported afterwards - so that what you learn once becomes how the whole team works. The two halves feed each other: you'll understand what's possible because you built the plumbing, and you'll build better plumbing because you know what people actually do with it.

We want someone with genuine ideas about where AI can take a business like ours, and the pragmatism to ship them. Our team has already built an Excel data mart plugin that puts gold-layer tables directly in the hands of non-technical staff, a metrics taxonomy app that keeps third-party definitions aligned with our own, and AI-assisted workflows that scaffold documentation automatically. There's a long list of things we haven't got to yet. Expect roughly half your time on integration and enablement and half on building, and expect to work closely with the central data platform team so what we do in OEGEN stays consistent with the wider estate and our specific needs get onto their roadmap.


What You'll Do

  • Integrate the systems our business runs on - third-party providers, internal tools, our own SharePoint and Microsoft 365 tenant - into our existing Databricks environment, via APIs and existing connectors.

  • Build data products on top of what you connect: well-modelled, documented, reusable datasets that the business consumes directly through Excel, dashboards and natural-language querying, rather than one-off extracts.

  • Design and ship internal applications and AI-enabled tools - using Python, Streamlit, Databricks Apps (HTMX), Lakebase, FastAPI or similar - that put data and AI directly into the hands of fund management, asset management and finance teams.

  • Prototype, evaluate and productionise new AI capability, from document AI and retrieval to agentic workflows, and turn the ideas that prove out into supported products rather than abandoned experiments.

  • Take an adopt-first approach: work with Octopus Energy Group's data platform and AI teams to reuse capability that already exists, and configure it for OEGEN rather than building parallel versions of it.

  • Set up practical guardrails inside Databricks and Unity Catalog - schema and workspace access, permissions, environment hygiene - so more teams can use it without stepping on each other.

  • Bring cost management from reactive to proactive: tagging, budgets, alerting and usage monitoring, so Databricks and AI token spend can be attributed to the right team, project or fund before the invoice arrives.

  • Get our AI usage properly credentialed and logged - managed keys and access rather than API keys sitting in individual password managers - and provide clean patterns for embedding AI into the tools we build.

  • Standardise how we build and ship internal apps: shared templates, authentication, deployment and documentation, so a tool remains supportable by someone other than the person who wrote it.

  • Consolidate the ad-hoc scripts, spreadsheets and no-code workflows we've accumulated into fewer, better-understood integrations that don't need babysitting, and automate the repetitive parts of our own workflow.

  • Work directly with non-technical teams to understand their problems and translate them into things we can build.


What You'll Need

  • Strong systems integration experience - connecting business systems, SaaS tools and data sources via REST APIs, connectors and authentication flows.

  • A track record of building and shipping data products or internal applications that people actually use, not just pipelines that feed someone else's reports.

  • Solid Python and SQL, used daily for building, automation and data modelling.

  • Hands-on experience with a cloud data platform in production (Databricks preferred): workspaces, catalogs, permissions and compute.

  • Practical experience integrating AI into real tools - LLM APIs, retrieval, agents - with a clear-eyed sense of what works and what's still a demo.

  • Practical identity and access experience - SSO, service accounts, credential management and access lifecycle - enough to make sensible, secure choices without a security team holding your hand.

  • Experience with Microsoft 365 / SharePoint integration, or a comparable enterprise document and collaboration stack.

  • Real experience keeping cloud or AI usage costs under control: you know what drives the bill and how to attribute and cap it.

  • A pragmatist's instinct for adopting over building where infrastructure is concerned - you'd rather configure something that exists than write something new - paired with a bias toward shipping when it comes to solutions.

  • Clear communication. You can explain a trade-off to a fund manager and hold your own in a technical review with a central engineering team.

  • Comfort with real ownership in a small team, where you set the working patterns rather than inherit them.


Bonus Points For

  • Full-stack or application development experience, particularly with Streamlit, FastAPI or HTMX.

  • Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem - Unity Catalog, Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Genie - or equivalent tooling.

  • Experience with vector search, embeddings, document AI or retrieval-augmented generation in production.

  • Experience with Terraform, GitHub Actions or similar, to keep configuration version-controlled and repeatable.

  • FinOps experience: usage monitoring, budgets, showback and chargeback.

  • Having supported analysts and non-specialist builders using a shared data environment.

  • Experience in a regulated or audited setting such as financial services, infrastructure investment or energy.

  • Familiarity with renewable energy, infrastructure investment or financial services data.

title: Senior Field Marketing Executive - UKI
descriptionHtml:
Who we are?

Silverfin is a cutting-edge cloud software solution built by accountants, for accountants.

Founded in 2013, Silverfin was created to solve the frustrations of manual, error-prone processes in analysing financial data and compliance. From day one, we’ve been a cloud-first platform with an open API architecture, leveraging structured data to transform how accountants work.

Our mission is simple: to enhance and support the accountancy profession through AI and automation, ensuring accountants remain relevant and respected in the future of finance.

In 2023, Silverfin became part of the Visma Group, joining one of Europe’s leading providers of cloud software. This partnership strengthens our ability to innovate and expand our impact within the accountancy industry.

Today, Silverfin is trusted by over +1000 firms across 19 countries. Our clients include all of the Big 4 accounting firms, as well as leading global networks like BDO, PKF, Baker Tilly, Grant Thornton, and Moore.

Headquartered in Ghent, with offices in Mont-Saint-Guibert (BE), London (UK), Luxembourg (LU), and Gouda (NL), we’re a team of over 200 people - including a diverse remote engineering team working across multiple time zones - all working together to drive innovation in accounting.

How would you support our success?

Your role

We are on the lookout for a Senior Field Marketing Executive to join our team in the UKI.

Your focus area will include a mix of marketing and event activities. You will be supporting events, digital, customer and partner marketing, and other field marketing activities in UKI, from our office in London. The position also includes occasional off-site event coordination mostly during office hours.

That means organising events with project boards on Monday.com, messaging, creatives, stakeholders and budgets will be a very important responsibility in this role, next to regular marketing campaigns to our audience of accounting practices in the region.

As part of this journey, you'll be in sync with a fantastic team of 15 marketing team members across UKI, Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg & Denmark. You’ll report to our Senior Manager Global Field Marketing, based at our head office in Ghent, Belgium. Your main focus region is the UKI. We provide a permanent contract on a full-time basis.

Silverfin moves fast with a constant flow of activities for both users and prospects, not to mention our incredible team. We also prioritise the well-being of our people, offering a range of initiatives. Envision yourself joining our international Marketing team and a diverse, motivated team, and growing along with Silverfin.

Your responsibilities

  • Collaborate with your BU stakeholders to define and refine the marketing plan for the UKI.

  • Work closely with the global marketing demand generation team based in Ghent. This team of specialists leads the execution of global targeted marketing campaigns aimed at generating leads and increasing demand utilising a variety of channels, including email, social media, PPC, and content marketing.

  • Work closely with the UKI sales team to ensure they have the marketing materials including assisting in the creation of sales enablement tools such as presentations, brochures, and case studies.

  • Plan, organise, and execute both hosted and 3rd party events from concept to completion. This includes venue selection, vendor management, promotional activities, and post-event analysis.

  • Measure and report on the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and events, using data to support decisions and improve future marketing strategies.

  • Liaise with product, sales, customer success and marketing teams to ensure cohesive brand messaging and optimise campaign success

  • Manage internal and external creative agencies to produce content such as video, copywriting, stand building etc.

  • Manage the marketing budget for the UKI with expenses and allocation of budget spends

  • Focus on ABM methodology using our existing framework and infrastructure, which is supported by the whole marketing department;

    • Improve account engagement in the UKI and account penetration in your target accounts for Tier 1 and 2 using a one-to-few approach. Expand the account-level ABM score with regional partners who provide engagement and buyer intent data. This complements the demand generation team, which runs a one-to-many digital strategy for Tier 3 and 4 accounts.

    • Report on ABM KPIs: account engagement, coverage across the buying committee, meetings booked, pipeline influenced and sourced, win rate and deal velocity

    • Showing ABM impact to senior leadership with clear, data-backed narratives

    • Testing, learning and improving programmes based on results

What will support your success?

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor/Master in Marketing

  • Proven marketing experience in B2B SaaS (5+ years)

  • But even more important is your eagerness to deliver results and proactive attitude.

Attitude and personality-related traits

We’re looking for someone who can work autonomously, has a pragmatic approach, and is eager to deliver results. You’re also happy to travel occasionally to our head office in Ghent for training, workshops and meetings with your manager and most of the global marketing team.

Skills and knowledge

  • Essential:

    • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to write clear, persuasive copy for a UKI professional audience

    • Strong planning & prioritising skills. Organised (KANBAN), punctual (Deadlines), and meticulous (Quality).

    • Salesforce: create campaigns, dashboards, and reports for your campaigns

    • Hubspot - follow up on emails, landing pages, segmentation

    • Tools like “Monday”, “Slack”, “Google Drive/Docs/Sheets”, “Canva”, “Eventbrite”, “Wordpress”

    • Event management of in-person events

  • Big Plus:

    • Comfortable running webinars/podcasts

    • Experience in devising & executing a marketing plan + budget

    • Experience with ABM programmatic and 1 to few

We care for you

Be part of something bigger - Join a growing SaaS company that’s now proudly part of Visma, Europe’s leader in mission-critical cloud software.

A connected team - Take part in regular team activities, retreats, and offsites to keep our culture thriving.

Grow with us - Take advantage of career development opportunities and a personal training allowance to support your growth.

Time to recharge - Enjoy our company-wide Wellbeing Days off each month (reviewed annually).

Flexibility with connection - We have a hybrid setup, with a minimum of two days a week in the office. However, we understand that life can be unpredictable, so we offer flexibility to accommodate unexpected events. Our offices in Belgium (Ghent and Mont-Saint-Guibert), the UK (London), the Netherlands (Gouda), and Luxembourg provide great spaces to collaborate and connect.

Fair compensation - Receive a competitive rewards package with benefits tailored to your role.

How we work

At Silverfin, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. We're committed to elevating talent by creating an environment where we can all thrive together.

We have a unique culture with our values ​​as the backbone:

Who we are -Authentically human

How we think -With a growth mindset

How we act -Bravely, side by side

How we win -By doing what we love

At Silverfin we make our own way. We are constantly looking for new and innovative ways to move forward. Continuous learning and development is encouraged to support your personal and professional growth.

At the same time, this opens up many new opportunities that allow our people to grow with Silverfin, and often faster than with other companies. So many ambitious team members have already found their way to a new challenge within Silverfin.

We want you to reach your full potential. To get you there, we don't want to think in boxes and over-structure things. So your options are not limited to 1 team or 1 career track. Your talent, motivation and potential play a crucial role in evolving across the teams into new roles.

title: Senior Financial Accountant
descriptionHtml:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

As we grow, the finance function has to keep pace: fast, accurate, and increasingly automated. You'll drive the month end close, build and maintain a high bar for internal control, and support the preparation of our statutory financial statements and annual audit completion. As you grow in the role, the ambition is for you to also take ownership of group consolidation and become the financial reporting engine of the business.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

Reporting, Close and Consolidation

  • Own the month end and year end close against the group close calendar, preparing journals, accruals and prepayments, completing balance sheet reconciliations and delivering the reporting pack, with hands-on support while you build up to running it independently.

  • Support group consolidation across our entities, including intercompany reconciliations, eliminations and FX.

Technical Accounting

  • Support technical accounting assessments, ad hoc finance projects and the development of group accounting policies (for example leases and share based payments), helping prepare papers and notes on judgemental areas and complex transactions.

Statutory Reporting and Audit

  • Manage the PBC list and audit request tracker, and support the wider external audit process, maintaining auditor relationships and contributing to remediation of any audit findings.

  • Support preparation of the UK statutory financial statements and, alongside external advisors, compliance across our other jurisdictions.

Controls, Systems and Process

  • Own process improvement and automation across the function, documenting changes as you build them and using AI and modern workflow tools, including NetSuite, to speed up the close and find efficiencies.

  • Support the group's financial controls and risk framework (RCM): help document key controls, carry out testing, identify gaps, and put together remediation plans.

About you

  • You're a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) with 1-2 years of PQE and a solid grounding in financial reporting and controls, built through practice, industry or a multi-entity environment. The exact route matters less than the instinct for clean, well controlled numbers.

  • You treat financial processes as products, not just tasks: when you spot a control gap or a messy reconciliation, you dig into why it happened and build a scalable solution, not just patch it once and move on.

  • You're comfortable getting hands-on with close and consolidation work, journals, reconciliations, intercompany eliminations and FX, across multiple entities and jurisdictions, and you can move quickly without cutting corners on control.

  • You communicate clearly and build trust easily with auditors, external advisors and internal stakeholders.

  • You're curious about how automation or AI can make a financial process faster or more reliable, and NetSuite experience (or a comparable ERP) means you can get going quickly.

  • You're highly adaptable with a strong willingness to learn. You see tasks outside of your job description as an opportunity to expand your skillset and tackle them head on.

We know not every strong candidate will tick every box. If this role sounds like the right fit, we'd encourage you to apply.

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer
descriptionHtml:
FULL TIME, 5 DAYS ONSITE

LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER

THE LAST FRONTIER

The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox—an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence—is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE
We’re looking for a Firmware Engineer to join our small team developing high-reliability firmware for some of the most challenging environments on earth. Working on 32-bit Arm Cortex-M processors, you’ll own firmware architecture, development, testing and debugging across ARD’s products, from low-level drivers through to networking and application logic, and work closely with our hardware engineers from bring-up to field deployment. We want you to use your experience to make key technical decisions, challenge the team constructively, and balance delivery against long-term quality, so that our products are dependable enough for the Arctic.

* Please note: this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship *

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design & Development — Design, develop and maintain firmware in C for Arm Cortex-M microcontrollers, writing efficient, reliable and well-documented code.

  • Hardware Integration — Work closely with the hardware team on board bring-up and on integrating sensors, communication interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART) and peripheral devices.

  • Testing & Debugging — Test and validate firmware at unit, integration and system level, diagnosing issues on real hardware with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and debug probes.

  • RTOS & Boot Systems — Develop RTOS-based and interrupt-driven firmware, along with bootloaders and OTA update mechanisms, to meet strict timing and reliability requirements.

  • Code Quality & Version Control — Maintain high code quality through peer review, coding standards and Git-based release management.

  • Team & Collaboration — Pick up, improve and extend existing designs as readily as building new ones, working alongside software, mechanical and QA colleagues on documentation, design reviews and compliance testing.

REQUIREMENTS

Essential

  • 5+ years of embedded firmware development in C for Arm or equivalent processors.

  • Willingness to adopt and embrace an AI-accelerated development workflow.

  • Experience across the full software development life cycle: writing and gathering requirements, design documentation, design and code review, writing test plans and testing.

  • Experience with low-level comms interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART).

  • Experienced Git user.

  • Experience with RTOS and bare-metal design.

  • Understanding of bootloaders and OTA for updating multi-processor products.

  • Experience debugging on real hardware and confidence using basic equipment such as logic analysers and oscilloscopes.

  • Willingness to test in the field to prove functionality and compliance.

  • A self-driven attitude and the confidence to be the subject matter expert in a startup, combined with a collaborative approach and a willingness to build on others’ work.

Desirable

  • Experience with STM32 and Nordic nRF platforms.

  • Understanding of electronics design, such as reading schematics, and soldering.

  • TCP/IP and networking experience.

  • Embedded security experience, such as secure boot, signed or encrypted firmware updates, and awareness of regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act.

  • Experience with CI systems.

  • Experience in both regulated environments and R&D or rapid-prototyping environments.

  • A degree in a related engineering discipline such as software or electronics, though experience is valued more highly.


Future Security Clearance Requirements

As our business scales into the defence and security sectors, the responsibilities of this role are expected to evolve to include projects requiring UK Security Check (SC) clearance.

While an active clearance is not required to apply or start in this role, candidates must be willing and eligible to undergo UK Government security vetting in the future should project requirements dictate it.

To meet the standard eligibility criteria for UK standard SC vetting, you must typically have resided in the UK for the past 5 continuous years, hold a valid passport, and be capable of passing comprehensive background, financial, and criminal record checks.

Why ARD

The mission - The Arctic is the fastest-changing region on Earth. You'll build the intelligence layer that helps understand and steward it — an early-warning system for the planet's coldest edge.

Early stage, real influence - ARD is at an exciting early stage. You'll join while our products, team and culture are still taking shape, and your ideas will directly influence where we go next.

Ownership and accountability - We give people real responsibility from day one. You'll own your work end to end, be trusted to make decisions, and be accountable for delivering results that ship and get used.

A small but growing team - You'll work closely with experienced colleagues across science, software and hardware, with no layers in between. As we grow, you'll help build the team and the ways of working that come next.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation

  • Private Health Insurance from Day 1

  • Dental & Vision

  • Equity - meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company

  • Real field exposure - travel to Arctic sites and Outposts when needed

  • Mission-driven culture - focus on impact, not hours logged

ARD is an equal opportunities employer. We hire on merit, based on skills, experience and potential, and welcome applications from everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. We know great candidates sometimes hold back unless they tick every box, so if this role excites you but your experience doesn’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you, especially if you bring a background or perspective that is under-represented in science and engineering. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, just let us know at

Team organisation

Hands-on engineering

You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

What You'll Do

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

  • Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.

  • Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

  • At least five (5+) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.

GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.

title: Senior Konstrukteur
descriptionHtml:
Über pplwise

pplwise ist eine Recruiting-Beratung für schnell wachsende Technologieunternehmen in ganz Europa. Mit Recruiting as a Service und Executive Search besetzen wir Schlüsselpositionen für unsere Kunden – vom Start-up bis zum börsennotierten Unternehmen. Diese Position besetzen wir für unseren Kunden Filics.

Über unseren Kunden: Filics

Filics erfindet die Intralogistik neu – mit autonomen mobilen Robotern (AMR), die verändern, wie Material bewegt wird. Dank seines Double-Runner-Systems ist Filics der erste und einzige AMR, der durch Ladungsträger wie Europaletten hindurchfahren kann. Das bricht mit der Gabelstapler-Logik und setzt einen neuen Standard für Effizienz. Filics ist ein kleines, praxisorientiertes Team, das schwierige Probleme mit technischer Exzellenz löst. Führung übernimmt, wer Initiative zeigt und zuverlässig liefert. Als Senior Konstrukteur bei Filics leitest du die mechanische Konstruktion der Roboter auf dem Weg vom Prototyp zur Serienfertigung.

Die Rolle

Die Stelle ist vor Ort/hybrid in München, nah an Entwicklung und Montage.

Filics entwickelt seine Roboter-Hardware komplett selbst: Mechanik, Elektronik und Software. Die Auftragslage wächst, und die Roboter gehen vom Prototyp in die Serie. Konstruktionen, die im Labor funktioniert haben, müssen jetzt zuverlässig, in Stückzahl und zu den richtigen Kosten gebaut werden. Die schwierigsten Probleme liegen oft zwischen den Disziplinen: Teile, die für sich allein funktionieren, können versagen, sobald sie mit der Elektronik verbaut sind.

Das Mechanik-Team besteht aus vier Personen, die meisten am Anfang ihrer Karriere – und sie brauchen jemanden, der sie täglich anleitet. Du bist der technische Lead für die Mechanik des Produkts und das Gegenüber zum Elektronik-Lead, damit sich die aktuelle Mechanik-Leitung auf die Kernentwicklung konzentrieren kann. Deine Zeit teilt sich etwa zur Hälfte auf praktische Ingenieursarbeit und technische Führung auf. Du arbeitest eng mit Elektronik, Produktion, Einkauf und dem CTO zusammen und prägst die Arbeitsweise im Engineering, solange das Team noch klein ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du coachst das Mechanik-Team im Alltag: Du unterstützt bei Konstruktionsentscheidungen, legst Methoden fest und hältst Projekte im Fokus

  • Du konstruierst Bauteile und Baugruppen im CAD inklusive Tolerierung und prüfst jede Konstruktion vor der Freigabe auf Fertigbarkeit und Kosten

  • Du leitest Test und Integration von Mechanik und Elektronik und löst die Probleme, die erst im zusammengebauten Zustand auftreten

  • Du priorisierst eingehende Aufgaben, verfolgst den Fortschritt und triffst die täglichen technischen Entscheidungen in der Mechanik

  • Du setzt den Stage-Gate-Entwicklungsprozess in der Praxis um und führst Design Reviews (Sicherheit, Mechanik, Elektronik, Fertigbarkeit) durch, bevor Teile integriert werden

  • Du etablierst Design for Manufacturing und Design for Cost: weniger und standardisierte Teile sowie Fertigungsverfahren, die skalieren

  • Du arbeitest vom ersten Prototyp an eng mit den Elektronik-Verantwortlichen der einzelnen Robotermodule zusammen – und mit der Produktion an Fertigbarkeit und Fertigungsvorrichtungen

  • Du baust Prototypen und entwickelst sie auf Basis von Kunden- und Feldfeedback weiter

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der mechanischen Konstruktion in der Entwicklung eines Unternehmens, das eigene elektromechanische Produkte entwickelt und baut (z. B. Elektrowerkzeuge, Haushaltsgeräte, E-Mobilität, Produktionsmaschinen, Robotik, Schiffsantriebe)

  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung darin, ein elektromechanisches Produkt vom Prototyp in die Serie zu bringen (idealerweise 1.000+ Einheiten pro Jahr) – in einem schnellen Entwicklungszyklus von etwa einem Jahr, nicht in einem jahrzehntelangen Programm

  • Du konstruierst weiterhin selbst im CAD, vor allem Metallteile und Baugruppen, und bist sicher in der Tolerierung (CAD-Tool egal; Onshape ist ein Plus)

  • Du hast Design for Manufacturing und Design for Cost angewendet und Kosten durch Konstruktion gesenkt: weniger Teile, Normteile

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Mentoring oder in der fachlichen Führung von anderen im Engineering; ein Teamleitungstitel ist nicht erforderlich

  • Erfahrung im Testen und in der Integration von Mechanik und Elektronik

  • Du hast Prozesse, Design Reviews oder Engineering-Standards eingeführt, die einem Team geholfen haben, Ergebnisse zu liefern

  • Du gehst souverän mit unklaren Anforderungen um und zerlegst komplexe Probleme so, dass andere daran arbeiten können

  • Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, da in der Produktion überwiegend Deutsch gesprochen wird

  • Bonus: GD&T und Toleranzketten, Konstruktion von Fertigungsvorrichtungen oder Projekte mit Motoren, Motorsteuerungen oder Elektronik

Was Filics bietet

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in einer frühen Phase: Du prägst sowohl das Mechanik-Team als auch das Produkt

  • Echte Verantwortung für die Mechanik – vom ersten Prototyp bis zur Serienfertigung

  • Eine Mischung aus praktischer Ingenieursarbeit und Führung, mit Perspektive in Richtung Teamleitung und Engineering Management, während Filics wächst

  • Schnelle Entwicklungszyklen, getrieben von Kunden- und Feldfeedback

  • Ein kleines, hochkarätiges Team mit enger Zusammenarbeit zwischen Mechanik, Elektronik, Software und Produktion

  • Schnelles Wachstum: Ein Jahr bei Filics bringt dir so viel wie sonst viele Jahre in einem Großunternehmen

  • Eine Rolle vor Ort/hybrid in München, nah an Entwicklung und Montage

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf.

title: Senior Manager External Reporting
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

Volta is building AI-ready data centre infrastructure across the UK, Norway, Germany, Spain and the US, and is preparing for a US public listing following a Series A led by a16z and Altimeter. We will register on Form S-1 and report as a US domestic filer on Forms 10-K and 10-Q. Building the external reporting infrastructure - US GAAP consolidated financial statements, SEC-standard disclosures and a close process that can sustain a quarterly filing cadence - is one of Finance's defining projects over the next 12 to 16 months.

As Senior Manager, External Reporting you will own group consolidation and external reporting end to end: consolidating the group's UK, US and European entities, running the ASC 830 translation mechanics, preparing the US GAAP financial statements and footnotes, drafting the S-1 and the periodic filings that follow, and building the tie-out discipline expected of a registrant.

You will report to the VP Accounting and work alongside the Director of Technical Accounting, who owns accounting positions and policy. You will be central to S-1 preparation and to Volta's first audited financial statements.

This is a build role, and in the first year a hands-on one. There is no team beneath the role today. You will prepare the statements, write the footnotes and run the tie-out yourself, with support following as the function scales. If you are looking to direct the work rather than do it, this is not the right role.

The role is scoped to grow. As the reporting team builds beneath it and the filing cadence reaches steady state, we expect it to progress to Director.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the group consolidation across the UK, US and European entities, including intercompany elimination and ASC 830 foreign currency translation

  • Prepare US GAAP consolidated financial statements with full footnote disclosure, for audit and for filing

  • Draft SEC disclosures to registrant standard - the S-1 financial statement sections, MD&A support under Reg S-K Item 303, and the 10-K and 10-Q filings that follow - working with the Director of Technical Accounting, the VP Accounting and the wider team

  • Own the tie-out process: every number in the statements agreed to support, referenced and reviewable

  • Build the disclosure checklist and the annual and quarterly reporting calendar from scratch, and design a close timetable that meets a 10-Q filing deadline

  • Coordinate audit deliverables through first-year fieldwork and completion, and through the quarterly review cycles that follow

  • Sign off the US GAAP group numbers that feed the statutory bridge, working alongside the Statutory Reporting Manager who prepares the local IFRS accounts

  • Own the consolidated actuals that management and board reporting are built from, and review non-GAAP measures and their reconciliations

Häufige Fragen zum Loom-Video im Bewerbungsprozess

Wenn du dich bei uns bewirbst möchten wir ein Loom Video von dir erhalten. 🙏🏻

Warum wollt ihr ein Video statt eines Anschreibens? Weil wir in der Content-Branche arbeiten und uns ein kurzes Video in zwei Minuten mehr über dich sagt als jedes Anschreiben.

Was ist Loom und brauche ich einen Account? Loom ist ein kostenloses Tool, mit dem du dich selbst und/oder deinen Bildschirm aufnimmst und per Link teilst. Die kostenlose Version reicht völlig. Du kannst auch jedes andere Tool nutzen (z. B. Handyvideo über Google Drive) Hauptsache, wir können den Link öffnen.

Wie lang sollte das Video sein? 2–4 Minuten. Kürzer ist besser als länger – wenn du es knapp auf den Punkt bringst, ist das schon ein Pluspunkt.

Was soll ich im Video sagen? Stell dich kurz vor, erzähl, warum du zu RealStudio willst, und zeig uns ein Projekt, einen Kunden oder ein Ergebnis, auf das du stolz bist. Gerne mit geteiltem Bildschirm, z. B. Kampagnen, Reportings oder Content, an dem du beteiligt warst.

Muss das Video professionell aussehen? Nein. Kein Schnitt, keine Musik, kein Skript nötig. Wir bewerten nicht die Videoqualität, sondern dich. Ein ruhiger Ort und guter Ton reichen.

Auf Deutsch oder Englisch? Bitte auf Deutsch, da unsere Kunden überwiegend aus dem DACH-Raum kommen.

Wer sieht mein Video? Nur die Personen, die bei uns am Bewerbungsprozess beteiligt sind. Wir teilen es nicht weiter und löschen es nach Abschluss des Verfahrens.

Wie geht es nach dem Video weiter? Wir melden uns innerhalb von max 2 Werktagen bei dir. Wenn es passt, folgt ein Kennenlern-Call und danach ein Probetag, an dem du an einer realistischen Aufgabe mit uns arbeitest.

About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

About the Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

Overview

Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. This role will sit in either our Runtime/Compute or the Developer Experience/CICD squad.
As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will work across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and internal developer tooling. You will work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Infrastructure IT, and other platform teams to build, enhance, and support our developer platform. You will help define standards and best practices, and act as a force multiplier for engineering teams by improving reliability, scalability, and developer productivity.

  • Partner with application teams to unblock delivery and align platform capabilities with developer needs
  • Drive cloud cost efficiency and optimization across our cloud and infrastructure
  • Improve operational excellence through observability, automation, and incident response
  • Help evolve CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-based workflows

title: Senior PMO Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
  • Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
  • Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
  • Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.

PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes

  • Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
  • Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
  • Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Risk, Issue & Performance Management

  • Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
  • Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
  • Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
  • Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

  • A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

  • Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

  • Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are

  • You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

  • You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

  • You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

  • You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

  • You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

  • You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

  • You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

  • You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer

  • A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction.

  • The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth.

  • Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs.

  • The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter.

title: Senior Product Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Analytics organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo powering decision-making across product, commercial and operations through experimentation and causal inference.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our London team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). In this role, you’ll enable high-quality human-led decision-making to maximise impact.

We’re hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.

About Our Analytics Organisation

We have an outstanding analytics organisation, with a mission to enable the highest quality human and machine decision-making.

Our community is highly active, with guest lectures, study groups, mentorship programmes and a robust technical review process. Data Scientists can progress equally as technical leads or people managers.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science, many are not.

What You’ll Be Doing

You will help answer questions like:

  • Which markets/cities should we enter next?

  • How can we incentivise good rider behaviour?

  • What are the trade-offs we face when choosing between growth and profitability? How should we decide between them?

  • How much should our pricing vary by distance and by market?

  • What is the optimum selection and variety of restaurants in a particular area?

Why Join Us?

title: Senior Product Engineer (Software) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Roger is the operating system for dental practices. We automate the work dental teams shouldn’t be doing by hand – from treatment plans to patient communication to revenue optimization – and we plug directly into the practice management systems (PMS) that German practices already run on. We’re early, well-funded, and moving fast.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer who wants to own a product area end to end: understand the practice’s problem, decide what to build, ship it, run it, and improve it with real usage data. Not tickets. Outcomes.

We call the role Product Engineer on purpose. You work directly with product, design, and practices, and you’re accountable for whether what you built actually solves the problem – not just for whether the code merged.

What you’ll build
Everyone works across the whole product; people build deeper expertise in some areas, but who works on what can change quickly. Over a typical quarter you’ll touch things like:
• PMS integrations – connecting Roger to the practice management systems German practices run on, so our workflows sit on top of live practice data instead of beside it
• Treatment plans and cost estimates (HKP) – turning a manual, error-prone paper process into something a practice team gets right the first time
• Patient communication – recalls, reminders, and follow-ups that practices today handle by phone, fax, and sticky note
• Revenue and billing workflows – helping practices bill what they actually did, correctly and on time
• The Roger apps – web and Flutter clients that practice staff use all day, every day

Whatever your area, you’ll own it from the first conversation with a practice to the dashboard that tells you whether it worked.

What we expect
• Own outcomes, not tasks. You define scope, timelines, and success criteria for your area, and you align stakeholders around them
• Make technical decisions and stand behind them. Architecture, trade-offs, what to build versus buy – you decide, document why, and course-correct when the data says so
• Know the system, not just your service. Roger is one product. You keep enough context across PMS integrations, data model, and clients to make decisions that hold up outside your corner
• Raise the bar continuously. Testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability – you leave every area better than you found it
• Shape how we work with AI. Our tooling and practices are still evolving. You contribute to them actively rather than waiting for a playbook
• Enable others. Code reviews, knowledge sharing, pairing – a senior here makes the people around them better

How we work
AI-native engineering, honestly described. Most of us run several coding agents in parallel, all day. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Reviewing it, testing it, and deciding what not to ship is. So here’s what that actually means for you:
• You write specs and plans before you prompt. Skipping design thinking is where projects fail – not the AI
• You review agent output with the same rigor as any PR. If you can’t explain what a module does, it doesn’t ship
• You test relentlessly. A solid test suite is how you turn an unreliable agent into a reliable system
• Your fundamentals are strong enough to evaluate, correct, and improve whatever AI produces – architecture, security, performance
• You know the spectrum: when a throwaway prototype is fine and when full engineering discipline applies
• You expect to spend as much time reviewing and validating as writing. If that sounds like a downgrade, this isn’t the right team. If it sounds like leverage, read on

Patient data is not a detail. Roger handles health data (GDPR Art. 9) and sits inside practices bound by professional secrecy (§ 203 StGB). Data minimization, access control, EU processing, and a clear head about what may go to which model provider are part of the engineering bar here – not a compliance checkbox someone else owns.
Small team, short paths. You talk to practices, to product, and to the people who answer the phones for our customers. Decisions get made in a conversation, not a committee.

Who you are
• Senior-level, with significant experience shipping and operating production systems – you’ve been paged for your own code
• A track record of owning projects end to end: from a vague problem statement through delivery to production and iteration
• Used to working cross-functionally with product, design, data, and non-technical stakeholders – and comfortable talking to end users directly

descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted Go is the delivery arm of Vinted, focused on developing products and solutions for seamless shipping and delivery across Europe and the US. Our delivery network includes more than 30,000 pick-up and drop-off (PUDO), thousands of delivery drivers and cutting-edge sorting tech. Our product portfolio spans mobile apps, IoT devices, and autonomous robots. We operate right where high-scale software meets physical hardware, storefront partner operations, and complex logistics.

In this high-visibility, high-impact role, you’ll join a dedicated cross-functional product team working in close partnership with Engineering, Product Design, Decision Science, Operations, and external partners, you’ll drive the product roadmap, lead discovery, and build scalable solutions that power physical operations across our network.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive the product strategy and roadmap for your ownership area.
  • Lead the end-to-end discovery, design, development, and launch of products.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including product, business, operations, and external teams.
  • Enable the team to create fast impact, prioritising working software, rapid feedback loops, and live experiments over heavy PRDs.

About you 

  • Several years of proven product management experience in a fast-paced environment, working effectively with cross-functional teams in a matrix organisation.
  • Strong ownership mindset: a self-starter comfortable driving alignment amid ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete data, and taking calculated risks.
  • Data-driven and analytical: comfortable applying a combination of qualitative and quantitative methods to define success metrics and act on insights.
  • Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable operating in environments with shifting priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to getting things done.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly to both technical and operational stakeholders.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance
  • Group Life and Income Protection Insurance
  • A matched pension scheme up to a set limit
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

title: Senior Program Manager, Product & GTM Programs
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Senior Program Manager, Product & GTM Programs, you run program management between our GTM organization and Product & Engineering. 

You are the connection point between both sides. You bring them together early on upcoming changes, align on what those changes mean for customers & partners, and determine what support customers need and which internal teams have to be prepared. From there, you own the path to our customers and partners.

Where a change is large enough to become a program in its own right, you own that program end to end. Other teams own their functional deliverables; you own the plan, the sequence, the cadence, the deadline, and the outcome. These programs carry hard cutoffs and significant revenue.

This is a cross-functional program management role at its core: a lot of coordination, judgment, and real accountability for the outcome. There's no playbook waiting for you — building it is part of the job.

Areas of ownership:

  • GTM to Product & Engineering Interface: Serve as the connection point for upcoming customer-impacting changes, bringing both sides together early to align on how customers and partners are affected and what they need to do. You determine which internal teams have to be enabled, from Engagement Managers and Sales to Solution Engineering, Partnerships, and Product Marketing.

  • Program Orchestration: Act as the single coordination point across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Product Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, and Engagement Managers. You steer cross-functional kickoffs, run the cadence that keeps programs moving, and hold functional owners to their commitments, including when that means escalating or re-sequencing.

  • Communication Sequencing: Design the plans for customer and partner communication so they experience one coordinated channel instead of several, and collect early customer and field feedback before it becomes an escalation.

  • Execution and Accountability: Track progress against plan, enforce deadlines, own escalation management end to end, and report to senior leadership in a way that makes risk visible early rather than defensible late.

  • Building the Discipline: Define and measure success metrics for each program, run retrospectives that produce process change rather than documents, and build the playbooks, SOPs, and governance cadence that make this function durable.

Who you are:

  • 5-7+ years in program or project management, owning complex cross-functional programs end to end — not workstreams inside someone else's program

  • You've worked as the connective tissue between technical and commercial teams, translating in both directions

  • Technically fluent in enterprise software platforms: you can assess what a change means for customers without Engineering explaining it each time

  • You operate without formal authority — you've held teams to deadlines you don't own, and you're comfortable making the call

  • You build the system, not just the tracker; you've created or fixed a process that outlived your tenure

  • Energized rather than paralyzed by ambiguity; you build the playbook while running the plays

  • An exceptionally strong writer, equally at home in technical detail and executive narrative

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.
