title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

title: Senior Quality Systems Engineer, United Kingdom
department: Quality Reliability & System Safety : Quality Engineering : Quality Systems Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril’s Quality organization is seeking a Quality Systems Engineer to join our London team and help develop future opportunities for our internal quality management system and digitization efforts. The Quality team works with our customers, internal teams, and suppliers to ensure the deployment of reliable products that meet all mission requirements. We develop cutting-edge Quality processes and methods to secure scalable, long-term business success.
We are growing and this role will focus on internal site growth and implementing a world-class quality management system, supporting our internal manufacturing sites, supplier sites, and allied facilities. This role carries responsibility for ensuring compliance with UK and European regulatory frameworks, NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace, and UK Ministry of Defense (MOD) requirements as part of our London operations.
The right person for this role has extensive knowledge in Quality Management System (QMS) systems, data analysis, and continuous improvement to help shape our internal systems, tools, procedures and the culture of quality at Anduril. If you are someone who loves to build world-class Quality processes, work hands-on, help others succeed on the quality journey, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

About the Job

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a real time, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop, lead, and manage the execution of the QMS and its top-level processes. Coordinate resources and prioritization of tasks to complete internal and external audits of the QMS.
  • Develop, lead, and manage the execution of the QMS software implementation and adoption across Anduril sites, including the London facility. Coordinate resources and prioritization of tasks to complete implementation, internal and external audits of the QMS.
  • Ensure full compliance with UK regulatory requirements, including UK MOD Defense Standards (DEF STANs), UKCA marking where applicable, and relevant UK Health & Safety Executive (HSE) regulations for defense manufacturing environments.
  • Drive compliance with NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace quality, including STANAG 4107 (Mutual Acceptance of Government Quality Assurance and Usage of the Allied Quality Assurance Publications), STANAG 4159 (NATO Quality Assurance Requirements for Design, Development and Production — AQAP-2110), and STANAG 4161 (NATO Quality Management System Requirements for Aviation, Space and Defense — AQAP-2310).
  • Ensure conformance to STANAG 4404 and associated AQAPs for software-intensive aerospace systems, including AQAP-2210 (NATO Supplementary Software Quality Assurance Requirements) as applicable to Lattice OS and embedded mission systems.
  • Support implementation of STANAG 4685 (Airworthiness) requirements as they relate to quality assurance processes for unmanned aerial systems and aerospace components.
  • Liaise with the UK MOD Quality Assurance representatives, the Defence Quality Assurance (DQA) organisation, and NATO Quality Assurance authorities to support Government Quality Assurance (GQA) activities and audits.
  • Partner with business systems team, product quality engineers and manufacturing engineers to help prepare new processes, digital tools, and sites to meet QMS requirements, develop new capabilities to meet existing QMS requirements and conduct internal audits before manufacturing readiness review and production readiness review.
  • Develop our internal QMS road map for tools and capabilities to match the scaling of the company: to meet customer needs, to enable quality capabilities for new products, and scale quality processes as we grow — with particular attention to UK Export Control and ITAR/EAR interface requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with UK data protection requirements (UK GDPR / Data Protection Act 2018) as they relate to quality records, supplier data, and audit documentation.
  • Become a systems expert for Anduril’s quality tools, processes, and data sets to enable effective QMS execution across both US and UK operations.
  • Communicate with external audit agencies, including UKAS-accredited certification bodies and NATO quality assurance authorities. Support customer audits as necessary.
  • Manage the QMS internal audit program and lead internal audits.
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities that benefit the QMS and product quality, aligned with AS9100, NATO AQAP, and STANAG frameworks.
  • Support investigations, initiatives, and projects as needed, at the team or organisation level.
  • Support developing QMS training modules and packages, including UK/NATO-specific regulatory and STANAG training. Facilitate training records and retention with manager of affected trainees.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective action with internal findings from audits and customer visits, including UK MOD and NATO audit findings.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 3–5 years of experience in aerospace and/or defence manufacturing.
  • Expert knowledge of QMS requirements and auditing in a complex product environment, in one or more of the following QMS standards: ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, AS9110C, AS9120B, AS6500, IATF 16949:2016, ISO 13485:2016, TL 9000 R6.3.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace quality, including STANAG 4107, STANAG 4159, STANAG 4161, and their associated Allied Quality Assurance Publications (AQAPs): AQAP-2110, AQAP-2210, and AQAP-2310.
  • Familiarity with UK MOD Defence Standards (DEF STANs) and Government Quality Assurance (GQA) processes.
  • Understanding of UK regulatory frameworks relevant to defence manufacturing, including UK Export Control Act 2002, HSE regulations, and UKCA/CE marking requirements.
  • Working knowledge with QMS software solutions which might include Net Inspect, Siemens, SAP, ETQ, One Factory, MasterControl, Compliance Quest, Hexagon, PTC, QT9.
  • Hands-on experience with data analytics platforms, reporting tools, and basic data visualisation.
  • Demonstrated project management for software system implementation and onboarding suppliers (external users) and internal users.
  • Working knowledge of design, development, manufacturing, supply chain, deployment, contracts, and other organisations that are part of a company-wide audit.
  • Knowledge of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and Business Intelligence (BI) systems.
  • A strong ownership mindset with demonstrated capability to drive projects from start to completion.
  • Proven track record of implementation and success with QMS.
  • Right to work in the United Kingdom.
  • Expected travel up to 20% of the time, including travel to US facilities and NATO partner sites.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an ----- address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let's be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They're seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the 'doing more with less' memos. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.

And we aren't just stable—we're expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we're looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You've successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players.

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What's in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC's hopes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: Senior Scientist, ADME/DMPK
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Scientist, ADME/DMPK, you will own the property prediction layer of Boltz Lab: the ADME and DMPK data we generate and acquire, and the scientific direction of the models built on it. Co-folding changed how scientists think about structure; we believe ADME prediction hasn't had its equivalent moment yet, and this role is how we get there.

You will work closely with ML Research, our Computational Scientists in Small Molecules, CROs and data providers, and Product. ML engineering support is available for anything that needs to reach production; this is not a machine learning role, and you don't need to have trained a model.

This role is ideal for an experienced ADME/DMPK scientist who wants to apply their expertise beyond a traditional drug discovery setting, guiding direction while staying hands-on.

What you'll do

  • Decide what ADME and DMPK data we generate, what we acquire from public and proprietary sources, and how we curate and standardize it.

  • Lead data generation and sourcing campaigns with CROs and data providers, holding a high bar on assay provenance and data quality.

descriptionHtml:

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.

Your Impact

Hello! I'm Roberto Olmeda, leading the Search Discovery Team at commercetools. Search is fundamentally changing shape. Shoppers are moving from keywords to full sentences—and increasingly, the client querying our APIs isn’t a human at all, it’s an AI agent. My team builds the core retrieval layer behind product discovery for the world’s most demanding commerce brands. As we take semantic and hybrid search to general availability, we’re tackling hard engineering problems at every layer: from query understanding and vector indexing down to latency, measurable relevance, and the cost of a single query. We’re looking for a Senior Search Engineer to build across Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, and our functional Scala backend—whether you already love functional programming or are excited to master it with us.

You will:

  • Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend
  • Develop search capabilities that combine lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval
  • Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB
  • Contribute to search relevance and quality, and to how we measure it
  • Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture
  • Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps
  • Learn Scala and functional programming as your new main development tools
  • Take part in on-call rotation with a worldwide distributed team for production systems

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. 

What Sets You Apart

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You do not need to be an ML researcher for this role. You need to be a strong backend engineer who is genuinely interested in retrieval quality.

You bring:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM
  • Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O
  • Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures, including sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover
  • Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns. If you come from another JVM language, we will support you in picking it up.
  • Fluent English for work in international teams
  • Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS where one tenant’s load must never affect another’s
  • Knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures, including queues and notification topics
  • A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have:

  • Hands-on search experience, preferably ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, including a working understanding of how an inverted index scores and ranks documents
  • Practical exposure to vector retrieval, such as embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid ranking, and a sense of where each approach breaks down. A deep lexical search background plus a clear appetite to go into this territory also works.
  • Comfort reasoning about relevance with data, including precision and recall tradeoffs, ranking metrics, and behavioral signals
  • Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust

title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the Role

Lendable is a high-growth FinTech building its security operations capability deliberately. As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you will triage and respond to security alerts, help improve the quality of the detections behind them, and lead the response when a security event becomes an incident.

You will investigate alerts and escalations from our MSSP, tune our monitoring so that it finds more of what matters and less of what doesn’t, and act as a trusted Incident Commander for security incidents, from declaration through to post-incident review. You will work with Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders, and you will be credible with all of them.

AI is used widely across the business, in how we build software, run operations and serve customers, and that changes both what security incidents look like and how quickly we can respond to them. You will use AI and automation as a normal part of your work, and you will be able to investigate and respond to incidents where AI tooling is the cause, the target or the route in.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with hands-on SOC experience and a track record of commanding incidents.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. Alert Triage & Monitoring

  • Triage and investigate alerts across our SIEM, EDR, identity and cloud tooling, taking escalations from our MSSP’s first-line team.

  • Reduce false positives and alert fatigue by tuning detection rules, thresholds and suppressions.

  • Utilise AI and automation to speed up triage, enrichment and response, and to remove repetitive manual work from the analyst workflow.

2. Incident Command & Response

  • Command security incidents, coordinating technical response, decision-making and communications across Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders. Give clear, timely updates to executives during live incidents.

  • Lead or support technical investigation and containment across endpoint, identity and cloud (AWS/GCP) environments, including incidents involving AI use, such as prompt injection, or credentials exposed through AI-generated code.

  • Run blameless post-incident reviews, track actions to closure, and feed lessons back into detection, playbooks and controls.

  • Take part in the out-of-hours on-call rota.

3. Operational Reporting & Assurance

  • Track and report SecOps metrics that reflect reality, such as alert quality, time to triage, time to contain, incident volumes and root causes.

  • Maintain accurate incident records and evidence in our incident management platform to support audit and assurance activity.

  • Build working relationships with Engineering, Platform and IT Systems so that incident response is practised before it is needed.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven incident command: Demonstrable experience leading significant security incidents as Incident Commander or lead responder, from declaration to resolution and review. You can describe incidents you have run, the decisions you made and what you changed afterwards.

  • Technical investigation skills: Solid hands-on SOC/DFIR experience, including log analysis, endpoint and identity investigation, and cloud incident response in AWS or GCP.

  • AI fluency: You understand how AI use creates security risk, including data exposure, agent misuse and AI-assisted attacks, and you can investigate and contain incidents that involve it.

  • AI-first ways of working: You already use AI and automation to speed up your own work, whether in investigation, enrichment, detection engineering or reporting, and you can judge when to trust the output and when to check it.

  • Composure and influence: You stay calm and structured under pressure, and can direct engineers and senior stakeholders without formal authority over them.

  • Communication: You can brief a senior leader in plain language during a live incident, and write a post-incident report that an engineer, an auditor and a board member can each use.

  • Pragmatism: You understand that security supports a business moving quickly, and you balance risk, speed and proportionality in your decisions.

  • Regulated environment awareness (desirable): Experience in financial services or another regulated sector, including incident reporting and evidence expectations.

  • Certifications (desirable, not required): GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, or equivalent practical experience.

Interview process

  • A quick phone call with one of the talent team

  • A Hiring Manager call with our Head of InfoSec

  • Technical Interview with two of the team

  • Final stage interview with our VP of Engineering

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, IaaS
descriptionHtml:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.  

The team

The Infrastructure as a Service team is at the center of one of Algolia’s most consequential engineering transformations.

For years, Algolia has operated a production fleet of approximately 4,000 bare-metal servers to deliver the reliability, low latency, and scalability that our customers expect. We are now building the foundations of a unified cloud and Kubernetes platform designed to support Algolia’s growth for years to come.

This is not a lift-and-shift project. It is an opportunity to rethink how Algolia provisions, secures, operates, observes, upgrades, and scales production infrastructure and to build it as a platform that engineers can safely consume, rather than a queue of manual requests.

The opportunity

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer in IaaS, you will help shape the next generation of Algolia’s production infrastructure.

You will lead major parts of the Cloud Baseline and the reliable lifecycle capabilities that enable teams to operate and migrate workloads safely on a cloud-native platform. You will work across cloud foundations, Kubernetes, platform engineering, automation, reliability, and large-scale production operations.

This role is for an engineer who enjoys solving infrastructure problems where the answer must work not once, but hundreds or thousands of times: creating repeatable cloud environments, enabling a growing fleet of production clusters, reducing manual operations, and maintaining the reliability and cost efficiency our customers expect throughout the transition.

YOU WILL:

  • Lead the design and evolution of Cloud Baseline capabilities across cloud providers, including identity and access, networking, account structure, security, auditability, tagging, inventory, and cost visibility.
  • Design and automate cloud infrastructure foundations that enable a growing fleet of production Kubernetes clusters.
  • Lead complex infrastructure initiatives, such as cloud-environment standardisation, cluster lifecycle automation, upgrade strategies, or infrastructure-drift reduction.
  • Ensure cloud and Kubernetes foundations, lifecycle operations, and operational guardrails are reliable and scalable enough to support large-scale workload migration without compromising customer experience.
  • Treat the platform as a product: define clear interfaces, reusable modules, self-service workflows, documentation, and reliable operational standards for the engineers who consume it.
  • Build automated guardrails for security, compliance, reliability, and safe change management, allowing teams to move faster without weakening production protections.
  • Improve platform efficiency through capacity planning, rightsizing, autoscaling, resource governance, and clear cost visibility.
  • Use automation and AI-assisted engineering tools where appropriate to improve fleet-scale analysis, infrastructure documentation, and safe, repeatable operational changes.
  • Mentor engineers, share knowledge, and raise the quality of infrastructure design and operations across the team.
  • Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, FinOps, and engineering teams to align technical decisions and deliver high-impact platform capabilities.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation and lead the resolution of complex production issues.

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:

  • Strong hands-on production expertise with AWS or GCP.
  • Deep practical Kubernetes knowledge, including its cloud infrastructure dependencies and operational challenges.
  • The ability to design, build, and operate reliable cloud infrastructure in production.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code and automation skills, ideally Terraform and Python, Go, or equivalent.
  • Solid knowledge of Linux, networking, distributed systems, and production operations.
  • A platform mindset: you design for the engineers who consume what you build, balancing velocity, correctness, security, and reliability.
  • Awareness of cloud cost drivers and the ability to treat cost as an engineering constraint.
  • A track record of leading complex technical initiatives and delivering durable solutions across teams.
  • Comfort adopting AI-assisted engineering tools, with strong judgement for critical production systems.
  • Excellent spoken and written English skills.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Familiarity with more than one public cloud provider.
  • Knowledge of GitOps or policy-as-code tooling, such as Argo CD, Helm, OPA, or Kyverno.
  • Exposure to cloud migration, platform engineering, FinOps, or large-scale infrastructure transformation.

Je combineert strategisch advies met een hands-on aanpak en ontwikkelt en optimaliseert campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok. Daarbij werk je met grote mediabudgetten en krijg je volop ruimte om impact te maken. AI speelt een belangrijke rol in jouw werk. Je benut slimme tools en automatisering om campagnes, content en processen continu te verbeteren. Daarnaast signaleer je proactief commerciële kansen bij klanten en deel je jouw kennis en ervaring met junior marketeers. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan het succes van klanten, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team en de dienstverlening van Indicia.

Over Indicia

Indicia is een onafhankelijk tech, data en AI-bureau dat sinds 1996 organisaties helpt om digitaal te groeien. Vanuit de overtuiging dat succesvolle digitale oplossingen beginnen bij een goed begrip van de business, combineert Indicia technologie, data en ondernemerschap om organisaties verder te brengen.

Met ruim 250 digitale specialisten biedt Indicia een breed scala aan diensten, waaronder online marketing, webdevelopment, HubSpot, AI en design. Van het ontwikkelen van websites en digitale platforms tot het realiseren van effectieve marketingcampagnes en slimme automatiseringen. Indicia bedient klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en richt zich steeds meer op grotere organisaties en langdurige samenwerkingen.

De organisatie bevindt zich in een fase van verdere professionalisering, waarbij de focus ligt op het verdiepen van specialismen, het versterken van de strategische klantrelaties en het realiseren van meetbare resultaten. AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Indicia ontwikkelt eigen AI-tools om processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten, waardoor meer ruimte ontstaat voor strategisch advies, innovatie en klantontwikkeling.

De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, familiair en ondernemend. Collega's werken nauw samen, krijgen veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en worden gestimuleerd om zich zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd groeit de ambitie om resultaatgerichter te werken en als organisatie verder te professionaliseren.

https://www.indicia.ai/

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Ontwikkelen en presenteren van socialmediastrategieën voor grote klanten, waarbij je commerciële doelstellingen vertaalt naar concrete campagnes en meetbare resultaten;

Als ervaren collega ben je een vraagbaak en sparringpartner voor de junior social marketeers. Je deelt je kennis over social en AI, en helpt hen zo verder te groeien. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Sophie Mees, Delivery Manager Online Marketing.

title: Senior Social Media Manager - UK
descriptionHtml:
Developers decide what’s interesting long before they decide what to buy. They follow builders, share the talk everyone is watching, and argue about benchmarks in the replies. Most infrastructure brands show up in that feed looking and sounding the same. ClickHouse has the material to do something different: a fast, open-source database that has grown into a platform for real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads; engineers and leaders with real points of view; and a brand that already turns up in unexpected places, from a Premier League partnership to our own Open House conference.

We are looking for a Senior Social Media Manager to run the ClickHouse accounts and turn that material into a brand developers actually want to follow, at the intersection of infrastructure, technology, and culture. You’ll own our presence on LinkedIn, X, and YouTube with video at the center: clipping talks, podcasts, launches, and live moments into content that travels, building formats people come back for, and working with the creators developers already trust. You’ll be accountable for growing audience and engagement across a global community.

You’ll sit on the Story & Communications team, reporting to the Head of Story & Communications, and work closely with developer relations, product marketing, demand generation, events, and our brand and design team. This is a hands-on role: you’ll make the work, not only schedule it.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Run the ClickHouse accounts on LinkedIn, X, and YouTube end to end: strategy, voice, calendar, publishing, and community management, with an approach built for each channel and for a global audience across time zones

  • Put video at the center of how ClickHouse shows up: clip talks, podcasts, livestreams, launches, and executive moments into short-form and vertical content, and build recurring, social-first series that earn a following

  • Build a brand developers find interesting at the intersection of infrastructure, technology, and culture, pairing technical depth with humor, opinion, and craft

  • Work with the creators and technical voices developers already follow, through collaborations, co-created content, guest appearances, and amplification, in tandem with developer relations and the wider marketing team

  • Turn launches, announcements, customer stories, and research into social moments, and bring live coverage from Open House and industry events, working with regional teams so local moments reach a global audience

  • Grow the voices around the brand: partner with communications on executive presence on LinkedIn and X, and give employees and developer advocates what they need to share their work

  • Own the numbers for organic social, including audience growth, engagement, video performance, and share of the developer conversation, and report on what’s working and why

  • Track what developers say about ClickHouse and the category and feed it back to product marketing, developer relations, and campaign teams, while using AI tooling and a lean production workflow to ship content quickly and partnering with demand generation so the best organic work gets paid reach

What You Bring Along

  • A record of growing audience and engagement at scale for a brand with a global following, and the numbers to show it

  • Real fluency with video: you can shoot, edit, and clip yourself, you know what makes short-form and vertical content work on each platform, and you can find the best ninety seconds in an hour-long talk

  • Experience running influencer or creator programs: finding the right voices, structuring partnerships, and making the collaboration feel native to the creator’s audience

  • Experience with a technical or B2B audience, and the ability to turn technical substance into something people want to share

  • Preferred: experience in SaaS, developer tools, or infrastructure

  • Taste and a point of view on internet culture: you know where developers spend time online, what they find funny, and what makes them tune a brand out

  • Sharp short-form writing: the post, the hook, the caption, the thread

  • A builder’s approach: you test quickly, read the data honestly, scale what works, and drop what doesn’t

  • Comfort owning a channel end to end while working across many teams, with low ego and high standards

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

title: Senior Software Engineer (GOlang, Engine)
descriptionHtml:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

The Engine team develops and maintains core components of the Workato Recipe runtime. Scope includes recipe execution, DSL, event pulling, webhook processing, and job execution. The team owns trigger and event infrastructure that defines how integrations start and react to external events. Current focus: modernization of a high-throughput platform to improve reliability, scalability, and long-term evolvability. Work is platform-oriented and directly impacts runtime performance and system correctness.

In this role, you will also be responsible to:

  • Design and implement distributed backend systems in Go with deep consideration of performance and memory behavior.

  • Work on runtime-level components operating under high concurrency and throughput.

  • Apply in-depth knowledge of Go internals (scheduler, memory model, garbage collection behavior) to improve system efficiency.

  • Design and optimize concurrent workflows using goroutines, channels, synchronization primitives, and context propagation.

  • Analyze and optimize slice usage, memory allocations, and data structures for performance-critical paths.

  • Improve execution engine for custom third-party code (isolation, performance, feature extensions).

  • Modernize runtime components with focus on modularity, structured architecture, and observability.

  • Improve trigger configuration and execution across webhooks and polling mechanisms.

  • Integrate and optimize data storage solutions (Postgres, S3, DynamoDB, Kafka, ClickHouse).

  • Identify bottlenecks, race conditions, deadlocks, and performance degradation in distributed systems.

  • Own initiatives end-to-end, from design to rollout and production support.

  • Conduct code reviews with emphasis on correctness, concurrency safety, and performance characteristics.

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in building scalable distributed backend applications (7+ years).

  • Great understanding of all building blocks of large web applications: databases, load balancers, application servers, message brokers, caching, monitoring, etc.

  • Good understanding of network protocols and stacks.

  • Good understanding of DB technologies: classic databases and modern no-SQL.

  • Knowledge of basic data structures and algorithms and how they are used is a must.

  • Multilingual programming experience: our code base is primarily in Ruby, with trend to migrate to GOlang and Rust.

  • Excellent debugging, analytical, problem solving, and social skills.

  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related subject, 7+ years of industry experience.

  • Readiness to work remotely with teams distributed across the world and timezones.

Nice to Haves

  • Background in network programming.

  • Background in application, data security.

  • Deep knowledge of physical DB design.

  • Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies.

  • Experience of working with public cloud infrastructure providers(AWS/Azure/Google Cloud).

  • Experience in related fields (DevOps, ML, DBA, Enterprise applications, etc).

  • Experience in building/deploying data processing pipelines is a plus.

  • Experience of working with third-party REST APIs at scale (request throttling, batch processing etc).

Anaplan is the leading enterprise decision-making platform, powering the world’s largest enterprises with our proprietary Hyperblock™ technology and cloud infrastructure. We are seeking an Engineer IV to join our team in Manchester, UK, or York, UK. 

Your Impact

  • Lead the design, delivery, and architecture of platform capabilities powering Anaplan’s enterprise-scale API gateways, edge routing, and developer acceleration.
  • Build and scale high-throughput backend engines that manage core request orchestration, seamless multi-tenant isolation, and API-first solutions serving thousands of tenants and tens of thousands of users.

  • Drive the evolution of our deployment infrastructure, championing modern GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Helm) and highly available containerized orchestration.
  • Own foundational features end-to-end—from design through to production—while continuously improving system observability, implementing intelligent rate-limiting, and solving complex concurrency challenges (e.g., database locks and connection starvation).
  • Deliver thought leadership and coding excellence across Java/Kotlin, ensuring seamless integration between backend microservices and UI components (including resolving complex CORS and distributed edge proxy requirements).
  • Mentor and elevate engineers across global teams through design reviews, pair programming, and hands-on leadership to foster a resilient engineering culture.

Your Qualifications

  • Experience in software engineering within enterprise-scale, high-throughput platform or data-centric environments.
  • Understand, leverage, and integrate modern AI tools and concepts—including agentic programming patterns and LLM-assisted workflows—to accelerate platform engineering and developer velocity.
  • Deep expertise in backend JVM languages (Java and/or Kotlin) with a strong understanding of distributed systems internals.
  • Proven track record of delivering API-first infrastructures, API Gateways (e.g., Traefik), and edge routing solutions that guarantee enterprise reliability under sustained traffic loads (2K+ requests per second).
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerized deployments, and managing complex CI/CD pipelines (strong familiarity with GitOps, ArgoCD, and high-velocity release workflows).

title: Senior Software Engineer.
descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

The opportunity.

AI is changing the engineering industry, and we see it as a huge opportunity to deliver more value to our customers, at unprecedented scale and pace, and to a higher standard than ever before. We want to be at the forefront of this change as we become an AI-native engineering organisation.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help lead this change and shape the next generation of products that transform how organisations around the world use data. You'll join our R&D department, over 200 people across London, Ireland and Malaga, working in cross-functional teams helping to build the Quantexa Platform, our core Contextual Decision Intelligence offering. Our technology helps customers tackle complex challenges across fraud detection, financial crime, data management and more.

What you will be doing.

  • Own the design, planning and delivery of entire features and epics end to end, ensuring they are delivered on time and to a high quality bar

  • Lead technical and architectural discussions, considering performance, reliability and security, and ensuring solutions work well within the wider system

  • Lead by example in AI-native engineering, helping to shape and drive the adoption of agentic tools and practices across the software development lifecycle

  • Build clean, well-tested and maintainable software, primarily in Scala, working with agentic tools to accelerate delivery and setting the standard for quality through code review

  • Work with Product Managers, Designers and Team Leads to shape upcoming features, contributing to estimates and reliable delivery plans

  • Mentor and support other engineers through code review, pairing and technical guidance, and take part in interviewing

  • Spot opportunities to improve processes, tooling and ways of working

Tech Stack.

Agentic tooling and automated workflows are embedded across our software development lifecycle, from design and coding through to testing, review and release, and we are building our own software factory, using services such as Claude to automate and accelerate how our engineers work.

On the back end, we build highly scalable, performant distributed services in Scala, capable of processing huge volumes of data. Our services are built on the Typelevel ecosystem (Cats, Cats Effect and fs2) and Apache Pekko, and we apply techniques such as event sourcing and CQRS in our persistence layer, giving us scalable datastores, flexible enough to meet the varied requirements of our customers. We also use Apache Spark and Kafka for large-scale data processing and streaming.

Our front end is built with Angular, TypeScript and Signals and is designed to be highly extensible, with AI agents accelerating how we build UI components and Playwright underpinning our component and integration testing. We also use Python for our client SDKs, enabling data scientists and engineers to work with the Platform from notebooks and data science environments.

What you'll bring.

  • Have a product-focused mindset, with a passion for building high-quality software that has real-world impact and that customers love

  • Have practical experience using agentic tools (such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor) across the software development lifecycle, with a clear understanding of their strengths, limitations and how to apply them effectively

  • Have significant commercial experience building scalable backend systems on the JVM, ideally in Scala with functional programming (we'll also consider strong Java engineers with some Scala experience)

  • Have a strong grasp of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, maintainability and performance, and set a high bar in code review

  • Have experience designing distributed systems that scale to high volumes of data and users, with a solid understanding of architectural patterns such as event-driven design, event sourcing and CQRS

  • Take a big picture approach to solving problems, considering security, reliability and how solutions fit within the wider system

  • Have experience owning significant pieces of work through the full engineering lifecycle and into a live SaaS environment, and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving setting

  • Enjoy mentoring others and can communicate complex technical ideas clearly to engineers and stakeholders

Nice to haves.

  • Building large-scale data processing and ETL/analytics pipelines with Apache Spark, ideally on managed cloud platforms such as GCP Dataproc, Azure Databricks or AWS EMR

  • Improving data quality through cleansing, parsing and standardisation, and indexing data into search technologies such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch

  • DevOps tooling and practices such as Infra-as-Code, containerisation, Kubernetes and CI/CD, and delivering software that runs both on-premise and as a service (automation is something we’re passionate about, and we even have a dedicated Developer Tooling team)

  • Building or extending AI-enabled developer tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers or automated review workflows

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

  • Competitive salary

  • Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare with AXA, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Calm App Subscription #1 app for meditation, relaxation and sleep

  • Continuous Training and Development, including access to Udemy Business

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Employee Referral Program

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

Location: South East England – based within ~30 miles of Crawley

Are you an experienced electrician who enjoys fault-finding more than fitting? Otovo is building its UK field service team and we’re looking for a senior Solar PV & Battery Service Engineer to lead our service work across the South East.

  • Level 3 electrical qualification and a valid ECS card

  • BS 7671 18th Edition

  • Based within ~30 miles of Crawley and willing to travel across the South East

descriptionHtml:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

This role can be based out of our Zurich office or remotely in the Switzerland region.

  • Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
  • The ability to travel up to 25%
  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • Fluency in English and German

You may also have:

  • Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers

  • Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
  • Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders

  • Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events
  • Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
  • Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members 
  • Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn:

MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:

  • Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
  • Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
  • Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Market-Relevant Technologies:

  • Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
  • Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design:

  • Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
  • Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:

  • Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
  • Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Industry Insights:

  • Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that.
